items.title: OpenAI supports EU Code of Practice on AI content transparency, advancing provenance standards for trustworthy AI ecosystem in Europe [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has announced its support for the European Union's Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content, aiming to promote a trustworthy AI ecosystem in Europe. The company is contributing to the development of provenance standards and tools that help users understand the origin and nature of AI-generated content. Building on years of internal research and collaboration with industry groups like C2PA, OpenAI has implemented multiple provenance signals such as metadata and watermarks in its AI-generated images. The company also offers a public verification tool and commits to complying with EU AI Act requirements, emphasizing transparency and responsible AI development in the European digital ecosystem.

items.title: OpenAI and Oracle partner to let Oracle Cloud customers access OpenAI models and Codex using existing cloud commitments [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI and Oracle have partnered to allow Oracle Cloud Infrastructure customers to use their existing Oracle Universal Credits to access OpenAI's advanced models and Codex. This integration enables enterprises to incorporate AI capabilities within their established procurement and governance frameworks without needing new purchasing processes. The availability is expected to begin in the coming weeks, providing a streamlined path for organizations to deploy AI applications while aligning with their current cloud investments and enterprise workflows.

items.title: Google DeepMind releases DiffusionGemma, a 26B MoE model enabling up to 4x faster text generation on GPUs with parallel token processing [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind introduced DiffusionGemma, an experimental open-source 26 billion parameter Mixture of Experts model that generates text up to four times faster on dedicated GPUs by producing entire blocks of tokens simultaneously rather than sequentially. The model targets speed-critical, interactive local workflows such as in-line editing and rapid iteration, operating efficiently within 18GB VRAM on consumer GPUs by activating only 3.8 billion parameters during inference. DiffusionGemma uses a novel diffusion approach with bi-directional attention to refine text iteratively, allowing it to self-correct and handle non-linear text structures like code infilling and mathematical graphs. While its output quality is lower than standard autoregressive Gemma 4 models, it offers significant speed advantages for local inference scenarios, especially on single accelerators with low to medium batch sizes. Developers can fine-tune DiffusionGemma for specific tasks, as demonstrated by its improved performance on Sudoku solving due to its bi-directional attention mechanism.

items.title: OpenAI says PRC-linked influence operations used AI-generated content to manipulate US AI policy debates, targeting data center narratives and tariffs [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI reported that two clusters of ChatGPT accounts likely originating from China were banned after using AI-generated comments and images to influence US debates on AI and technology policies. These operations focused on increasing concerns about data center electricity costs and criticizing US tariffs, while falsely alleging ChatGPT user data compromises. The campaigns, named "Data Center Bandwagon" and "Tech and Tariffs," covertly inserted themselves into American discussions about AI infrastructure and policy without revealing their origins. OpenAI found no evidence that these influence efforts significantly shifted public opinion but highlighted the tactics as attempts to exploit local issues and undermine democratic discourse. By disclosing these findings, OpenAI aims to assist industry, governments, and civil society in identifying and countering foreign influence operations that seek to manipulate public debates and weaken democratic institutions through AI-enabled surveillance and control.

items.title: Google DeepMind and partners launch $10M global funding initiative for multi-agent AI safety research, focusing on emergent behaviors and system-wide risks [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind, along with Schmidt Sciences, the Cooperative AI Foundation, ARIA, and Google.org, announced a $10 million funding call to support research on the safety of multi-agent AI systems. The initiative aims to understand and mitigate risks arising from interactions among millions of AI agents across digital environments. The funding targets four priority areas: creating realistic test environments, studying collective behaviors in agent networks, strengthening secure agent infrastructure, and developing oversight methods to monitor and control agent populations. Researchers worldwide are invited to apply by August 8, 2026, with awardees expected to be announced in autumn 2026.

items.title: LSEG scales trusted AI using OpenAI technology to accelerate data insights and reduce product release cycles from six months to two weeks [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) has integrated OpenAI's generative AI models across its global operations to enhance data-driven decision-making and innovation. This deployment supports around 4,000 employees and aims to streamline workflows, improve analyst productivity, and accelerate product development timelines. LSEG adopted a deliberate strategy focusing on real problems and responsible scaling, embedding governance measures such as human-in-the-loop reviews and data privacy controls. The initiative has reduced product release cycles from three to six months down to two weeks and shortened customer delivery timelines to about four weeks, while fostering cross-functional collaboration and enabling rapid prototyping.

items.title: Google launches Gemini 3.5 Live Translate for near real-time speech-to-speech translation in over 70 languages across Google AI Studio, Translate, and Meet [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Google has introduced Gemini 3.5 Live Translate, an audio model that delivers near real-time speech-to-speech translation in more than 70 languages, preserving speakers' intonation and pacing. The model continuously generates translated speech with low latency, enabling fluid conversations without awkward pauses. Gemini 3.5 Live Translate is available to developers via the Gemini Live API and Google AI Studio, in private preview for enterprises on Google Meet, and broadly through the Google Translate app on Android and iOS. The technology supports multilingual inputs without manual configuration and is designed to work well in noisy environments, facilitating live interpretation for calls, meetings, and broadcasts. Google is also rolling out a new listening mode on Android that streams translations directly through the phone earpiece for private use.

items.title: Google DeepMind introduces Gemma 4 12B, an encoder-free multimodal model with native audio input and laptop-ready efficiency [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind has launched Gemma 4 12B, a multimodal AI model that processes vision and audio inputs directly without separate encoders, enabling advanced reasoning and agentic workflows on consumer laptops with 16GB of VRAM. This model bridges the gap between their edge-friendly E4B and larger 26B Mixture of Experts models, offering high performance with a reduced memory footprint and open-source availability under Apache 2.0 license. Gemma 4 12B replaces traditional vision and audio encoders with lightweight embedding modules and projects raw audio signals into the same token space as text, streamlining multimodal input processing. It supports multi-token prediction to reduce latency and integrates with popular developer tools and platforms, allowing local deployment and production use through Google Cloud services. The model has already seen over 150 million downloads across the Gemma 4 series, powering applications from wearable robotics to enterprise AI security.

items.title: Google DeepMind launches three-month accelerator for 15 European robotics startups to integrate AI into real-world applications [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind has started a three-month accelerator program selecting 15 early-stage robotics startups across Europe to receive mentorship, technical support, and access to advanced AI models. The program aims to help these companies apply AI to robotics challenges in sectors such as healthcare, manufacturing, and climate solutions. The selected startups will work closely with Google experts to turn complex AI research into practical robotic products, leveraging Google's AI stack and Gemini robotics models. This initiative reflects a broader effort to advance physical AI and robotics innovation across Europe by supporting startups that address real-world problems with scalable, intelligent robotic systems.

items.title: Nextdoor engineers use Codex with GPT-5.5 to accelerate product development and solve complex technical issues across platforms [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Nextdoor's engineering team integrates Codex powered by GPT-5.5 to enhance productivity by enabling engineers to focus on product outcomes rather than implementation details. This approach allows individual engineers to own features end-to-end, speeding up development and improving product understanding. Codex assists with debugging difficult issues, such as embedded Rust databases and Kubernetes pod failures, by providing persistent investigation capabilities. The faster engineering cycles have shifted organizational bottlenecks from technical execution to strategic decision-making about what to build next.

items.title: Notion uses OpenAI Codex to accelerate feature development, including AI voice input for web, reducing engineering time from weeks to hours [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Notion has integrated OpenAI's Codex to significantly speed up its software development processes, enabling features like AI-powered voice input on the web. This technology allows engineers and managers to delegate coding tasks to Codex, which can produce code that meets the company's standards with minimal oversight, cutting development time from two weeks to a few hours. The adoption of Codex has transformed how Notion's engineering team operates, allowing them to handle multiple tasks in parallel and freeing managers to contribute directly to coding. This shift has increased productivity and enabled smaller teams to deliver complex features more efficiently, with Codex acting as a constant assistant for research, bug fixes, and feature implementation.

items.title: OpenAI proposes people-first industrial policy ideas for the Intelligence Age to expand opportunity and build resilient institutions [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced a set of early, exploratory industrial policy ideas aimed at ensuring advanced AI technologies benefit everyone by focusing on expanding opportunities, sharing prosperity, and strengthening institutional resilience. These proposals are intended as a starting point for public discussion and democratic refinement as society approaches superintelligence. To support this initiative, OpenAI is reviewing over 400 responses to its call for feedback, offering fellowships and research grants up to $100,000 and $1 million in API credits, and organizing discussions at its new Washington, DC workshop. The company emphasizes that these ideas are not final recommendations but invite ongoing collaboration and development from the broader community.

items.title: OpenAI confidentially submits draft S-1 registration statement to SEC, timing for public offering undecided [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has confidentially submitted a draft S-1 registration statement to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, signaling a potential future public offering. The company has not set a timeline for proceeding with the offering, citing ongoing considerations about remaining private versus going public. This filing provides OpenAI with the option to go public sooner if it aligns with their strategic decisions, but no immediate plans have been announced.

items.title: Google DeepMind reports AI-driven Guided Learning boosts math progress by up to 2.5 years in Sierra Leone trial [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind conducted a randomized controlled trial with 1,763 junior secondary students in Sierra Leone, finding that its Gemini AI's Guided Learning feature significantly improved math scores over eight weeks. The AI tool supported teachers by promoting conceptual understanding and encouraging students to engage deeply rather than seek direct answers. The trial showed students using Guided Learning gained between 1.2 and 2.5 years of typical learning progress, with high engagement levels far exceeding typical educational technology adoption rates. Teachers reported that the AI also enhanced their instructional methods, shifting their role toward facilitators. DeepMind plans further global trials and has released a teacher training guide to support wider adoption and evidence-based AI integration in education.

items.title: OpenAI outlines plan to develop artificial general intelligence with broad access, safety, and shared benefits for all humanity [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has detailed its vision for artificial intelligence, emphasizing the development of artificial general intelligence (AGI) that benefits everyone by expanding human capabilities and distributing advantages widely. The organization stresses the importance of safety, alignment with human intent, and preventing power concentration among a few entities. The plan draws parallels to the transformative impact of electricity, highlighting AI's potential to improve daily life and create new opportunities. OpenAI also calls for international coordination to manage risks and ensure that AI development proceeds with societal resilience and shared safety standards in mind.

items.title: OpenAI launches Economic Research Exchange to support external studies on AI's impact on employment and the economy, accepting project proposals through July 2026 [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced the Economic Research Exchange, a platform designed to facilitate rigorous external research on how artificial intelligence affects workers, firms, institutions, and the broader economy. The initiative invites researchers to submit proposals for structured collaborations that use OpenAI tools and datasets while ensuring privacy and responsible data use. Selected projects will follow defined milestones and governance processes, focusing on empirical questions in areas such as labor economics, productivity, and inequality. The Exchange aims to expand the evidence base for policymakers, businesses, and the public amid rapid technological change, with applications open until July 5, 2026, and notifications expected by July 31.

items.title: Endava integrates OpenAI agents into software delivery and enterprise workflows to accelerate development and foster AI-native culture [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: Endava is redesigning its software delivery by embedding AI agents like ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex across its workflows, aiming to accelerate development and transform enterprise collaboration. The company has developed an AI-native delivery methodology called DavaFlow, which incorporates AI throughout planning, engineering, and deployment stages. Beyond engineering, Endava has expanded AI adoption to legal, finance, and operations teams, using AI to automate reporting, streamline research, and build internal tools without dedicated engineering support. Leadership emphasizes AI fluency as a core skill and encourages experimentation to drive organization-wide adoption. Looking ahead, Endava plans to focus on orchestrating AI models, agents, and workflows to reshape organizational operations, viewing AI not just as a productivity tool but as a fundamental operating model.

items.title: OpenAI rolls out Dreaming V3 memory system for ChatGPT Plus and Pro users in the US to improve context retention and personalization [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has launched a new, more capable memory system called Dreaming V3 for ChatGPT Plus and Pro users in the US, designed to enhance the model's ability to remember user preferences, maintain relevant context, and provide fresher, more accurate responses over time. This system builds on previous memory features by synthesizing information from multiple conversations to offer a scalable and efficient memory experience without relying solely on explicit user instructions. The Dreaming V3 update allows users to review and manage their memory summaries, enabling better control over what ChatGPT remembers and how it applies that information in future interactions. The rollout will expand to additional countries and free-tier users in the coming weeks, aiming to improve ChatGPT's usefulness for long-term projects and personalized assistance by carrying forward useful context and adapting to changes over time.

items.title: OpenAI launches biodefense action plan using AI model GPT-Rosalind to enhance biological threat detection and pandemic preparedness [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI introduced a biodefense action plan in June 2026 centered on its AI model GPT-Rosalind, designed to support biological research and improve pandemic preparedness. The plan aims to strengthen biological security by enabling earlier threat detection, faster countermeasure development, and coordinated crisis response. GPT-Rosalind, released in April 2026, supports research in biology, drug discovery, and medicine, reflecting OpenAI's commitment to advancing health outcomes. The biodefense initiative focuses on equipping trusted developers with advanced AI tools while establishing safeguards and governance for their responsible use to build a more resilient biological future.

items.title: OpenAI updates GPT-Rosalind with enhanced biological reasoning, medicinal chemistry, genomics, and experimental workflow support for life sciences research [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has released an updated version of GPT-Rosalind, a model designed for enterprise-scale life sciences research. The new capabilities include improved performance in medicinal chemistry, genomics analysis, and experimental workflows, leveraging GPT-5.5's advanced coding and tool-use features to support complex drug discovery tasks. The update was evaluated using LifeSciBench, a benchmark developed to assess models on key life sciences research workflows such as evidence handling, scientific reasoning, and experimental validation. GPT-Rosalind demonstrated broad gains across these areas, aiding researchers in tasks like data synthesis from diverse biological sources and troubleshooting wet lab experiments. The model is now available in research preview to eligible organizations worldwide through a trusted-access deployment.

items.title: Wasmer uses Codex with GPT-5.5 to build a Node.js runtime for edge computing, cutting development time from one year to two weeks [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Wasmer developed Edge.js, a JavaScript runtime that runs Node.js workloads inside a WebAssembly sandbox for edge computing, using Codex powered by GPT-5.5. This approach accelerated their development speed by 10 to 20 times, enabling a small team to complete a project that would have otherwise taken a year in just two weeks. The Wasmer team leveraged Codex throughout the project lifecycle, from architecture to debugging, benefiting from its ability to reason across languages and identify low-level bugs. This breakthrough allowed Wasmer to become the first cloud host to offer full Node.js support at the edge, opening possibilities for more ambitious projects in the future.

items.title: OpenAI proposes a federal blueprint for democratic governance of frontier AI, emphasizing safety, resilience, and national security in the US [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has released a blueprint outlining how the United States can establish a durable federal framework to govern increasingly capable frontier AI systems. The plan focuses on building a national framework aligned with emerging state laws, strengthening the Center for AI Safety and Innovation (CAISI) as the primary federal institution, and mobilizing a resilience strategy to address national security and public safety challenges posed by advanced AI. The blueprint builds on recent state-level initiatives such as California's SB 53, New York's RAISE Act, and Illinois's SB 315, as well as the White House's executive order on Promoting Advanced Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Security. OpenAI emphasizes the need for a federal framework that can evolve alongside AI technology to ensure safe and responsible development.

items.title: OpenAI releases public policy agenda outlining AI safety, user protection, workforce transition, and global standards priorities [ * ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has published its public policy agenda focused on ensuring artificial general intelligence benefits all humanity. The agenda emphasizes AI safety, protecting young users, managing workforce changes due to AI, and establishing global standards to maximize societal benefits. The agenda outlines OpenAI's core principles including democratization, empowerment, universal prosperity, resilience, and adaptability. It supports state and federal efforts in the US to create safety frameworks for advanced AI models and advocates for international cooperation on AI standards. OpenAI also highlights its commitment to broad user accessibility and engagement with governments and civil society to shape policies that advance safe and equitable AI deployment.

items.title: Travelers deploys AI-powered Claim Assistant nationwide using OpenAI to handle surge in auto insurance claims [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Travelers has launched an AI-powered Claim Assistant developed with OpenAI to help customers file auto insurance claims through natural conversation. The tool operates 24/7, guiding users through first notice of loss, answering policy questions, and submitting claims without wait times, even during catastrophe events. After initial deployment in eight states, Travelers expanded the assistant nationwide within two months, with 85-90% of customers completing claims via AI. This system allows claim professionals to focus on complex cases while managing high claim volumes efficiently.

items.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Sites for creating and sharing lightweight internal websites and apps using Codex [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced ChatGPT Sites, a feature within the Codex desktop app that enables users to create, customize, and deploy lightweight internal websites or apps for specific team workflows. These sites can serve as launch trackers, dashboards, calculators, or onboarding pages, providing a centralized place for teams to access and interact with relevant information. Users describe their needs to Codex, which builds and deploys the site within the same workspace, including hosting, access controls, storage, and database support. The feature supports iterative development through user feedback and allows sharing with specific people or groups, with enterprise admins controlling availability. While sites cannot currently connect to live data directly, users can automate updates through separate workflows to keep information current.

items.title: OpenAI launches new role-specific Codex plugins and interactive sites to enhance productivity across analysts, marketers, designers, investors, and other professionals [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced new role-specific plugins, interactive websites, and annotations for Codex to support a wider range of professionals beyond developers, including analysts, marketers, designers, investors, and bankers. These tools aim to integrate Codex with existing workflows and popular apps, enabling users to create reports, dashboards, creative assets, sales materials, prototypes, and investment analyses more efficiently. The update includes six new plugins tailored to specific roles, covering data analytics, creative production, sales, product design, public equity investing, and investment banking, with plans for more plugins in areas like corporate finance and legal. Additionally, Codex now supports creating and sharing interactive websites and apps within workspaces, allowing teams to collaborate on dashboards, project boards, and review spaces via URL sharing.

items.title: OpenAI calls for global AI Safety Institute to enhance youth safety and opportunities at upcoming G7 Summit [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI is advocating for international collaboration to improve safety and opportunities for young people using AI technologies. The organization proposes establishing a dedicated global AI Safety Institute to develop safeguards, standards, and support systems tailored to youth. OpenAI plans to discuss this initiative at the G7 Leaders' Summit in Évian, France, emphasizing the need for sustained global coordination beyond single events. The proposed institute would facilitate ongoing cooperation among governments, researchers, civil society, and industry to share evidence, develop guidance, and raise safety standards for youth AI use worldwide. The institute would build on existing efforts like Common Sense Media's Youth AI Safety Institute and OpenAI's partnerships with educators and researchers, including studies on Estonia's national ChatGPT rollout in schools. OpenAI stresses that companies should implement age-appropriate protections, conduct regular youth safety risk assessments, and provide accessible parental controls and clear information about AI's benefits and risks for young users.

items.title: OpenAI says Codex is evolving into a productivity tool for knowledge workers beyond developers, with over 5 million weekly users and growing use in research, data analysis, and workflow automation [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI released a report showing that Codex, initially a coding tool, is now widely used by knowledge workers to automate routine tasks, accelerate work, and reduce friction across industries. The user base has grown more than sixfold since February 2026, with knowledge workers making up about 20 percent and growing rapidly. Knowledge workers use Codex for creating reports, spreadsheets, presentations, contracts, and increasingly for research, data analysis, and building lightweight tools without engineering support. Users often run multiple tasks in parallel, which may enable them to take on more ambitious projects and expand their roles. Codex helps coordinate work across systems and teams, improve deliverables, and streamline review and approval processes.

items.title: OpenAI outlines AI policy stance, denies political PAC involvement, and emphasizes transparency and independence from external political groups [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has detailed its approach to AI policy and political advocacy, emphasizing the importance of transparent communication about its values and policy positions. The company states it has not formed or funded any political action committees (PACs) or made donations to political campaigns, and that employee political activities are personal and separate from the company. The company also addressed questions about the political group Leading the Future (LTF), clarifying that involvement by its co-founder Greg Brockman and his wife is personal and not representative of OpenAI. OpenAI stresses that no external political group speaks for the company and advocates for thoughtful AI regulation, safety standards, public accountability, and broad access to AI benefits through direct and transparent engagement.

items.title: OpenAI breaks ground on 1GW Stargate data center in Michigan with community and labor partnerships [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has started construction on The Barn, a 1 gigawatt data center campus in Saline, Michigan, aiming to build AI infrastructure while supporting local communities and workers. The project includes commitments to protect local residents from infrastructure costs, safeguard water resources, and create thousands of union construction and permanent jobs. The initiative involves partnerships with Oracle, Related Digital, Walbridge, and local government, contributing $10 million to community improvements and projecting $1 billion in tax revenue over the lease term. OpenAI will also provide up to $45 million in Codex credits to over 400,000 Michigan students and collaborate with state agencies on AI literacy and workforce training programs to prepare residents for AI-related jobs. This project reflects Michigan's industrial heritage and aims to catalyze a new era of technology-driven economic growth rooted in skilled labor and community investment, aligning with broader state strategies for education and workforce development.

items.title: OpenAI frontier models and Codex become generally available on AWS, enabling enterprise AI deployment within existing AWS security and governance frameworks [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has made its frontier models and Codex generally available on Amazon Web Services (AWS), allowing enterprises to integrate these AI tools into their existing AWS environments with familiar security, compliance, and procurement workflows. This integration aims to reduce barriers to AI adoption by enabling faster transition from evaluation to production using AWS-native controls. The offering includes OpenAI models and Codex on Amazon Bedrock, supporting both commercial and GovCloud regions. Customers like Amgen and Autodesk are exploring these capabilities to enhance scientific research and design workflows within secure and governed AWS infrastructures. OpenAI and AWS plan to expand these capabilities further, including future releases like Daybreak, which focuses on cybersecurity applications to help organizations adopt advanced AI securely and efficiently.

items.title: Boston Children's Hospital integrates OpenAI's AI across clinical and operational workflows, diagnosing over 40 rare diseases and saving 60,000 staff hours [ ! ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: Boston Children's Hospital has embedded OpenAI's artificial intelligence technology into its clinical and administrative operations to improve pediatric care, particularly for complex and rare conditions. This integration has helped diagnose more than 40 previously unresolved rare diseases while reducing operational costs and saving approximately 60,000 staff hours. The hospital developed an enterprise AI layer that supports research, clinical decision-making, and administrative tasks, enabling rapid deployment of AI tools tailored to various roles. AI automations now manage supply chain processes, surgical scheduling, and clinical data synthesis, contributing to over $7 million in redeployed labor. This approach addresses both the cognitive limits of clinicians and the administrative burdens faced by staff, enhancing care delivery and operational efficiency.

items.title: Braintrust uses Codex with GPT-5.5 to convert customer feature requests into preview code branches within minutes, accelerating development and feedback [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Braintrust engineers have integrated Codex powered by GPT-5.5 into their workflow to rapidly transform customer feature requests into working code previews. This approach enables the team to create preview branches in minutes, allowing real-time iteration and faster feedback loops with customers. Within one month, half of Braintrust's engineering team adopted Codex, which founder and CEO Ankur Goyal credits with significantly speeding up coding and experimentation. The increased speed allows engineers to define problems, run autonomous tests in sandbox environments, and quickly move from ideas to solutions, enhancing their ability to solve customer problems efficiently.

items.title: OpenAI launches Rosalind Biodefense to provide trusted developers and U.S. government partners access to GPT-Rosalind for biodefense and pandemic preparedness [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced Rosalind Biodefense, a program granting vetted developers and select U.S. government collaborators access to GPT-Rosalind, its advanced AI model for life sciences research. The initiative aims to support biodefense, public health, and pandemic preparedness by enabling the development of AI-powered tools for early detection, epidemiological modeling, and medical countermeasures. This effort builds on OpenAI's ongoing work to deploy AI safely in biology, including layered safeguards and partnerships with public-sector organizations. Rosalind Biodefense sponsors access and launch support for trusted developers working on applications that strengthen societal resilience against biological threats, reflecting a broader strategy to equip defenders with advanced AI capabilities.

items.title: OpenAI releases shared playbook to standardize trustworthy third-party evaluations of frontier AI models [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has published guidance aimed at improving the reliability and validity of independent third-party evaluations for advanced AI systems. The playbook outlines best practices for assessing model capabilities, safeguards, and comparative performance, emphasizing the importance of evaluation setups and environments, or "harnesses," that reflect real-world use cases. The guidance categorizes evaluation claims into capability elicitation, safeguard performance, and controlled comparisons, and highlights common validity threats such as reward hacking, refusals, contamination, broken problems, and sandbagging. OpenAI stresses that selecting an appropriate harness is critical for accurate assessment, especially for models that operate over multiple steps or use tools, and recommends transparent reporting of evaluation design and evidence to support claims.

items.title: Endava uses Codex to build an agentic organization, scaling senior engineering expertise and reducing requirements analysis from weeks to hours [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Endava, a global software contracting firm, has adopted Codex technology to transform into an agentic organization that embeds senior engineering judgment into AI agents supporting the entire delivery lifecycle. This approach has significantly improved software quality and accelerated development timelines by enabling small teams to deliver high-value work rapidly. Codex acts as a guide for junior developers, codifying senior architects' expertise to enhance mentorship and decision-making in real time. Endava uses Codex across requirements analysis, design, development, and operations, compressing processes that once took weeks into hours, such as generating working specifications from complex legal documents. This integration has also improved client communication by enabling live creation of design documents and diagrams during sessions.

items.title: OpenAI publishes Frontier Governance Framework aligning AI safety and security practices with emerging EU and California regulations [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has released its Frontier Governance Framework to detail how its safety and security measures comply with new legal requirements such as California's Transparency in Frontier AI Act and the EU AI Act's Code of Practice for General Purpose AI. The framework builds on OpenAI's existing Preparedness Framework, focusing on risk assessment and mitigation in areas like cyber offense, harmful manipulation, and loss of control, while addressing model reporting, incident response, and external expert input. OpenAI plans to update the framework as AI capabilities and regulatory standards evolve.

items.title: Cisco integrates OpenAI's Codex into enterprise engineering workflows, accelerating AI-native development and defect remediation with 10-15x throughput gains [ ! ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: Cisco has partnered with OpenAI to embed Codex into its enterprise software engineering processes, making AI-native development central to building complex systems. This integration has enabled Cisco to accelerate AI Defense product development, reduce build times by about 20%, and save over 1,500 engineering hours monthly. Codex's capabilities include understanding large codebases, executing autonomous compile-test-fix loops, and operating within Cisco's security and governance frameworks. Cisco's use of Codex has compressed feature development timelines from quarters to weeks and increased defect resolution throughput by 10 to 15 times, demonstrating the tool's impact on large-scale, mission-critical software engineering.

items.title: OpenAI and Thrive develop self-improving Tax AI using Codex to automate and enhance accuracy of complex tax return preparation for Crete accounting firms [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI and Thrive Holdings collaborated to build Tax AI, a Codex-powered agent designed to automate and improve the preparation of complex tax returns for Crete's network of accounting firms. The system processes thousands of returns, reducing manual data entry time and increasing accuracy and throughput during tax season. Tax AI uses practitioner feedback, production data, and a Codex-driven iteration loop to self-improve continuously, achieving up to 97% accuracy and saving practitioners about a third of their preparation time. The system has expanded its capabilities from simpler forms to more complex filings, demonstrating measurable improvements in accuracy and efficiency over several months. This approach addresses challenges in tax preparation by making production failures visible and actionable without heavy engineering intervention, enabling faster product development and potentially serving as a model for other domains requiring expert practitioner input and complex data handling.

items.title: Warp uses GPT-5.5 to orchestrate AI coding agents across local, cloud, and open-source workflows, enabling 90% of internal pull requests to be agent-created [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Warp has integrated GPT-5.5 into its Open Agentic Development model to coordinate AI agents that plan, write, test, and review code across various environments. This approach reduces token usage by 30% per task compared to previous models and supports nearly one million developers, including over half of the Fortune 500. Warp's Oz platform manages these agents, allowing persistent, coordinated workflows with human supervision to improve software development efficiency and collaboration.

items.title: OpenAI outlines election safeguards for 2026 including reliable information access, cyber defense support, and AI content transparency enhancements [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI is preparing for the 2026 global elections by enhancing access to reliable voting information, supporting cybersecurity professionals defending election infrastructure, and increasing transparency around AI-generated content to protect electoral integrity. The company plans to provide live vote counts in the US and Brazil, partner with organizations to share accurate voting logistics, and improve ChatGPT's ability to surface trustworthy election-related information with source links. OpenAI is also advancing cybersecurity through its Daybreak initiative, offering tools like Codex Security to identify software vulnerabilities and providing verified access to frontier AI models for cyber defense to election system manufacturers and state authorities. To combat misinformation, OpenAI is implementing digital watermarking and metadata standards for AI-generated images, previewing public verification tools, and collaborating with social media platforms to use provenance markers as signals for civic content distribution.

items.title: OpenAI analysis finds 4 million Americans use ChatGPT as a first hire to support small business operations and reduce startup costs [ * ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: A new OpenAI report reveals that around four million people in the US used ChatGPT in March 2026 to help plan, start, run, or grow small businesses across various sectors including consulting, retail, home services, and hospitality. These entrepreneurs often rely on AI to perform multiple roles such as marketing, customer service, and legal tasks, which would otherwise require additional staff or consultants. The report highlights that prospective entrepreneurs use ChatGPT mainly for branding and product development, while active entrepreneurs focus on marketing, customer communication, and compliance. This usage pattern suggests AI lowers the fixed costs of entrepreneurship by enabling small business owners to manage diverse tasks without immediate hires, potentially increasing the viability and survival of modest businesses.

items.title: OpenAI partners with Brazilian media groups Folha de S.Paulo and UOL to integrate their journalism into ChatGPT with attribution and transparency [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has formed a strategic content partnership with Brazilian media companies Grupo Folha and Grupo UOL to bring their journalism to ChatGPT users worldwide. This collaboration aims to provide over 900 million weekly active users with access to high-quality, locally relevant news summaries that include proper attribution and links to original sources. The partnership marks OpenAI's first media collaboration in Brazil, a key market with more than 50 million monthly ChatGPT users. Grupo Folha and Grupo UOL will also gain access to OpenAI's Codex, ChatGPT Enterprise, and API tools to explore AI applications in journalism, develop new products, and improve internal workflows.

items.title: OpenAI named a Leader in Gartner's 2026 Magic Quadrant for Enterprise AI Coding Agents, recognized for Codex's enterprise-scale capabilities and governance features [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has been named a Leader in Gartner's 2026 Magic Quadrant for Enterprise AI Coding Agents, highlighting its Codex technology for supporting enterprise-scale software development. Codex is used by over 4 million people weekly and by companies such as Cisco, Datadog, Dell Technologies, and NVIDIA. Gartner praised Codex for its ability to execute and completeness of vision, noting its agentic software development features, enterprise governance, sandboxing, and flexible deployment options. Recent improvements include GPT-5.5 integration, enhanced tool use, faster performance, and expanded enterprise workflow support. OpenAI's Codex is positioned as a tool that helps enterprises accelerate development while maintaining security, auditability, and control.

items.title: Virgin Atlantic uses Codex to accelerate mobile app development with near-complete test coverage and zero critical defects for Christmas travel launch [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Virgin Atlantic employed Codex to speed up the development and deployment of its revamped mobile application, achieving nearly 100% unit test coverage and zero priority one defects at launch during the high-risk Christmas travel period. The airline also used Codex to dramatically reduce legacy codebase size by up to 80% and cut refactoring time from two weeks to under an hour. Beyond the mobile app, Codex enabled Virgin Atlantic's data and analyst teams to rapidly prototype internal applications directly on the company's data warehouse, improving development velocity across multiple departments. The company is now exploring how to scale Codex-driven software delivery across its entire development lifecycle as engineering speed begins to outpace other processes.

items.title: Google DeepMind launches AI accelerator program in Asia Pacific to address environmental risks [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind has launched a three-month accelerator program in the Asia Pacific region aimed at supporting startups, research teams, and nonprofits using AI to tackle environmental challenges such as climate change, agriculture, and energy. The program offers expert mentorship and integration support with Google AI models to help scale climate solutions. The initiative begins with an in-person bootcamp in Singapore and seeks to accelerate innovation in response to the region's rising environmental risks.

items.title: AdventHealth deploys ChatGPT for Healthcare to reduce administrative tasks and improve clinical workflows across nine states [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: AdventHealth is using ChatGPT for Healthcare to cut administrative time by 80%, enabling clinicians to spend more time on patient care and improving overall workflow efficiency. The hospital system operates across nine states and serves millions of patients annually, facing pressures from tight margins and growing demand. By automating documentation and support tasks, AdventHealth aims to expand clinical capacity and enhance the patient experience. The organization prioritized enterprise-grade AI tools with strong privacy and governance features, choosing OpenAI for its reliability and compliance support. Adoption is treated as a key metric, with peer-group-based training to encourage consistent and safe use across departments.

items.title: Ramp engineers use Codex with GPT-5.5 to accelerate code reviews and develop internal tools, reducing feedback time from hours to minutes [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Ramp engineers have integrated Codex powered by GPT-5.5 into their code review process, enabling them to receive detailed feedback on code changes within minutes rather than hours. This has improved development velocity and code quality by providing thorough, reasoning-based reviews that catch issues often missed by humans or other AI tools. Additionally, Ramp is using Codex to build an On-Call Assistant tool that manages complex on-call rotation tasks, speeding up development and increasing confidence in shipped improvements.

items.title: OpenAI model disproves Erdős's 80-year-old unit distance conjecture in discrete geometry with polynomial improvement [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: An OpenAI model has solved the longstanding planar unit distance problem posed by Paul Erdős in 1946, disproving the prevailing conjecture that square grid constructions were optimal for maximizing unit-distance pairs among points in the plane. The model produced an infinite family of counterexamples yielding a polynomial improvement, and the proof has been verified by external mathematicians. The breakthrough was achieved using a general-purpose reasoning model not specifically trained for mathematics or this problem, marking the first time AI has autonomously solved a prominent open problem in a mathematical subfield. The proof applies sophisticated algebraic number theory concepts to a classical geometric question, and leading mathematicians have praised the result as a milestone demonstrating AI's capability for original and deep mathematical reasoning.

items.title: OpenAI advances Education for Countries program with new partnerships, teacher training, and AI tools to improve learning outcomes globally [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI is expanding its Education for Countries initiative by partnering with governments and educators to integrate AI tools like ChatGPT Edu into classrooms worldwide. The program focuses on research-driven deployment, localized AI learning tools, and teacher training to support responsible AI adoption in education. The first cohort includes countries such as Estonia, Greece, Jordan, Kazakhstan, and Slovakia, where deployments have reached millions of students and educators. OpenAI collaborates with local institutions to measure AI's impact on learning and develop tailored tools, while investing in professional development to help teachers effectively use AI in their classrooms. Early results show positive effects on productivity and engagement, with initiatives like Jordan's AI Education Assistant and Kazakhstan's nationwide ChatGPT Edu training. OpenAI plans to continue sharing research findings and expanding the program to support personalized and proactive learning globally.

items.title: OpenAI launches multi-year partnership with Singapore government to support national AI strategy with S$300 million investment [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has announced a multi-year partnership with Singapore's Ministry of Digital Development and Information to advance the country's National AI strategy. The initiative includes establishing OpenAI's first Applied AI Lab outside the US, creating over 200 local technical roles, and focusing on AI deployment in public service, finance, healthcare, and digital infrastructure. The partnership aims to develop local AI talent through collaborations with educational institutions and government agencies, including training programs and AI-enabled learning tools. It also seeks to broaden AI adoption across Singapore's economy by supporting startups, small businesses, and workforce skill development, positioning Singapore as a global hub for AI innovation and deployment.

items.title: OpenAI advances content provenance with C2PA conformance, Google SynthID watermarking, and a public verification tool to enhance AI-generated media transparency [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced new measures to improve content provenance in AI-generated media, including adopting the C2PA open standard for metadata, integrating Google DeepMind's SynthID invisible watermarking for images, and launching a public tool to verify AI-generated content. These efforts aim to provide users with reliable signals about the origin and authenticity of AI-created images and audio, supporting a safer and more transparent AI ecosystem. The company has been involved in provenance standards since 2024 and recently became a C2PA Conforming Generator Product, enabling platforms to preserve and share provenance metadata. The multi-layered approach combines metadata and watermarking to ensure provenance information survives common content transformations like resizing or screenshots. The new public verification tool allows users to detect whether images were generated by OpenAI models such as ChatGPT, Codex, or the OpenAI API by checking for embedded provenance signals. These updates build on OpenAI's ongoing collaboration with industry partners to foster trust and transparency in AI-generated content, addressing challenges in verifying media authenticity as AI tools become more widespread.

items.title: Google DeepMind uses Co-Scientist AI to identify genetic factors that reverse cellular aging in human cells [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind has developed Co-Scientist, a multi-agent AI tool that accelerates research by identifying new genetic factors capable of reversing aging in human cells. This advancement could significantly impact the study of cellular rejuvenation and age-related biology.

items.title: OpenAI and Dell partner to integrate Codex into hybrid and on-premises enterprise environments for secure AI agent deployment [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI and Dell Technologies have partnered to enable enterprises to deploy OpenAI's Codex AI technology within hybrid and on-premises environments, including Dell's AI Data Platform and AI Factory. This collaboration aims to bring Codex closer to enterprise data, systems, and workflows to enhance software development and knowledge work while maintaining security and control. The partnership will allow Codex to connect with Dell's infrastructure used for storing and governing enterprise data, supporting use cases such as code review, test coverage, incident response, and broader AI-powered business workflows. Dell and OpenAI will also explore integrating Codex with Dell AI Factory to manage AI workloads and deploy AI applications within enterprise premises, providing a practical path for large organizations to scale AI agent deployment securely.

items.title: Google expands Project Genie with Street View integration for AI Ultra subscribers worldwide to simulate and explore real-world locations [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google has enhanced Project Genie, its AI-powered world model, by integrating Google Street View imagery to create interactive virtual environments grounded in real-world locations. This new feature allows users to explore or creatively reimagine places in the U.S. using various styles, such as underwater scenes or historical settings, and is now available to Google AI Ultra subscribers globally. Project Genie has been a key tool for AI research and simulation, including applications like Waymo's road environment modeling. The Street View grounding capability uses Maps Imagery Grounding technology to anchor generative AI worlds in actual geographic imagery, with plans to expand coverage beyond the U.S. over time. The feature remains experimental and is accessible through Google Labs as part of the AI Ultra subscription service.

items.title: Google launches Gemini Omni, a multimodal AI model that generates and edits videos from combined inputs including images, audio, and text [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Google has introduced Gemini Omni, a new AI model that can create and edit high-quality videos using multiple input types such as images, audio, video, and text. The model leverages Gemini's reasoning capabilities and real-world knowledge to produce realistic scenes with accurate physics and meaningful storytelling. The first model in the Omni family, Gemini Omni Flash, is being integrated into the Gemini app, Google Flow, and YouTube Shorts. Users can edit videos through natural language instructions, allowing for iterative refinements that maintain scene consistency and physics. Gemini Omni also supports complex visualizations and explainers, combining creativity with Gemini's extensive knowledge base to enhance video content creation.

items.title: Google DeepMind launches Antigravity 2.0, an updated technology platform with undisclosed new features
items.content_text: Google DeepMind has introduced Antigravity 2.0, an updated version of its technology designed to enhance user experience through innovative features. The company has not yet disclosed specific functionalities or applications of this new release.

items.title: Google launches Gemini for Science, AI tools and experiments to accelerate scientific research and discovery [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Google has introduced Gemini for Science, a suite of AI-powered tools designed to enhance the scale and precision of scientific research by accelerating core steps of the scientific method. The initiative includes experimental prototypes like Co-Scientist for hypothesis generation, AlphaEvolve and Empirical Research Assistance for computational discovery, and NotebookLM for literature insights, aiming to help researchers manage vast scientific knowledge and generate new hypotheses more efficiently. These tools are being gradually opened to public access through Google Labs, while enterprise versions are already in private preview with partners such as BASF, Klarna, Daiichi Sankyo, Bayer Crop Science, and U.S. National Labs. The project also includes Science Skills, integrating data from major life science databases to speed up complex workflows. Research papers on some of these tools have been published in Nature, highlighting their potential impact on scientific progress.

items.title: Google expands content transparency tools with SynthID watermarking and C2PA credentials across Search, Gemini, Chrome, Pixel, and Cloud [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Google is enhancing its tools to improve transparency about how online content is created and edited by expanding its SynthID digital watermarking and C2PA Content Credentials technologies across multiple products including Search, Gemini, Chrome, Pixel phones, and Cloud services. These tools help identify AI-generated or modified media and verify original content captured by cameras. SynthID has been integrated into Google's generative media models, watermarking over 100 billion images and videos and 60,000 years of audio, while Pixel phones now provide native Content Credentials for images and soon for video. Google is also launching an AI Content Detection API on its Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform to help businesses detect AI-generated content from various models. The company is collaborating with industry partners like OpenAI, Kakao, ElevenLabs, NVIDIA, and Meta to promote interoperable standards for content provenance and transparency, aiming to make it easier for users and platforms to verify the authenticity and history of digital media.

items.title: Google DeepMind partners with Singapore to advance AI applications in health, education, and sustainability [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind has formed a national partnership with Singapore to apply advanced artificial intelligence technologies to complex challenges in health, education, and sustainability. The collaboration aims to enhance Singapore's AI capabilities and foster innovative solutions to national issues.

items.title: Google DeepMind's Co-Scientist platform helps Clare Bryant identify genetic molecular switches in emerging infectious diseases [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Clare Bryant uses Google DeepMind's Co-Scientist multi-agent AI platform to identify genetic factors acting as molecular switches in new infectious diseases, aiming to improve understanding of their development and progression.

items.title: Calico Life Sciences adopts DeepMind's Co-Scientist AI platform to integrate aging research data and accelerate discovery of new insights [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Calico Life Sciences is using DeepMind's Co-Scientist, a multi-agent AI platform, to connect disparate research findings in aging and facilitate the generation of novel research leads. This approach aims to enhance understanding of aging processes by integrating scattered data and accelerating scientific discovery.

items.title: Google DeepMind uses Co-Scientist AI platform to accelerate discovery of liver disease mechanisms and treatment insights [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind employs its Co-Scientist multi-agent AI platform to speed up research into liver disease mechanisms. This approach helps identify new treatment options and explains why existing medications work only for certain patient groups.

items.title: Boston Children's Hospital and MIT collaborate using AI to develop RNA-based treatments for ALS
items.content_text: Researchers from Boston Children's Hospital and MIT are partnering to combine biological research tools and AI-driven methods to accelerate the development of RNA-based therapies for Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS). This collaboration aims to leverage multi-agent AI systems to enhance the pace and effectiveness of ALS research.

items.title: Stanford geneticist uses DeepMind's Co-Scientist AI to identify repurposed drugs for liver fibrosis treatment [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: A geneticist at Stanford University is leveraging DeepMind's Co-Scientist, a multi-agent AI platform, to accelerate the discovery of existing medicines that could be repurposed to treat chronic liver disease and liver fibrosis. This approach aims to speed up the development of effective therapies by utilizing AI-driven research assistance.

items.title: Google DeepMind's WeatherNext AI model helped the National Hurricane Center improve predictions of Hurricane Melissa's historic landfall in Jamaica [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind's WeatherNext AI model assisted the National Hurricane Center in enhancing the accuracy of forecasts for Hurricane Melissa's landfall in Jamaica, enabling forecasters to provide earlier warnings. This improved prediction capability aimed to give communities more time to prepare for the significant storm event.

items.title: OpenAI and Malta partner to provide free one-year ChatGPT Plus access to all citizens with AI literacy training [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI and the Government of Malta have launched a partnership to offer all Maltese citizens free access to ChatGPT Plus for one year, coupled with an AI literacy course developed by the University of Malta. The initiative aims to empower citizens with practical AI skills and promote responsible use of AI technologies. The program, part of Malta's AI for All initiative, will begin in May 2026 and is managed by the Malta Digital Innovation Authority. It targets residents and citizens both within Malta and abroad, providing education on AI's capabilities and limitations alongside access to advanced AI tools. This partnership is the first of its scale globally and reflects Malta's commitment to leading AI adoption through strategic national initiatives.

items.title: Google DeepMind launches Gemini 3.5 Flash model for agentic workflows and coding, offering faster performance and real-world applications across billions of users and enterprises [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini 3.5 Flash, a new AI model designed to execute complex, multi-step agentic workflows and coding tasks with frontier-level intelligence and speed. The model is available globally through the Gemini app, Google Search AI Mode, and developer platforms like Google Antigravity and Gemini API, targeting both individual users and enterprises. Gemini 3.5 Flash outperforms previous versions on coding and agentic benchmarks while being four times faster than other frontier models. It supports long-horizon tasks such as application development, code maintenance, and financial document preparation. Industry partners including Shopify, Macquarie Bank, Salesforce, Ramp, and Xero are already using the model to automate complex workflows, improve data analysis, and enhance customer onboarding processes. The model leverages the Antigravity harness to deploy collaborative subagents that can handle multi-step workflows reliably and at scale. Google DeepMind is also developing Gemini 3.5 Pro, which is currently in internal use and expected to launch soon, aiming to further advance agentic AI capabilities for real-world utility.

items.title: OpenAI launches personal finance feature in ChatGPT for US Pro users with secure account linking and AI-driven financial insights [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced a new personal finance experience in ChatGPT for Pro users in the U.S., allowing them to securely connect their financial accounts and receive AI-powered insights tailored to their financial context and goals. The feature supports over 12,000 financial institutions and is available on web, iOS, and Android platforms, starting with a preview to a smaller group to gather feedback and improve the service. Users can view a dashboard summarizing their portfolio performance, spending, subscriptions, and upcoming payments, and provide additional context such as savings goals or planned purchases. ChatGPT uses this information to offer personalized guidance and help users understand tradeoffs and plan financial decisions, though it is not a substitute for professional financial advice.

items.title: OpenAI details how business operations teams use Codex to generate decision-ready briefs and updates from scattered project data [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Business operations teams use OpenAI's Codex to consolidate diverse inputs like project trackers, KPI dashboards, meeting notes, and stakeholder feedback into initial drafts of initiative briefs, strategy updates, leadership decision packets, and progress reports. Codex helps produce executive-ready documents faster, allowing teams to focus on refining recommendations and making decisions. Codex processes various sources such as financial models, project status updates, and stakeholder discussions to identify changes, risks, options, and owners, creating clear summaries that separate confirmed facts from interpretations. This approach streamlines the preparation of off-track briefs, strategic health updates, and decision packets, improving communication and decision-making efficiency within business operations teams.

items.title: Databricks integrates GPT-5.5 into enterprise agent workflows after model achieves new state-of-the-art accuracy on OfficeQA Pro benchmark [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Databricks has incorporated the GPT-5.5 language model into its enterprise agent workflows following the model's achievement of over 50% accuracy on the OfficeQA Pro benchmark, a test for complex document tasks involving scanned PDFs and legacy files. GPT-5.5 reduced errors by 46% compared to its predecessor, GPT-5.4, particularly improving parsing and retrieval in multi-step workflows. The model is now available through Databricks' AI Unity Gateway, enabling customers to use GPT-5.5 within workflows built with AgentBricks and the Agent Supervisor API. This integration aims to enhance the reliability and efficiency of enterprise agents handling complex document processing and knowledge work.

items.title: Sea Limited rolls out Codex AI coding assistant across engineering teams to accelerate AI-native software development in Southeast Asia [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: Sea Limited, a Singapore-based global tech company, is deploying Codex, an AI-powered coding assistant, across its developer organization to enhance productivity and manage complex software systems. The company reports that 87% of its developers use Codex weekly, leveraging its deep contextual understanding to navigate large codebases and improve debugging and feature development. David Chen, Sea's Co-Founder and Chief Product Officer, highlighted that Codex enables engineers to focus on higher-level tasks like architectural design and innovation by reducing cognitive load. Sea views AI-assisted development as a structural shift that increases speed, responsiveness, and engineering discipline, with AI agents integrated into continuous integration and deployment pipelines to propose implementations and identify edge cases. Sea anticipates that Southeast Asia's complex, multilingual markets will drive AI-native software development innovation, transforming software teams as AI agents take on operational tasks and developers evolve into system orchestrators focused on product strategy and design.

items.title: OpenAI adds Codex support to ChatGPT mobile app for real-time coding task monitoring and approvals from any device [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has integrated Codex into the ChatGPT mobile app, enabling users to monitor, guide, and approve coding tasks remotely across laptops, devboxes, or managed environments. This update allows seamless collaboration on active threads, approvals, and project context from anywhere, with real-time updates including screenshots, terminal output, and test results. The mobile app connects securely to machines running Codex via a relay layer that maintains session state and context without exposing devices to the public internet. Users can start, review, and steer long-running coding tasks on the go, facilitating timely decisions and continuous progress without being tied to a single machine.

items.title: OpenAI updates ChatGPT to better recognize evolving context in sensitive conversations, improving safety responses to potential risks [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced safety updates to ChatGPT that enhance its ability to recognize subtle and evolving cues of risk during sensitive conversations. These improvements help the system distinguish between routine interactions and rare cases requiring caution, enabling it to respond more safely by de-escalating, refusing harmful content, or directing users to support resources. The updates focus on acute scenarios such as suicide, self-harm, and harm to others, incorporating safety summaries that capture relevant context across conversations for a limited time. Developed with input from mental health experts, these changes aim to improve ChatGPT's recognition of warning signs emerging over time and inform safer, more appropriate responses in high-risk situations.

items.title: OpenAI builds custom sandbox for Codex on Windows to balance safety and functionality amid OS limitations [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI developed a secure sandbox environment to enable Codex on Windows, addressing the lack of native OS features for safe code execution. This sandbox restricts file writes to the user's workspace and limits network access, allowing Codex to operate with user-level permissions while maintaining safety. Existing Windows isolation tools like AppContainer, Windows Sandbox, and Mandatory Integrity Control were evaluated but found unsuitable due to compatibility, scope, or usability issues. OpenAI's custom solution enforces constraints at the OS level to provide a safer and more efficient developer experience with Codex on Windows devices.

items.title: OpenAI responds to TanStack npm supply chain attack by rotating macOS app certificates and requiring updates by June 26, 2026
items.content_text: OpenAI disclosed a supply chain attack involving the TanStack npm library that affected two employee devices and limited internal source code repositories. The company found no evidence of customer data compromise or unauthorized software changes but took immediate action to contain the breach and protect its systems. As part of its response, OpenAI is rotating code-signing certificates for its macOS applications, requiring users to update their apps by June 26, 2026, to maintain security. The company coordinated with Apple to block new notarizations using the previous certificate and confirmed no malicious software was signed with OpenAI certificates. OpenAI also accelerated deployment of security controls to mitigate future supply chain risks.

items.title: OpenAI Blog: Finance teams use Codex to automate monthly business reviews, model cleanup, and financial planning workflows [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Finance teams are using OpenAI's Codex to streamline financial reporting and analysis by automating the creation of monthly business review narratives, variance analyses, and model checks. Codex processes existing financial workbooks, dashboards, forecasts, and notes to generate review-ready documents and cleaned models without requiring coding skills. Codex helps identify key variances, risks, and CFO preparation questions, while also performing safe cleanup of financial models and flagging assumptions needing review. The tool integrates with common platforms like Google Drive, SharePoint, and Microsoft Office to accelerate the preparation of financial reports and planning scenarios, allowing teams to focus more on analysis and decision-making.

items.title: Google DeepMind launches Co-Scientist, a multi-agent AI system to accelerate biomedical research and identify drug repurposing candidates for liver fibrosis
items.content_text: Google DeepMind introduced Co-Scientist, a multi-agent AI partner built with Gemini technology to assist researchers in accelerating scientific discoveries. The system helped identify overlooked drug-repurposing candidates that blocked 91% of a scarring-linked response in lab tests for liver fibrosis, with results published in Advanced Science. Researchers say Co-Scientist acts like a collaborator with extensive biomedical knowledge and reasoning capabilities, uncovering connections that were previously missed.

items.title: OpenAI reports on Parameter Golf challenge with 1,000+ participants and 2,000+ AI-assisted machine learning submissions under strict constraints [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI's Parameter Golf challenge engaged over 1,000 participants who submitted more than 2,000 entries focused on minimizing loss on a fixed dataset within tight limits on model size and training time. The event highlighted the use of AI coding agents, which lowered experimentation costs and accelerated participation while introducing new challenges for submission review and scoring. The challenge featured a record track emphasizing performance and a nonrecord track encouraging experimental approaches, with notable submissions involving optimizer tuning, quantization, and novel modeling ideas. OpenAI found the competition valuable for discovering talent and exploring how AI tools reshape machine learning research workflows.

items.title: NVIDIA engineers use Codex with GPT-5.5 to accelerate production system development and automate machine learning research workflows [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: NVIDIA engineers and researchers have adopted Codex, powered by GPT-5.5, as their primary tool for complex engineering tasks and end-to-end machine learning experiments, achieving a tenfold speed improvement in research workflows. Codex runs on NVIDIA's GB200 and GB300 infrastructure, enabling longer autonomous sessions that identify bugs and suggest improvements beyond initial prompts. The coding agents team at NVIDIA has leveraged Codex to evolve internal platforms into production-ready systems and rapidly build applications like a podcast recording app, significantly reducing development time. Researchers use Codex to automate the research loop, from hypothesis generation to script writing and remote experiment execution, with capabilities such as translating Python codebases into more efficient Rust implementations. NVIDIA views Codex as a transformative tool that accelerates the transition from concept to execution and testing, with ongoing exploration of its potential to further enhance engineering and research productivity.

items.title: AutoScout24 integrates Codex and ChatGPT to accelerate development and improve code quality across 2,000 employees [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: AutoScout24 Group, a leading online car marketplace in Europe and Canada, has adopted AI-powered tools including Codex and ChatGPT to speed up software development and enhance code quality. The company enabled around 2,000 employees with AI tools, reducing development cycles from weeks to days and expanding AI adoption across engineering and non-technical roles. The rollout involved embedding Codex into engineering workflows for about 1,000 builder employees and providing ChatGPT access organization-wide. A cross-functional AI Champions network supported adoption by translating AI capabilities into practical use cases. Key benefits included faster iteration, automated code reviews, reduced manual workload, and increased innovation capacity. AutoScout24 plans to deepen AI integration into core systems to further improve automation and user experiences.

items.title: OpenAI reports broader ChatGPT adoption in Q1 2026 with increased use among users over 35 and growth in Latin America, Asia-Pacific, and Africa [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: In the first quarter of 2026, ChatGPT usage expanded beyond early adopters to include a wider age range, particularly users over 35, and a more balanced gender distribution. The platform also saw increased adoption in countries outside established markets, including several in Latin America, Asia-Pacific, and Africa. Work-related use on consumer accounts evolved with a shift toward specialized tasks such as content creation, health documentation, and information retrieval, while overall workplace use became more consistent. These trends indicate that ChatGPT is becoming a more mainstream tool used by a broader mix of people across more regions for recurring tasks.

items.title: OpenAI launches Campus Network to connect student AI clubs globally with tools and event support [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced the OpenAI Campus Network, a platform aimed at connecting student clubs worldwide to foster AI learning and collaboration on campuses. The network offers access to AI tools, supports student-led events and workshops, and provides early access to programs and opportunities. It seeks to engage student leaders involved in AI projects and communities to help shape the future of learning and work.

items.title: OpenAI Blog: European enterprises scale AI by building trust, governance, and workflow integration for sustained impact [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: European enterprise leaders interviewed by OpenAI emphasize that scaling AI successfully involves more than rapid deployment; it requires cultivating trust, establishing governance early, redesigning workflows, and maintaining quality standards. These organizations prioritize culture, ownership, and hybrid workflows that enhance expert judgment rather than just throughput. The insights highlight five recurring patterns: focusing on culture before tooling, involving security and compliance teams early to enable faster progress, empowering teams to build with AI, defining quality metrics before scaling, and protecting expert decision-making through hybrid workflows. This approach moves enterprises beyond individual productivity gains toward embedding AI responsibly in end-to-end processes with human oversight.

items.title: OpenAI launches OpenAI Deployment Company with $4 billion investment to help enterprises integrate AI systems, acquiring Tomoro and partnering with global firms [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has launched the OpenAI Deployment Company to assist organizations in building and deploying AI systems for critical business operations. The company will embed Forward Deployed Engineers into client teams to redesign workflows and create durable AI-driven systems that deliver measurable results. The launch includes OpenAI's acquisition of Tomoro, bringing 150 experienced engineers to the new company from day one. Backed by over $4 billion in initial investment and partnerships with leading global investment firms and consultancies, the Deployment Company aims to accelerate AI adoption and integration across industries while maintaining close ties to OpenAI's research and product teams.

items.title: OpenAI details security controls for safely running Codex coding agents with sandboxing, approval workflows, network policies, and telemetry [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI explains how it governs Codex coding agents to ensure safe deployment in real workflows by enforcing technical boundaries, approval processes, and telemetry for auditing. Codex operates within sandboxes that restrict write and network access, with user approvals required for higher-risk actions outside these boundaries. Network policies limit outbound connections to approved domains, and authentication is managed through secure OS keyrings and ChatGPT enterprise workspace integration. These measures aim to balance developer productivity with security and compliance by allowing low-risk actions to proceed smoothly while requiring review for potentially dangerous commands.

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5-Cyber with Trusted Access for Cyber to support verified defenders in critical infrastructure security [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5-Cyber as part of its Trusted Access for Cyber initiative, aiming to enhance cybersecurity by providing verified professionals with advanced AI tools for vulnerability research and defense.
