These models offer varying levels of access and safeguards tailored to different defensive workflows, from general security tasks to specialized penetration testing. Trusted Access for Cyber is an identity-based framework that ensures enhanced AI capabilities are available only to authorized users, with strict controls to prevent misuse such as credential theft or malware deployment. Starting June 1, 2026, users with the highest access levels must enable advanced account security measures, reflecting OpenAI's focus on proportional safeguards while empowering defenders to protect critical infrastructure and the broader cyber ecosystem.

items.title: Parloa launches AI Agent Management Platform using OpenAI models to build scalable, voice-driven customer service agents for enterprises [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Parloa has developed an AI Agent Management Platform (AMP) that uses OpenAI models, including GPT-5.4, to design, simulate, and deploy voice-driven customer service agents at scale. The platform enables non-technical business users to configure agent behavior in natural language, test interactions through simulations, and manage the entire AI agent lifecycle without coding. AMP handles complex, multi-step customer requests with a focus on reliability and real-time performance, continuously testing models against real scenarios before deployment. Parloa's modular approach separates tasks into sub-agents and incorporates deterministic controls to balance conversational flexibility with predictable execution, aiming to deliver consistent and effective customer service experiences for large enterprises.

items.title: OpenAI launches new real-time voice models in API with GPT-5-class reasoning, live translation, and streaming transcription capabilities [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced three new real-time voice models in its API designed to enhance voice intelligence by enabling reasoning, translation, and transcription during live conversations. These models include GPT-Realtime-2 for advanced reasoning, GPT-Realtime-Translate for live speech translation across 70+ languages, and GPT-Realtime-Whisper for streaming speech-to-text transcription. The new models support more natural and intelligent voice interactions by allowing developers to build applications that can understand context, handle interruptions, call multiple tools simultaneously, and respond appropriately in real time. Use cases include voice assistants that can plan events, provide live translations, and offer proactive spoken guidance, aiming to make voice a more effective interface for software tasks.

items.title: OpenAI tests ads in ChatGPT for free and Go users in multiple countries, ensuring ads do not influence answers and include privacy controls [ * ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has begun testing advertisements within ChatGPT for logged-in adult users on the Free and Go subscription tiers in the U.S. and plans to expand to other countries including the UK, Mexico, Brazil, Japan, and South Korea. Ads are clearly labeled, do not affect the AI's responses, and are designed with privacy protections that prevent advertisers from accessing personal chat data. The pilot aims to support broader access to ChatGPT by funding free and low-cost tiers while maintaining user trust and control. Users can dismiss ads, provide feedback, and manage ad personalization, with ads excluded from sensitive topics and accounts of users under 18. OpenAI plans to expand the program thoughtfully, learning from real-world usage and adjusting safeguards to protect privacy and prevent misleading ads.

items.title: OpenAI launches Trusted Contact feature in ChatGPT to notify designated individuals of serious self-harm concerns [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced Trusted Contact, an optional safety feature in ChatGPT that allows users to designate a trusted adult who may be notified if automated systems and trained reviewers detect serious self-harm concerns in conversations. This feature aims to provide an additional layer of support alongside existing crisis helplines by encouraging connection with someone the user trusts during moments of distress. Users can add one trusted contact who must accept the role before activation. If a serious safety concern is detected, ChatGPT informs the user and may notify the trusted contact with a limited message that protects user privacy. The feature was developed with input from clinicians and mental health experts and includes human review of notifications to ensure accuracy and timely response.

items.title: Simplex adopts ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to reduce software development time by up to 70%, scaling AI-driven workflows across projects [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Simplex is integrating ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex into its software development process to improve productivity and reduce time spent on design, coding, and testing phases. The company reports up to 70% less time needed to develop each screen and is advancing AI-native delivery across multiple projects. The company uses Codex not only for code generation but also for design interpretation, test code creation, and issue remediation, enabling smaller teams to work more efficiently and allowing senior experts to focus on final decisions and quality accountability. Simplex emphasizes validating AI impact quantitatively and treating AI adoption as an operating model with governance and training to scale AI-driven development safely and effectively.

items.title: Google DeepMind's AlphaEvolve uses Gemini-powered coding agent to reduce DNA sequencing errors by 30%, aiding genomic research at PacBio [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind's AlphaEvolve has applied a Gemini-powered coding agent to improve DeepConsensus, a DNA sequencing error correction model developed by Google Research, achieving a 30% reduction in variant detection errors. This enhancement is enabling scientists at PacBio to analyze genetic data more accurately and cost-effectively, potentially uncovering previously hidden disease-causing mutations. Aaron Wenger, Senior Director at PacBio, highlighted that the improved accuracy rates from AlphaEvolve's solution could significantly advance genomic research and disease discovery.

items.title: OpenAI explains how ChatGPT trains on diverse data while applying privacy filters and offering user controls to limit data use [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI details how ChatGPT learns from a mix of publicly available information, partnerships, and user interactions while employing advanced privacy filters to minimize personal data exposure during training. Users can control whether their conversations contribute to model improvements through settings and temporary chat options. The company uses an internal Privacy Filter to mask personal information in datasets and user conversations when enabled, and it offers this tool to other developers. ChatGPT also includes features like Memory, which users can manage or disable to control data retention, and provides mechanisms for users to export data or submit privacy requests. OpenAI emphasizes its responsibility to protect user privacy as ChatGPT is used for increasingly personal tasks, balancing privacy safeguards with the need to address potential harms. Users are advised not to share sensitive information they do not want processed or reviewed.

items.title: OpenAI B2B Signals shows frontier firms use 3.5x more AI intelligence per worker with advanced Codex agentic workflows driving competitive advantage [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI's B2B Signals research reveals that frontier firms at the 95th percentile of AI usage now employ 3.5 times more AI intelligence per worker than typical firms, up from 2 times a year ago. This advantage stems mainly from deeper, more complex AI use rather than just higher message volume, with frontier firms sending 16 times as many Codex messages per worker, indicating greater adoption of agentic workflows. The report highlights that leading companies are moving beyond basic AI access to embed AI deeply into workflows, delegating complex tasks to AI agents and scaling production use cases across industries. Examples like Cisco demonstrate significant productivity gains by integrating Codex into engineering workflows, reducing build times and increasing defect resolution throughput. This trend suggests that firms investing in governance, enablement, and advanced AI tools are pulling ahead in sustainable competitive advantage.

items.title: Singular Bank launches Singularity assistant using ChatGPT and Codex to save bankers 60-90 minutes daily by streamlining portfolio analysis and client communications [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Singular Bank, a private bank in Madrid, developed Singularity, an internal assistant powered by ChatGPT and Codex, to help bankers analyze portfolios in real time, prepare for meetings, and generate compliant follow-up communications. This tool reduces meeting preparation time from about 20 minutes to under one minute, enabling bankers to focus more on advising clients and building relationships. Singularity integrates with the bank's core systems to flag portfolio risks, recommend actions, and automate routine tasks such as call reports and client communications. Bankers have executed over 3,500 operations in a 30-day period using the system, which improves traceability and regulatory reporting while maintaining compliance. The assistant enhances bankers' expertise by allowing faster, more consistent, and precise client interactions without replacing human judgment.

items.title: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT Futures Class of 2026, awarding 26 student innovators $10,000 grants to advance AI projects across over 20 universities [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has launched the inaugural ChatGPT Futures Class of 2026, recognizing 26 students who have used AI tools like ChatGPT to build projects, conduct research, and create impact during their college years. These students represent more than 20 universities and will receive grants and access to OpenAI's frontier models to continue their work. The program highlights how this generation, the first to start and finish college with ChatGPT, is leveraging AI to accelerate learning, creativity, and problem-solving without waiting for traditional barriers like funding or expertise to be removed. OpenAI emphasizes the importance of education in fostering AI agency and adaptability among students to prepare them for a rapidly evolving technological landscape.

items.title: Uber integrates OpenAI models to power AI assistants and voice features that help drivers optimize earnings and enable faster ride bookings across its global marketplace [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Uber has incorporated OpenAI's large language models to enhance its platform with AI-powered assistants and voice capabilities aimed at helping drivers make smarter earning decisions and riders book rides more quickly. This integration supports Uber's complex real-time marketplace, which operates across 15,000 cities and over 70 countries with millions of daily trips and drivers. The AI assistants provide drivers with real-time insights and personalized guidance by analyzing marketplace data such as earnings trends and demand heatmaps, reducing the cognitive load of decision-making. Uber's multi-agent AI system routes queries to specialized models to ensure accuracy, safety, and low latency, while an internal governance layer monitors responses to maintain trust and policy compliance. This technology benefits both new and experienced drivers by accelerating onboarding and optimizing platform engagement.

items.title: OpenAI updates ChatGPT default to GPT-5.5 Instant with improved accuracy, fewer hallucinations, and enhanced personalization [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has released GPT-5.5 Instant as the new default model for ChatGPT, offering smarter, clearer, and more personalized responses. The update reduces hallucinated claims by over 50% on high-stakes topics and improves factual accuracy, especially in medicine, law, and finance. GPT-5.5 Instant also enhances performance on image analysis, STEM questions, and web search integration. Personalization features are rolling out to ChatGPT Go and Free tiers, with Free tier responses drawing from a limited set of past chats to tailor interactions more effectively.

items.title: OpenAI and partners launch Multipath Reliable Connection protocol to improve resilience and performance in large-scale AI training networks [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced Multipath Reliable Connection (MRC), a new networking protocol developed with AMD, Broadcom, Intel, Microsoft, and NVIDIA to enhance data transfer speed and reliability in large AI training clusters. MRC is designed to reduce network congestion and quickly route around failures, improving the efficiency of supercomputer networks used for training frontier AI models. The protocol extends existing standards and is deployed across OpenAI's largest NVIDIA GB200 supercomputers, including those hosted with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Microsoft.

items.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.5 Instant System Card with enhanced safety measures and high capability classification in cybersecurity and biological preparedness [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced the GPT-5.5 Instant System Card, detailing its latest Instant model, GPT-5.5 Instant, which features enhanced safety mitigations and is classified as high capability in cybersecurity and biological and chemical preparedness. This update distinguishes GPT-5.5 Instant from previous models by implementing appropriate safeguards for these critical categories. The release clarifies naming conventions to avoid confusion with other GPT-5.5 models and continues OpenAI's focus on safety and research in AI development.

items.title: OpenAI launches beta self-serve Ads Manager and CPC bidding for ChatGPT ads with enhanced measurement tools and privacy protections [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced new features for purchasing ChatGPT advertisements, including a beta self-serve Ads Manager that allows businesses to create and manage campaigns directly. The update also adds cost-per-click (CPC) bidding alongside existing cost-per-mille (CPM) options and improved measurement tools designed to protect user privacy by keeping conversations separate from advertising data. The company has expanded access to ChatGPT ads through partnerships with major agencies and technology providers, enabling advertisers to use familiar tools while OpenAI controls ad delivery. The new Ads Manager aims to support businesses of all sizes by simplifying campaign setup, budgeting, bidding, and performance tracking. OpenAI plans to continue evolving the ad platform with new formats and capabilities while maintaining principles that keep ChatGPT answers independent and user experiences private.

items.title: OpenAI launches European Youth Safety Blueprint and awards €500,000 in EMEA Youth & Wellbeing Grants to support safe AI use among young people [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced the European Youth Safety Blueprint and announced recipients of its EMEA Youth & Wellbeing Grants to promote safe and responsible AI use among teenagers, families, and educators across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The Blueprint outlines five pillars for policymakers to enhance youth protections while maintaining access to AI tools that support learning and creativity. The €500,000 grant program supports 12 organizations working on practical projects and research related to youth safety, mental health, AI literacy, and age assurance. These initiatives aim to define safe AI practices in real-world settings and provide resources for vulnerable communities, educators, and parents. OpenAI's efforts build on its global youth safety principles and collaborations with governments and institutions to deploy AI responsibly in education and wellbeing.

items.title: OpenAI and PwC collaborate to build AI agents for automating CFO workflows and enhancing financial decision-making [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI and PwC have partnered to develop AI agents aimed at transforming the office of the CFO by automating finance workflows, improving forecasting accuracy, reinforcing financial controls, and supporting better decision-making with governance and human oversight. The collaboration focuses on real-world applications across core finance functions such as planning, reporting, procurement, payments, treasury, tax, and accounting close. OpenAI's finance team serves as the initial user, applying AI tools like ChatGPT and Codex to increase efficiency, including processing contracts and managing investor relations. PwC contributes expertise in finance transformation and controls to help scale these AI-driven workflows from prototype to production in enterprise environments, enabling CFOs to govern AI adoption alongside other operating costs.

items.title: OpenAI rearchitects WebRTC infrastructure to deliver low-latency voice AI for over 900 million weekly users globally [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has redesigned its WebRTC stack to support real-time voice AI applications with low latency, fast connection setup, and stable media round-trip times, enabling natural conversational interactions at scale. This new architecture addresses challenges related to media termination, session state management, and global routing to reduce latency and improve user experience. The overhaul leverages WebRTC's standardized protocols for encrypted, low-latency audio streaming, allowing AI models to process speech while users are still talking. OpenAI's approach departs from traditional selective forwarding units by optimizing for one-to-one sessions, which are common in voice AI use cases, ensuring crisp turn-taking and global reach across its infrastructure.

items.title: Google DeepMind develops AI co-clinician to support healthcare professionals and enhance clinical decision-making [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind is developing an AI co-clinician designed to assist healthcare professionals by augmenting clinical decision-making and improving patient outcomes. This initiative aims to establish a new model of AI-augmented care that integrates reliable AI tools into healthcare workflows.

items.title: OpenAI launches Advanced Account Security with phishing-resistant login and enhanced recovery for ChatGPT and Codex accounts [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced Advanced Account Security, an opt-in feature for ChatGPT and Codex users that provides stronger protections against unauthorized access through phishing-resistant sign-in methods, stricter account recovery options, and improved session management. This feature targets users at higher risk of digital attacks, such as journalists and political dissidents, by requiring passkeys or physical security keys and disabling password and SMS/email recovery methods. The new security measures include shorter session durations, login alerts, and automatic exclusion of conversations from model training for users handling sensitive information. OpenAI has partnered with Yubico to offer discounted hardware security keys and will require members of its Trusted Access for Cyber program to enable Advanced Account Security starting June 1, 2026, or demonstrate equivalent protections through single sign-on workflows.

items.title: OpenAI traces rise of 'goblin' metaphors in GPT-5 models to Nerdy personality training incentives [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI investigated an unusual increase in references to goblins and similar creatures in GPT-5 model outputs, identifying the cause as high rewards given during training for the Nerdy personality customization feature. This incentive unintentionally encouraged the use of creature metaphors, which then spread beyond the Nerdy personality to other model outputs through reinforcement learning and fine-tuning processes. The phenomenon first appeared after the GPT-5.1 launch and became more pronounced in GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.5, with goblin mentions rising significantly in user interactions. Analysis showed that although the Nerdy personality accounted for a small fraction of responses, it was responsible for the majority of goblin references, indicating a transfer of this stylistic quirk to other contexts. OpenAI's findings highlight how subtle training incentives can lead to unexpected and widespread changes in AI behavior.

items.title: OpenAI expands Stargate compute infrastructure, surpassing 10GW AI capacity goal ahead of 2029 deadline to meet accelerating AI demand [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI is rapidly expanding its Stargate compute infrastructure to support growing demand for artificial intelligence, having already exceeded its goal of securing 10GW of AI capacity in the U.S. ahead of the 2029 target. This expansion aims to provide the necessary compute power for developing artificial general intelligence and delivering AI benefits broadly. The company is working with a broad ecosystem of partners including cloud providers, chipmakers, energy suppliers, and local communities to build data centers efficiently and responsibly. OpenAI emphasizes community engagement, workforce development, and sustainable resource use, exemplified by its Abilene, Texas site which uses closed-loop water cooling and supports local education and job training programs. Looking beyond the initial capacity goal, OpenAI and its partners are evaluating new data center locations across the U.S. to continue scaling infrastructure in response to accelerating AI adoption across consumers, businesses, developers, and governments.

items.title: OpenAI publishes five-part action plan to democratize AI-powered cyber defense and protect critical infrastructure in the Intelligence Age [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has released a comprehensive action plan focused on enhancing cybersecurity amid evolving AI threats. The plan includes five pillars: democratizing cyber defense, coordinating government and industry efforts, securing frontier cyber capabilities, maintaining deployment control, and empowering users to protect themselves. The initiative responds to the increasing use of AI by both defenders and malicious actors, aiming to build resilience through broader access to defensive tools and collaboration across democratic institutions. OpenAI developed the plan after consulting cybersecurity and national security experts from government and commercial sectors.

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-5.5, Codex, and Managed Agents on AWS Bedrock in limited preview to enable enterprise AI development within AWS environments [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI and Amazon Web Services have expanded their partnership to offer OpenAI's latest models, including GPT-5.5, Codex coding tools, and Amazon Bedrock Managed Agents within AWS. These capabilities allow enterprises to build AI applications securely using their existing AWS infrastructure, security protocols, and compliance workflows. The integration enables developers to create AI-powered applications, automate complex workflows, and embed intelligence into products while benefiting from AWS's enterprise-grade security, billing, and high availability. Codex on AWS supports software development and document-based workflows, and Managed Agents facilitate multi-step, context-aware automation aligned with AWS operational standards. These offerings are currently available in limited preview through Amazon Bedrock.

items.title: OpenAI details ChatGPT safety measures including model safeguards, misuse detection, policy enforcement, and expert collaboration to prevent violence and harm [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has outlined its comprehensive approach to community safety in ChatGPT, focusing on training models to recognize and refuse requests that could enable violence while allowing factual discussions. The company employs automated systems and human reviewers to detect and respond to potential misuse, enforcing strict usage policies to prevent harm. The safety measures include ongoing refinement of model responses to subtle risk signs, support for users in distress with crisis resources, and collaboration with experts in psychology, civil liberties, and law enforcement. OpenAI emphasizes balancing helpfulness and user freedom with minimizing harm, continuously improving safeguards based on expert input and real-world feedback.

items.title: OpenAI achieves FedRAMP Moderate authorization for ChatGPT Enterprise and API Platform, enabling secure AI use by U.S. federal agencies [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has obtained FedRAMP Moderate authorization for its ChatGPT Enterprise and API Platform, allowing U.S. government agencies to adopt these AI services with the required security, privacy, and governance standards. This authorization supports a range of federal use cases including research, communication drafting, public health analysis, and software development. The FedRAMP 20x process facilitated a faster, cloud-native security validation, enabling OpenAI to meet federal requirements without compromising speed. Agencies can now access advanced models like GPT-5.5 within a trusted environment and evaluate OpenAI's offerings through reusable authorization data in the FedRAMP Marketplace. OpenAI continues to collaborate with government customers to expand features and maintain compliance for public sector missions.

items.title: Google DeepMind announces partnership with the Republic of Korea to accelerate scientific breakthroughs using advanced AI models [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind has partnered with the Republic of Korea to advance scientific research through the application of cutting-edge artificial intelligence technologies. The collaboration aims to leverage frontier AI models to drive innovation and accelerate progress in various scientific fields.

items.title: OpenAI and Microsoft amend partnership to simplify collaboration, clarify cloud product distribution, and adjust licensing and revenue terms through 2032 [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI and Microsoft announced an amended agreement to streamline their partnership, providing long-term clarity and flexibility while maintaining Microsoft as OpenAI's primary cloud provider and major shareholder. The update includes non-exclusive licensing of OpenAI's intellectual property to Microsoft through 2032, removal of Microsoft's revenue share payments to OpenAI, and continuation of OpenAI's revenue share payments to Microsoft through 2030 with a cap. The agreement allows OpenAI to serve products across any cloud provider if Microsoft cannot support necessary capabilities, and emphasizes ongoing collaboration on scaling data center capacity, next-generation silicon, and AI applications in cybersecurity. This amendment aims to strengthen their joint ability to build and operate AI platforms at scale while enabling both companies to pursue new opportunities.

items.title: OpenAI releases Symphony, an open-source specification for Codex orchestration that turns issue trackers into continuous agent systems to reduce developer context switching [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced Symphony, an open-source specification designed to orchestrate Codex agents by transforming project management boards like Linear into control planes where each open task is assigned a continuously running agent. This system aims to improve engineering productivity by minimizing the cognitive load and context switching associated with managing multiple interactive coding sessions. Symphony maps each issue to a dedicated agent workspace and continuously monitors task status to ensure agents work on unblocked tasks, restarting stalled agents and allowing agents to create new tasks as needed. This approach decouples work from individual coding sessions and pull requests, enabling more efficient parallel execution of complex workflows such as feature development and infrastructure migrations. OpenAI reports that using Symphony has led to a 500% increase in landed pull requests on some teams.

items.title: Choco automates food distribution with AI agents using OpenAI APIs, processing over 8.8 million orders annually and doubling sales team productivity [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Choco has integrated OpenAI APIs to automate its food distribution platform, enabling the processing of more than 8.8 million orders annually and reducing manual order entry by up to 50%. The AI-powered system handles multimodal inputs such as emails, texts, images, and voice, converting them into structured orders and supporting 24/7 operations across global supply chains. The platform serves over 21,000 distributors and 100,000 buyers across multiple regions, including the US, UK, Europe, and the GCC. By embedding AI agents like OrderAgent and VoiceAgent, Choco has streamlined workflows, improved accuracy with configurable automation thresholds, and increased sales team productivity without adding headcount. The company continues to expand AI capabilities to further automate complex operational tasks in food distribution.

items.title: Sam Altman outlines OpenAI's five principles to guide AGI development for broad societal benefit [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Sam Altman details five guiding principles that shape OpenAI's mission to develop artificial general intelligence (AGI) in a way that benefits all humanity. These principles emphasize democratization, empowerment, universal prosperity, resilience, and safety to ensure AI technology is accessible, equitable, and responsibly deployed. The principles include resisting power consolidation by a few, enabling users to achieve their goals with AI, promoting widespread prosperity through accessible AI infrastructure, collaborating with governments and society to manage AI risks, and prioritizing safety and alignment. OpenAI aims to balance broad access with caution to minimize harm while fostering innovation and societal flourishing.

items.title: OpenAI introduces AI Jobs Transition Framework analyzing 921 US occupations to assess automation risk, job reorganization, growth potential, and minimal AI impact [ * ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has developed the AI Jobs Transition Framework to evaluate how AI might affect 921 occupations covering approximately 148 million jobs in the U.S. The framework categorizes jobs based on AI's ability to perform tasks, the necessity of human involvement, and whether AI-driven productivity gains could increase demand. The analysis identifies four categories: about 18% of jobs face high automation risk, including roles like data-entry clerks and telemarketers; 24% are likely to reorganize, such as lawyers and teachers who will integrate AI while retaining human judgment; 12% could grow as AI lowers service costs, benefiting fields like tutoring and healthcare; and 46% show less immediate change, including physically intensive jobs like electricians and construction workers. The framework emphasizes that these categories map potential changes rather than predict job losses, highlighting the complexity of AI's impact on the labor market.

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-5.5 with improved intelligence, speed, and efficiency for coding, research, and knowledge work [ ! ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has released GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5 Pro, its most advanced language models to date, designed to handle complex, multi-step tasks such as coding, data analysis, and scientific research more efficiently and intuitively. The models match the speed of previous versions while delivering higher intelligence and using fewer tokens, improving performance in agentic coding and knowledge work. GPT-5.5 is available to Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users in ChatGPT and Codex, with API access forthcoming. OpenAI has implemented its strongest safeguards yet to reduce misuse, based on extensive internal and external testing and feedback from early-access partners. The update marks a significant step toward more capable AI systems that can autonomously plan, execute, and verify tasks across multiple tools and contexts.

items.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.5 system card detailing model capabilities, training, and safety measures [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has published the system card for GPT-5.5, outlining the model's enhanced abilities for complex tasks such as coding, research, and document creation. The card includes information on training data, improvements over previous versions, and safety evaluations conducted before release. The document describes the model's improved understanding, reduced need for guidance, and effective tool use, along with the deployment of advanced safeguards to minimize misuse. It also covers the evaluation process involving early-access partners and targeted red-teaming for cybersecurity and biology risks, with additional details on GPT-5.5 Pro's specific safeguards included in an update.

items.title: OpenAI explains how ChatGPT Work automates everyday tasks by transforming existing work inputs into review-ready documents and summaries [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI details how teams can use ChatGPT Work to convert calendars, emails, documents, and other work materials into usable outputs like briefs, summaries, decks, and plans. The tool leverages existing context to generate initial drafts that teams can review and refine for various routine workflows. The article highlights practical use cases such as daily briefs, weekly updates, decision memos, and workflow audits, emphasizing how ChatGPT Work integrates with common workplace tools to streamline productivity. It also references an on-demand webinar and additional resources for users to learn how to implement these workflows effectively.

items.title: OpenAI explains how ChatGPT Codex plugins and skills enable reusable workflows and tool integrations for automating repeatable tasks [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI details how ChatGPT Codex uses skills and plugins to streamline repeatable work by packaging instructions, resources, and tools into reusable workflows. Skills provide task-specific guidance for consistent results, while plugins bundle skills with apps and services for broader functionality. Skills help automate tasks like preparing briefs or applying team standards by capturing workflows that ChatGPT can recognize and execute repeatedly. Plugins extend this by integrating with external services such as GitHub or Google Drive, allowing users to install and share complex workflows easily. OpenAI also offers guidance on building, testing, and distributing skills and plugins to enhance productivity and collaboration.

items.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Clinicians, a free AI tool for verified U.S. physicians, nurse practitioners, and pharmacists to assist with clinical care, documentation, and research [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced ChatGPT for Clinicians, a specialized version of ChatGPT designed to support clinical tasks such as documentation, medical research, and patient care. The service is free for verified individual clinicians in the U.S., including physicians, nurse practitioners, physician assistants, and pharmacists. The tool incorporates advanced AI models tailored for complex clinical questions, reusable skills for common workflows, trusted clinical search with cited evidence, and deep research capabilities across medical journals. It also offers optional HIPAA compliance support and enhanced account security features. OpenAI developed the tool in collaboration with hundreds of physician advisors and continues to evaluate and improve its performance and safety in healthcare settings.

items.title: Google DeepMind introduces Decoupled DiLoCo, a distributed AI training architecture that improves resilience and efficiency across global data centers with lower bandwidth requirements [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind has developed Decoupled DiLoCo, a new distributed architecture designed to train large language models across distant data centers with greater fault tolerance and reduced communication delays. This approach divides training into asynchronous "islands" of compute, allowing local hardware failures to be isolated without interrupting overall progress, and requires significantly less bandwidth than traditional methods. Built on previous advances like Pathways and DiLoCo, Decoupled DiLoCo enables self-healing training clusters that can continue learning despite hardware disruptions and reintegrate failed units seamlessly. In tests with Gemma 4 models, it maintained high training availability and matched conventional performance benchmarks while operating over standard internet connectivity, achieving training speeds more than 20 times faster than synchronized methods. This architecture also supports mixing different hardware generations within a single training run, extending hardware lifespan and increasing compute capacity. Decoupled DiLoCo represents a step toward more flexible, scalable AI training infrastructure capable of leveraging distributed resources globally without requiring custom network setups.

items.title: OpenAI launches Codex-powered workspace agents in ChatGPT to automate complex team workflows with organizational controls [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced workspace agents in ChatGPT, powered by Codex, enabling teams to automate complex tasks and long-running workflows within organizational permissions. These agents operate in the cloud, can be shared across teams, and integrate with various tools to streamline work processes securely. Workspace agents can gather context from multiple systems, follow team procedures, request approvals, and maintain workflow continuity across platforms like ChatGPT and Slack. OpenAI provides templates and guided setup to help teams build agents for tasks such as software request triage, product feedback routing, metrics reporting, lead outreach, and third-party risk management. These agents are currently available in research preview for ChatGPT Business, Enterprise, Edu, and Teachers plans.

items.title: OpenAI launches workspace agents in ChatGPT to automate repeatable workflows with triggers, processes, and tool integrations [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI introduced workspace agents in ChatGPT designed to automate repeatable, structured workflows by connecting triggers, processes, and tools. These agents help teams reduce manual tasks by integrating with systems like Slack, CRMs, and ticketing platforms to deliver consistent outputs on schedules or events. Workspace agents differ from traditional deterministic workflows by using AI models to interpret context and make bounded decisions within defined guardrails. OpenAI provides examples such as marketing campaign summaries, product feedback triage, and sales pipeline monitoring to illustrate how agents can streamline common business processes and improve efficiency.

items.title: OpenAI speeds up Codex agent workflows by 40% with WebSockets and caching in the Responses API to reduce latency and API overhead [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has improved the performance of its Codex agent workflows by integrating WebSockets and connection-scoped caching into the Responses API, resulting in a 40% faster end-to-end experience. These changes reduce redundant processing and network overhead, allowing users to benefit from faster model inference speeds that have increased from 65 to nearly 1,000 tokens per second. The improvements address the bottleneck caused by repeated API calls that processed full conversation histories for each request. By establishing a persistent WebSocket connection, the system caches reusable state and only sends new information, minimizing latency. Additional optimizations include caching tokens and model configurations, reducing network hops, and enhancing safety checks to flag issues more quickly, all contributing to a more responsive and efficient agent loop.

items.title: OpenAI launches Privacy Filter, an open-weight model for detecting and redacting personally identifiable information in text with state-of-the-art accuracy [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has released Privacy Filter, a small, open-weight model designed to detect and redact personally identifiable information (PII) in unstructured text. The model supports high-throughput privacy workflows, runs locally to keep data on device, and achieves state-of-the-art performance on the PII-Masking-300k benchmark after correcting annotation issues. Privacy Filter uses a context-aware token-classification approach to identify a wide range of PII categories, including names, addresses, emails, phone numbers, dates, account numbers, and secrets, enabling developers to build stronger privacy protections into their AI systems and workflows.

items.title: Google DeepMind partners with Accenture, Bain, BCG, Deloitte, and McKinsey to accelerate AI adoption and transformation across industries [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind has formed partnerships with leading global consultancies including Accenture, Bain & Company, BCG, Deloitte, and McKinsey to help organizations worldwide adopt and integrate advanced AI technologies. This collaboration aims to accelerate AI-driven transformation by combining DeepMind's research expertise with the consultancies' strategic reach to address complex industry challenges. The initiative focuses on delivering scaled, industry-specific AI solutions, providing early access to DeepMind's frontier models like Gemini, and connecting AI leadership with customer executives to guide AI development. The partnership targets sectors such as finance, manufacturing, retail, and media, aiming to empower workforces with AI tools for improved decision-making and management of complex tasks while promoting responsible AI diffusion across industries.

items.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Images 2.0 with improved text rendering, multilingual support, and enhanced visual reasoning [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has released ChatGPT Images 2.0, an updated image generation model that improves text rendering accuracy, supports multiple languages, and offers enhanced visual reasoning capabilities. This update aims to advance the quality and versatility of AI-generated images within the ChatGPT platform.

items.title: OpenAI launches Codex Labs and partners with Accenture, PwC, Infosys, and others to scale Codex adoption in enterprises, reaching over 4 million weekly users [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced Codex Labs to help enterprises integrate Codex into their software development workflows through expert-led workshops and sessions. The company is partnering with global systems integrators including Accenture, PwC, Infosys, Capgemini, CGI, Cognizant, and Tata Consultancy Services to accelerate Codex deployment from pilots to production across thousands of engineering organizations. Codex is being used by companies like Virgin Atlantic, Ramp, Notion, Cisco, and Rakuten for tasks ranging from test coverage and code review to incident response and feature development. Beyond engineering, teams are leveraging Codex to synthesize information and automate workflows, expanding its impact across enterprise functions. OpenAI aims to help more organizations adopt Codex at scale with the support of its partners and direct engagement through Codex Labs.

items.title: Hyatt deploys ChatGPT Enterprise with GPT-5.4 and Codex across global workforce to enhance productivity and guest experience [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Hyatt has implemented ChatGPT Enterprise, powered by GPT-5.4 and Codex, for its global corporate and hotel employees to improve productivity, streamline operations, and enhance guest services. The AI tools support multiple departments including finance, marketing, business development, product engineering, and customer experience. The rollout includes live onboarding and training in collaboration with OpenAI, enabling Hyatt teams to integrate AI into daily workflows. This deployment is part of Hyatt's broader strategy to leverage AI technologies to deliver more personalized and efficient service, complementing other AI-powered initiatives like the Hyatt app in ChatGPT.

items.title: OpenAI updates Codex app with computer control, in-app browsing, image generation, memory, and expanded developer workflow support [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has released a major update to its Codex application for macOS and Windows, enhancing its capabilities to assist over 3 million weekly developers. The update enables Codex to operate computer apps directly, supports in-app web browsing, generates images, remembers user preferences, and integrates with more developer tools to streamline software development tasks. New features include parallel agent operation on Macs, an in-app browser for frontend and game development, and support for over 90 new plugins including integrations with JIRA, CircleCI, GitLab, and Microsoft Suite. The app also adds workflow improvements such as GitHub review comment handling, multiple terminal tabs, remote devbox connections via SSH, and rich file previews. Codex now supports automations that preserve conversation context over time and can schedule future tasks, with a preview of memory features to recall past interactions and preferences. These enhancements aim to accelerate development cycles by helping users manage ongoing work and prioritize tasks across tools like Slack, Gmail, and Notion. The update is available immediately for Codex desktop users signed in with ChatGPT, with some features rolling out soon to enterprise and regional users.

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-Rosalind, a reasoning model optimized for life sciences research and drug discovery workflows [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced GPT-Rosalind, a new AI model designed to accelerate research in biology, drug discovery, and translational medicine by improving reasoning across chemistry, protein engineering, and genomics. The model supports complex scientific workflows such as literature review, experimental planning, and data analysis to help researchers generate hypotheses and design experiments more efficiently. GPT-Rosalind is available as a research preview through ChatGPT, Codex, and the API for qualified users, with a Life Sciences research plugin connecting to over 50 scientific tools and data sources. OpenAI is collaborating with organizations including Amgen, Moderna, and the Allen Institute to apply the model in real-world research settings, aiming to reduce the time and complexity involved in early-stage drug discovery and biological research.

items.title: OpenAI launches Trusted Access for Cyber initiative with $10 million in API grants to enhance global cyber defense using GPT-5.4-Cyber [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced the Trusted Access for Cyber program to broaden access to advanced cybersecurity tools while ensuring trust and safeguards. The initiative involves partnerships with security firms, enterprises, and researchers to improve threat detection and response across diverse digital environments. The program includes $10 million in API credits awarded to organizations like Socket, Semgrep, Calif, and Trail of Bits, focusing on software supply chain security and vulnerability research. Major companies such as Bank of America, Cisco, CrowdStrike, and JPMorgan Chase have joined to support these efforts, alongside access granted to U.S. and UK AI security institutes for model evaluation. OpenAI aims to expand this ecosystem to strengthen collective cyber defense capabilities globally.

items.title: Google launches Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS with granular audio tags for expressive AI speech in over 70 languages, available via Google AI Studio and Vertex AI [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Google has introduced Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS, a new text-to-speech model that offers improved speech quality, expressiveness, and precise control through granular audio tags. The model supports over 70 languages and allows developers to adjust vocal style, pace, and delivery using natural language commands. Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS is accessible in preview via the Gemini API, Google AI Studio, Vertex AI, and Google Vids. It includes features like scene direction, speaker-level specificity, and seamless export of voice settings, enabling developers to create more natural and immersive AI speech experiences. The audio outputs are watermarked with SynthID to identify AI-generated content and help prevent misinformation.

items.title: OpenAI updates Agents SDK with native sandbox execution and model-native harness to support secure, long-running agents across files and tools [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has released an updated version of its Agents SDK that introduces native sandbox execution and a model-native harness, enabling developers to build agents capable of inspecting files, running commands, editing code, and handling long-horizon tasks securely. The new SDK provides standardized infrastructure designed specifically for OpenAI models, allowing agents to operate within controlled environments and work across multiple files and tools efficiently. The updated harness includes configurable memory, sandbox-aware orchestration, and integrations with common agent system primitives such as tool use, progressive disclosure, custom instructions, and code execution. This design aims to improve reliability and performance on complex, long-running tasks while offering flexibility for developers to adapt the SDK to their specific needs. Early testers reported that the SDK made production automation of complex workflows more viable, particularly in clinical record processing.

items.title: OpenAI expands Trusted Access for Cyber program with GPT-5.4-Cyber model to support verified cybersecurity defenders [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has scaled its Trusted Access for Cyber (TAC) program to include thousands of verified individual defenders and hundreds of teams, introducing GPT-5.4-Cyber, a model fine-tuned for defensive cybersecurity use cases. This initiative aims to enhance cyber defense capabilities while maintaining strong safeguards as AI models become more capable. The program is built on principles of democratized access, iterative deployment, and ecosystem resilience, using strong identity verification and automated processes to grant access to legitimate users. OpenAI also supports the cybersecurity community through grants, open-source contributions, and tools like Codex Security to help defenders identify and fix vulnerabilities more rapidly. OpenAI's approach addresses the dual-use nature of AI in cybersecurity by expanding access based on user trust and intent, aiming to balance broad availability with granular controls to prevent misuse. The company plans to continue evolving its models and safeguards in response to emerging threats and capabilities in the cyber defense landscape.

items.title: Google DeepMind launches Gemini Robotics ER 1.6 to enhance spatial reasoning and multi-view understanding for real-world robotic tasks [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind has introduced Gemini Robotics ER 1.6, a system designed to improve spatial reasoning and multi-view understanding in autonomous robots. This update aims to boost robots' embodied reasoning capabilities, enabling better performance in complex real-world environments.

items.title: Cloudflare integrates OpenAI GPT-5.4 and Codex into Agent Cloud to enable enterprises to deploy AI-powered agents at global scale [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Cloudflare has integrated OpenAI's GPT-5.4 and Codex models into its Agent Cloud platform, allowing millions of enterprises to deploy AI agents that automate tasks such as customer responses, system updates, and report generation within a secure, production-ready environment. Agent Cloud operates on Cloudflare Workers AI, enabling fast, real-time AI applications at the edge worldwide. This integration builds on Cloudflare's efforts to provide advanced AI capabilities to enterprises, with Codex now generally available in Cloudflare Sandboxes for secure development and testing. The partnership supports large enterprises including Accenture, Walmart, and Morgan Stanley, reflecting OpenAI's broad adoption with over one million business customers and billions of tokens processed per minute.

items.title: OpenAI publishes guidance on responsible and safe use of ChatGPT and AI tools, emphasizing accuracy, transparency, and human oversight [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has released best practices for the responsible and safe use of AI tools like ChatGPT, highlighting the importance of accuracy, transparency, and maintaining human oversight in AI-assisted work. The guidance advises users to respect workplace and OpenAI policies, verify critical information, and be cautious of potential biases in AI outputs. The recommendations also stress the need for expert review in legal, medical, or financial contexts and encourage transparency about AI use when required by employers or institutions. Users are urged to obtain consent before sharing personal data and to provide feedback on unsafe or incorrect AI responses to help improve safety and reliability.

items.title: OpenAI Blog explains how ChatGPT can assist brainstorming by generating ideas, organizing thoughts, and creating actionable plans [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: The article describes how ChatGPT serves as a structured thought partner to help users generate options quickly, organize ideas into themes, and develop executable plans. It is particularly useful for starting from scratch, managing competing ideas, and preparing initial drafts before collaboration. The piece outlines a recommended approach for brainstorming with ChatGPT, including defining clear decisions, adding constraints to improve feasibility, and using a wide-to-narrow flow to generate and evaluate ideas. It also provides example prompts and tips for refining outputs, emphasizing that ChatGPT complements but does not replace human judgment and expertise.

items.title: OpenAI details how to use ChatGPT for drafting, revising, and refining workplace writing with clear goals and audience focus [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI explains how ChatGPT can assist with common workplace writing tasks such as drafting from scratch, rewriting, adjusting tone, and organizing ideas to improve clarity and intent. The guidance emphasizes defining the writing goal, providing context, specifying format, and iterating with targeted feedback to produce effective communication. The article outlines a workflow of planning, drafting, revising, and packaging written content, highlighting ChatGPT's ability to adapt tone for different audiences and formats like emails, summaries, and announcements. It also offers example prompts and tips for success, including providing starting material, setting constraints, and verifying facts to enhance the quality of AI-assisted writing.

items.title: OpenAI launches Projects feature in ChatGPT to organize chats, files, and instructions for ongoing work and collaboration [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced Projects in ChatGPT, a feature that allows users to organize chats, files, and instructions into dedicated spaces for specific bodies of work or focus areas. This helps maintain context over time and supports collaboration by enabling shared access on certain plans. Projects are designed for ongoing tasks such as research, writing, planning, and learning, where users can keep related materials together and return to the same context without repeating background information. Enterprise customers can manage shared projects with role-based access controls, and project-only memory settings help keep work self-contained within each project.

items.title: OpenAI details AI applications through ChatGPT, Codex, and APIs for diverse user and developer needs [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has developed AI applications accessible via products like ChatGPT and Codex, as well as APIs that enable developers to integrate AI into various workflows and systems. These tools support tasks ranging from conversational assistance and software development to custom AI-powered applications, aiming to make advanced AI capabilities practical, safe, and widely accessible. ChatGPT serves as a general-purpose conversational AI for writing, learning, and problem-solving, with specialized versions for enterprises offering enhanced controls and privacy. Codex focuses on AI-assisted coding tasks, while the OpenAI API allows scalable integration of AI models into external products and automation. OpenAI emphasizes thoughtful design and safeguards to ensure these technologies benefit users and organizations effectively.

items.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT tools to help customer success teams manage accounts, improve communication, and reduce churn [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced ChatGPT features designed to assist customer success teams in managing accounts, streamlining communication, and enhancing customer outcomes. The tools synthesize scattered customer information into clear plans, draft structured messaging, and standardize workflows for onboarding, adoption, renewals, and risk monitoring. These features support various customer success activities such as creating onboarding plans, preparing meeting summaries, tracking account health, coordinating cross-functional efforts, and analyzing customer feedback. By combining research and content creation capabilities, ChatGPT aims to reduce administrative overhead and help teams focus more on customer relationships and retention.

items.title: OpenAI details how sales teams use ChatGPT to streamline account research, outreach, deal coordination, and pipeline management [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI explains how sales teams leverage ChatGPT to accelerate tasks like account research, meeting preparation, personalized outreach, and deal coordination, resulting in more efficient pipeline management and higher conversion rates. ChatGPT transforms unstructured inputs such as call notes and CRM data into clear briefs, emails, and action plans, helping sales reps focus more on customer interactions and consistent execution. The tool supports various sales activities including prospecting, discovery, proposal drafting, objection handling, and RFP responses, while features like project organization and data analysis enhance team collaboration and decision-making.

items.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Healthcare, a HIPAA-compliant AI tool to assist clinicians with diagnosis, documentation, and patient care workflows [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced ChatGPT for Healthcare, a secure AI workspace designed to support hospital providers with clinical workflows while complying with HIPAA regulations to protect patient data. The tool offers cited answers from trusted medical sources and helps clinicians reduce administrative tasks such as drafting documentation, preparing prior authorizations, and summarizing patient information. The platform includes prompt templates tailored for common clinical scenarios, including diagnostic test selection, differential diagnosis, care planning, and patient counseling. These resources aim to improve efficiency and allow clinicians to focus more on patient care by streamlining evidence search, guideline reconciliation, and documentation processes.

items.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT personalization features with custom instructions and memory to tailor responses to user preferences [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced new personalization features for ChatGPT that allow users to customize the AI's behavior through custom instructions and memory. These tools enable ChatGPT to remember user preferences and context, providing more relevant and consistent responses tailored to individual needs. Custom instructions let users specify details such as their role, preferred tone, and output formats, which apply across conversations until changed. Memory allows ChatGPT to retain information users choose to share, improving response relevance over time without needing repeated explanations. Users can manage saved information directly within conversations to refine the AI's understanding. These personalization capabilities aim to make ChatGPT function more like a reliable collaborator by adapting to users' working styles and recurring tasks, enhancing productivity and interaction quality.

items.title: OpenAI details how ChatGPT can analyze data, generate insights, and create visualizations in ChatGPT, Excel, and Google Sheets [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI explains how users can upload data files or connect data sources to ChatGPT for exploratory analysis, cleaning, visualization, and summarization in plain language. The tool supports early-stage data exploration and helps translate findings into actionable summaries for decision-making. ChatGPT integrates with Excel and Google Sheets as a sidebar plugin, enabling users to request spreadsheet edits, updates, and first-pass analyses without leaving their familiar tools. The article provides example prompts and workflows for cleaning workbooks, understanding model logic, updating assumptions, and building KPI summaries, emphasizing clear instructions for best results.

items.title: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT skills to create reusable workflows for automating recurring tasks and ensuring consistent outputs [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has launched ChatGPT skills, which are reusable, shareable workflows designed to guide the AI through recurring tasks with consistent steps and formats. Skills include a SKILL.md file that outlines instructions, inputs, outputs, and quality checks, enabling users to automate multi-step processes, enforce standards, and share best practices across teams. Users can build skills by defining repeatable tasks, writing detailed instructions, reviewing drafts generated by ChatGPT, and installing them for everyday use. This approach aims to reduce repetitive prompting, improve consistency, and allow workflows to be reused across different chats and applications.

items.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT tools to help operations teams organize workflows, standardize processes, and improve execution efficiency [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced ChatGPT features designed to support operations teams by transforming fragmented inputs into clear summaries, standardizing recurring processes, and maintaining consistent updates. These tools aim to reduce coordination friction and enable teams to focus more on execution. The platform assists with various operational tasks including running business reviews, managing workflows, handling incidents, coordinating vendor operations, planning capacity, and ensuring data quality. It offers capabilities such as project organization, workflow standardization, data analysis, research synthesis, and image generation to enhance communication and decision-making. Teams achieve the most benefit by providing clear context and real inputs, allowing ChatGPT to structure work, identify gaps, clarify decisions, and produce actionable outputs. The impact is measured by improvements in speed, quality, and consistency of operational outputs and cross-functional coordination.

items.title: OpenAI publishes introductory guide explaining AI basics, large language models, and their applications like ChatGPT [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI released a beginner-friendly guide that explains the fundamentals of artificial intelligence, including what AI is, how it functions, and how tools like ChatGPT use large language models. The guide aims to help newcomers understand AI concepts without requiring a technical background. The guide covers how AI systems recognize patterns and learn from data, the distinction between different AI models, and the training process involving pre-training and post-training stages. It also explains the differences between reasoning and non-reasoning models and how users can interact with these models depending on their needs.

items.title: OpenAI details how marketing teams use ChatGPT to plan campaigns, generate content, analyze data, and accelerate project workflows [ * ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Marketing teams use ChatGPT to streamline campaign planning, content creation, and performance analysis by consolidating inputs, generating drafts, and summarizing results. This helps reduce time spent on rewriting and allows teams to focus more on strategy and execution. ChatGPT supports tasks such as drafting multi-channel copy, synthesizing market research, brainstorming ideas, and interpreting campaign data to inform next steps. Teams are encouraged to use ChatGPT as a collaborative tool, refining outputs with human judgment to improve clarity, tone, and messaging consistency. The impact is measured by faster campaign cycles, quicker launches, and increased testing capacity rather than usage metrics alone.

items.title: OpenAI launches custom GPT builder to create purpose-built ChatGPT assistants for specific workflows and consistent outputs [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI introduced a custom GPT builder that allows users to create specialized ChatGPT assistants tailored to specific tasks or workflows, improving consistency and efficiency in repeatable work. These custom GPTs can follow user-defined instructions, incorporate uploaded knowledge, and enable tools like web search and data analysis to reduce repetitive setup and maintain context. The builder offers a guided interface to define objectives, behaviors, and capabilities, supporting use cases such as writing assistance, data analysis, coding help, and visual design. Users can test their custom GPTs before sharing them, ensuring reliable performance for tasks like automating routine prompts, integrating external APIs, and maintaining consistent tone and structure across interactions.

items.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT tools to help finance teams streamline reporting, improve forecasting, and communicate insights more clearly [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced ChatGPT features designed to assist finance teams in organizing data, drafting reports, and standardizing workflows to reduce overhead in tasks like variance analysis, forecasting, and audit preparation. The tools help structure inputs, generate narratives, and maintain consistency across recurring financial deliverables without replacing professional judgment. The platform supports integration with sources like Google Drive and SharePoint to pull in budgets and planning documents, and it can analyze Excel or CSV files directly. Key use cases include preparing month-end reports, building forecasts, investigating anomalies, managing close processes, and supporting accounting and audit tasks. ChatGPT also offers project organization, skill standardization, and data analysis capabilities tailored for finance workflows.

items.title: OpenAI offers tailored AI resources and prompt packs to help financial institutions deploy and scale AI securely in regulated environments [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has compiled a set of resources including prompt packs, GPT models, guides, and tools designed specifically for banks, asset managers, insurers, and other financial services organizations to evaluate, adopt, and scale AI within regulated environments. These resources aim to support financial institutions in deploying AI securely and effectively across various use cases such as data analysis, financial modeling, regulatory interpretation, and document analysis. The offerings include curated prompts for ChatGPT Enterprise to accelerate workflows while ensuring clarity and auditability, on-demand webinars showcasing AI applications in banking, and in-depth guides and whitepapers providing frameworks for AI adoption. Financial institutions interested in secure AI deployment can engage with OpenAI's sales team and continue learning through the OpenAI Academy.

items.title: OpenAI launches file upload support in ChatGPT for analyzing, editing, and generating content from PDFs, spreadsheets, images, and documents [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has added file upload capabilities to ChatGPT, allowing users to directly upload various file types such as CSV, XLSX, PDF, DOCX, JPEG, and PNG within conversations. Users can analyze data, summarize reports, edit documents, and generate visualizations or tables without leaving the chat interface. The feature supports tasks like summarizing key findings, visualizing sales data, rewriting documents for clarity, and extracting information into tables. Some ChatGPT versions also enable integration with third-party apps to bring external context into conversations, with enterprise controls governing app availability and data usage policies. Additional resources and guidance are available through the OpenAI Help Center and OpenAI Academy.

items.title: OpenAI details ChatGPT's search and deep research features for integrating current web information and complex analysis [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI explains how ChatGPT can assist with research by combining web search capabilities and deep research to gather, analyze, and synthesize information from across the internet. The article outlines two methods: ChatGPT search for quick retrieval of recent facts and deep research for multi-step, in-depth analysis with citations and reasoning. ChatGPT search allows users to access up-to-date information directly within conversations, indicated by a globe icon, and supports follow-up prompts for summarization or drafting. Deep research involves an agentic process that plans and executes multi-step queries to produce detailed, evidence-backed reports, which may take several minutes to complete. The article also compares the two approaches, highlighting their distinct use cases, speed, and output depth to help users choose the appropriate method for their research needs.

items.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT research tools to help users gather, analyze, and synthesize information with citations for faster evidence-based insights [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI introduced new ChatGPT features designed to assist users in conducting research by turning questions into structured plans, gathering and comparing sources, and producing reports with citations. These tools support both quick overviews and deeper multi-step investigations, aiming to improve research efficiency and output trustworthiness. The research capabilities include a Search mode for fast orientation using up-to-date web information and a Deep Research mode for complex questions that require breaking down problems, evaluating multiple sources, and synthesizing findings into briefs or memos. Users can request outlines, source quality checks, summaries, and targeted follow-ups to refine results. OpenAI provides examples such as competitive landscape tables, literature reviews from PDFs, policy scans, and market trend tracking to demonstrate practical applications. The tools emphasize transparency by including citations and highlighting gaps or uncertainties in the research.

items.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT tools to help managers prepare conversations, draft feedback, and organize team workflows [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT features designed to assist managers in preparing for conversations, drafting clear and consistent feedback, and managing recurring tasks like 1:1 agendas and performance documentation. The tools aim to reduce time spent on repetitive work while supporting better communication and organization within teams. The platform offers templates and checklists for common managerial activities such as hiring, goal setting, and performance reviews, and can generate strategic plans, meeting agendas, and change management communications. By incorporating real context like notes and project updates, managers can use ChatGPT to structure their thinking and improve decision-making efficiency without replacing their judgment or HR responsibilities.

items.title: OpenAI Blog explains how to generate and refine images using ChatGPT with clear prompts and iterative adjustments [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI's blog details how ChatGPT can create original images from simple, descriptive prompts, allowing users to quickly iterate on designs and produce production-ready visuals. The process emphasizes clarity in prompts, specifying key details like purpose, subject, style, and constraints to guide image generation effectively. The article provides best practices for refining images through targeted revisions and explains advanced techniques such as using multiple uploaded images for style transfer and precise instructions for text in images. It also highlights considerations like respecting likeness rights and policy compliance when generating images.

items.title: OpenAI rotates macOS code signing certificates and updates apps after Axios developer tool supply chain attack, confirms no user data breach [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI responded to a supply chain attack involving the Axios developer tool used in their macOS app-signing process by revoking and rotating their macOS code signing certificates. They updated their macOS applications, including ChatGPT Desktop and Codex, requiring users to update by May 8, 2026, to maintain functionality and security. OpenAI found no evidence that user data, systems, or software were compromised during the incident. The attack occurred on March 31, 2026, when a malicious version of Axios was executed in a GitHub Actions workflow with access to signing certificates. OpenAI engaged a third-party forensics firm, worked with Apple to block unauthorized notarizations, and addressed the root cause, which was a misconfiguration in their workflow. The company emphasized that this issue only affected macOS apps and not other platforms or web versions.

items.title: CyberAgent adopts ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to enhance AI-driven productivity and decision-making across advertising, media, and gaming sectors [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: CyberAgent, a Japanese internet company, has integrated ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to improve speed, quality, and decision-making in its advertising, media, and gaming businesses. The company uses these AI tools to support daily tasks such as research, drafting, design discussions, and code review while maintaining human oversight for final decisions. The adoption of ChatGPT Enterprise addressed previous security and governance concerns by providing enterprise-grade management features and clear internal guidelines for handling confidential information. This enabled widespread, secure AI use across nearly all departments, reaching a 93% monthly active user rate without mandatory enforcement, supported by a company culture that encourages proactive AI adoption and ongoing training.

items.title: OpenAI announces next phase of enterprise AI with Frontier, ChatGPT Enterprise, and company-wide AI agents to enhance business integration [ ! ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has unveiled its next phase of enterprise AI, introducing key developments such as Frontier, ChatGPT Enterprise, Codex, and company-wide AI agents designed to accelerate AI adoption across industries and integrate AI deeply into business operations. The company reports that enterprise now accounts for over 40% of its revenue and is on track to match consumer revenue by the end of 2026, with growing demand from major customers like Goldman Sachs and State Farm. OpenAI aims to provide a unified AI operating layer through Frontier, enabling AI agents to work across company systems and data with proper governance and permissions. The company is partnering with firms like McKinsey, BCG, Accenture, AWS, Databricks, and Snowflake to help enterprises embed AI into existing infrastructure. Additionally, OpenAI is developing a unified AI superapp to integrate AI agents into employees' daily workflows, enhancing productivity and enabling teams to manage AI agents effectively.

items.title: OpenAI introduces Child Safety Blueprint to strengthen AI safeguards against child sexual exploitation with industry and law enforcement collaboration [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has launched the Child Safety Blueprint, a framework designed to combat AI-enabled child sexual exploitation by modernizing laws, improving reporting and coordination, and embedding safety-by-design measures in AI systems. The blueprint was developed with input from organizations including the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children and the Attorney General Alliance to address emerging risks in the digital age. The framework aims to enhance detection and prevention efforts by combining legal, operational, and technical approaches, promoting earlier intervention and stronger accountability across the AI ecosystem. State attorneys general and child protection leaders have endorsed the blueprint as a necessary step to align technology practices with enforcement realities and evolving threats, emphasizing the need for layered defenses and ongoing collaboration to protect children online.

items.title: OpenAI launches Safety Fellowship to support independent AI safety and alignment research from September 2026 to February 2027 [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has announced the Safety Fellowship, a pilot program inviting external researchers, engineers, and practitioners to conduct rigorous research on AI safety and alignment. The program runs from September 14, 2026, to February 5, 2027, and offers mentorship, workspace options in Berkeley or remote work, a monthly stipend, compute support, and expects substantial research outputs such as papers or datasets. The fellowship prioritizes research in areas including safety evaluation, ethics, robustness, scalable mitigations, privacy-preserving methods, and misuse domains, welcoming applicants from diverse fields like computer science, social science, cybersecurity, and HCI. Applications are open until May 3, 2026, with notifications by July 25, and fellows will receive API credits but no internal system access.

items.title: Google DeepMind launches Gemma 4 open models with advanced reasoning and agentic workflows, offering state-of-the-art performance across four sizes and broad hardware compatibility [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind introduced Gemma 4, its most capable open AI models to date, designed for complex reasoning and agentic workflows. Available in four sizes from 2 billion to 31 billion parameters, Gemma 4 delivers high intelligence-per-parameter and supports multimodal inputs including vision and audio, with native processing of over 140 languages. The models are optimized for diverse hardware, from mobile devices to high-end GPUs, and are released under an Apache 2.0 license to encourage broad adoption and fine-tuning. Gemma 4 models achieve top rankings on industry benchmarks, outperforming much larger models in efficiency and capability.
