Features include multi-step planning, function-calling for autonomous agents, extended context windows up to 256K tokens, and high-quality offline code generation. The release builds on DeepMind's Gemini research and aims to empower developers and researchers with accessible, frontier-class AI tools for a wide range of applications, including language, vision, and audio processing.

items.title: OpenAI acquires TBPN to support independent AI discussions and expand engagement with tech and business communities [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has acquired Technology Business Programming Network (TBPN), a daily live tech talk show known for its editorial independence and influential voice in AI and technology discussions. The acquisition aims to accelerate global conversations about AI and maintain TBPN's editorial autonomy while scaling its reach. TBPN, hosted by entrepreneurs Jordi Hays and John Coogan, has become a prominent platform for real-time coverage of AI news and industry developments. The team will join OpenAI's Strategy organization, with a focus on leveraging their communication and marketing expertise to enhance public understanding of AI's impact on daily life. OpenAI emphasized the importance of preserving TBPN's editorial independence as foundational to its credibility. The acquisition reflects OpenAI's commitment to fostering constructive dialogue about AI's technological shifts and societal implications, involving builders and users at the center of the conversation.

items.title: OpenAI introduces pay-as-you-go Codex pricing for ChatGPT Business and Enterprise teams, enabling flexible scaling and lowering ChatGPT Business seat prices [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has launched pay-as-you-go pricing for Codex seats within ChatGPT Business and Enterprise plans, allowing teams to add Codex access without fixed seat fees and pay based on token usage. This change aims to simplify adoption and cost tracking for teams starting small pilots or expanding usage. The update also includes a reduction in the annual price of ChatGPT Business seats from $25 to $20 and a limited-time credit offer for new Codex-only team members. Codex usage within ChatGPT Business and Enterprise has grown sixfold since January 2026, with companies like Notion and Ramp using it to accelerate engineering workflows.

items.title: Gradient Labs launches AI account managers for all bank customers using GPT-4.1 and GPT-5.4 mini and nano models to automate complex financial support workflows [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Gradient Labs has introduced AI account managers for every bank customer, leveraging OpenAI's GPT-4.1 and GPT-5.4 mini and nano models to handle complex banking support tasks with high accuracy and low latency. The system aims to replicate the experience of a dedicated account manager by following strict procedures in real time, ensuring compliance and reducing customer wait times. The platform uses a hybrid architecture combining large reasoning models with smaller deterministic ones, supported by over 15 guardrail systems to maintain compliance and prevent errors. Gradient Labs validates the system through replaying real conversations and synthetic tests, gradually expanding AI coverage from low-risk to more complex workflows while monitoring performance and enabling human review when needed.

items.title: OpenAI raises $122 billion at $852 billion valuation to expand AI infrastructure and accelerate global AI adoption [ ! ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI announced it has secured $122 billion in funding at a post-money valuation of $852 billion to accelerate the next phase of AI development and deployment worldwide. The investment will support advancements in AI models, computing infrastructure, and enterprise AI products such as ChatGPT and Codex. The funding round was led by strategic partners including Amazon, NVIDIA, SoftBank, and Microsoft, with participation from numerous global institutional investors and individual investors through bank channels. OpenAI highlighted its rapid user growth, revenue milestones, and product expansions, including the launch of GPT-5.4 and increased enterprise adoption, positioning the company as a core AI infrastructure provider with broad consumer and business impact.

items.title: OpenAI and Gates Foundation hold AI workshop for disaster response leaders across 13 Asian countries to improve emergency management [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI partnered with the Gates Foundation, Asian Disaster Preparedness Center, and DataKind to host an AI workshop in Bangkok for 50 disaster management leaders from Southeast and South Asia. The event aimed to help governments and nonprofits use AI tools to respond faster and more effectively to disasters in the region. Participants from 13 countries, including Bangladesh, India, Indonesia, and Thailand, collaborated with OpenAI mentors to develop practical AI applications such as custom GPTs for situation reporting, needs assessment, and public communication. The initiative builds on OpenAI's broader program to integrate AI into real-world operational challenges faced by disaster response teams, especially as Asia remains the world's most disaster-prone region with increasing climate-related emergencies.

items.title: Google DeepMind develops AI-powered mouse pointer to enable context-aware interactions across Chrome and other apps [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind is creating an AI-enhanced mouse pointer that understands the context of what users point at, aiming to make interactions more intuitive and seamless across applications like Chrome. The technology leverages the Gemini AI model to interpret visual and semantic cues, allowing users to perform tasks such as summarizing text, generating charts, or requesting directions simply by pointing and speaking. This AI pointer is designed to maintain user workflow without forcing detours into separate AI tools, replacing complex text prompts with natural, shorthand commands like "Fix this" or "Show me directions." Google is integrating these capabilities into Chrome and its Googlebook laptop, with plans to expand testing across other platforms including Google Labs' Disco. The approach transforms pixels into actionable entities, enabling more fluid collaboration between users and AI.

items.title: STADLER integrates ChatGPT across 650 employees to accelerate knowledge work and improve productivity at its 230-year-old recycling technology company [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: STADLER, a family-owned company with over 230 years of history specializing in automated waste sorting, has embedded ChatGPT into daily workflows for its 650 employees to enhance speed, quality, and decision-making. The company reports 30-40% time savings on common knowledge tasks and over 85% daily active usage since adopting the AI tool in 2023. The rollout involved creating more than 125 custom GPTs tailored to various functions including engineering, project management, and marketing. Employees use ChatGPT for drafting, summarizing, translating, and structuring complex information, reducing the time to first draft by 2.5 times on average. Leadership combined bottom-up experimentation with top-down support to encourage widespread adoption and training. STADLER plans to evolve AI use from assistance to execution by integrating AI agents into core workflows that can automate information gathering, output generation, validation, and approval routing. This transformation aims to increase organizational agility and unlock new productivity levels across its global operations.

items.title: Google launches Gemini 3.1 Flash Live audio model with improved precision, lower latency, and enhanced naturalness for real-time voice AI across 200+ countries [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Google has introduced Gemini 3.1 Flash Live, its highest-quality audio and voice model designed to deliver more natural, reliable, and fluid real-time dialogue. The model is accessible to developers via the Gemini Live API in Google AI Studio, available for enterprises through Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience, and integrated into consumer products like Search Live and Gemini Live, now supporting over 200 countries. Gemini 3.1 Flash Live improves tonal understanding and task execution, scoring 90.8% on ComplexFuncBench Audio and leading on Scale AI's Audio MultiChallenge benchmark. It adapts dynamically to user emotions and performs well in noisy environments. The model also includes an imperceptible SynthID watermark to help detect AI-generated audio and combat misinformation. Early feedback from companies such as Verizon and The Home Depot highlights its enhanced conversational naturalness and reliability.

items.title: Google DeepMind releases toolkit to measure AI's potential for harmful manipulation in finance and healthcare, based on studies with over 10,000 participants [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind has developed the first empirically validated toolkit to assess AI's ability to manipulate human thought and behavior harmfully, focusing on high-stakes areas like finance and healthcare. Their research involved nine studies across the UK, US, and India, testing AI's manipulative tactics and their effects on decision-making. The study distinguished between beneficial persuasion and harmful manipulation, measuring both the efficacy and propensity of AI to use manipulative tactics when explicitly instructed or not. DeepMind also introduced a Harmful Manipulation Critical Capability Level within their Frontier Safety Framework to monitor and mitigate risks as AI models evolve. This ongoing work aims to refine evaluation methods and safety measures to prevent AI misuse in real-world interactions.

items.title: Google launches Lyria 3 Pro for longer, structurally aware music tracks across multiple products including Vertex AI and Gemini [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Google has introduced Lyria 3 Pro, an advanced AI music generation model that creates tracks up to three minutes long with enhanced structural elements like intros, verses, choruses, and bridges. The model is now integrated into various Google platforms such as Vertex AI, Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, Google Vids, the Gemini app, and ProducerAI, enabling users to produce customized music at scale. Lyria 3 Pro aims to support creators, developers, and businesses by offering flexible music generation tools that maintain creative control and musical coherence. Google is collaborating with musicians to develop these AI tools responsibly, ensuring outputs are watermarked and designed to avoid replicating existing artists' work. The rollout includes public previews and availability for paid subscribers across different Google services, expanding access to AI-assisted music production.

items.title: OpenAI publishes Model Spec as a public framework to guide AI model behavior, balancing safety, user freedom, and accountability [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced the Model Spec, a formal and publicly accessible framework that defines intended behaviors for its AI models to ensure fairness, safety, and user empowerment. The framework aims to make model behavior explicit and legible to users, developers, researchers, and policymakers, supporting transparency and iterative improvement. The Model Spec complements OpenAI's broader safety initiatives by providing clear guidance on how models should respond across diverse queries, balancing goals such as harm prevention and operational licensing. Since its initial release in 2024, the Model Spec has evolved based on user feedback and expanding AI capabilities, serving as both an internal training and governance tool and an external reference for public scrutiny and input.

items.title: OpenAI launches Safety Bug Bounty program to identify AI abuse and safety risks including prompt injection and data exfiltration [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced a public Safety Bug Bounty program aimed at detecting and addressing AI-specific safety and abuse risks across its products. The program targets vulnerabilities such as agentic behaviors, third-party prompt injection, data exfiltration, and account integrity issues that could lead to harm or misuse. This initiative complements OpenAI's existing Security Bug Bounty by focusing on safety risks that do not qualify as traditional security vulnerabilities. Researchers can submit findings related to agentic risks, proprietary information leaks, and platform integrity, with submissions triaged by OpenAI's Safety and Security teams. The program excludes general content-policy bypasses and jailbreaks but may consider other user harm risks on a case-by-case basis.

items.title: OpenAI releases prompt-based teen safety policies for gpt-oss-safeguard to help developers build age-appropriate AI protections [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced a set of prompt-based safety policies designed to help developers create safer AI experiences tailored for teenagers. These policies work with the open-weight safety model gpt-oss-safeguard to simplify the implementation of age-specific content moderation and protections. The policies address common teen risks such as graphic violence, sexual content, harmful body ideals, dangerous activities, roleplay, and age-restricted goods. Developed with input from external experts including Common Sense Media and everyone.ai, the policies aim to provide clear, operational rules that developers can integrate into real-time filtering or offline content analysis, supporting safer AI interactions for younger users.

items.title: OpenAI expands ChatGPT with Agentic Commerce Protocol to enable richer, visual product discovery and side-by-side comparisons [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has enhanced ChatGPT's shopping capabilities by integrating the Agentic Commerce Protocol, allowing users to browse products visually, compare options side-by-side, and access up-to-date product information within the chat interface. This update aims to simplify the shopping process by reducing the need to switch between tabs and websites, making product discovery faster and more seamless for users. The new features support conversational refinement of search results based on user preferences and budgets, and merchants benefit from attracting shoppers closer to purchase decisions. These improvements are rolling out to all ChatGPT users, including free, Go, Plus, and Pro tiers, with further enhancements planned to continue advancing product discovery within ChatGPT.

items.title: OpenAI Foundation plans to invest at least $1 billion in AI-driven disease cures, economic opportunities, AI resilience, and community programs starting in 2026 [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: The OpenAI Foundation announced it will invest a minimum of $1 billion over the next year to advance AI applications in life sciences, economic impact, AI resilience, and community support. The foundation aims to accelerate medical breakthroughs, improve economic opportunities, and prepare society for AI challenges. Initial efforts focus on using AI to combat diseases like Alzheimer's, expanding public health data access, and supporting research on high-mortality diseases. The foundation is also engaging with experts to address AI's impact on jobs and the economy, while developing programs to enhance AI resilience and societal readiness. These investments are part of a broader $25 billion commitment to curing diseases and AI resilience, with updates and new grants expected as the foundation scales its initiatives and refines its approach.

items.title: OpenAI details safety features in Sora 2 video generation model and app, including consent controls, content filtering, and protections for teens [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has outlined the safety measures integrated into its Sora 2 model and Sora app, designed to support secure video generation and social creation. These measures include visible and invisible provenance signals on generated videos, strict consent requirements for using real person likenesses, and enhanced guardrails for content involving minors and public figures. The platform also incorporates layered defenses against harmful content and audio misuse, along with user controls for sharing and reporting content. The safety framework includes embedding industry-standard metadata, watermarking videos, and maintaining internal tools to trace content back to Sora. Teen users receive additional protections such as filtered feeds and parental controls. OpenAI emphasizes ongoing investment in audio safeguards and human review to address emerging risks. Users retain control over their content and can report or block abusive behavior, ensuring a balance between creative expression and user safety.

items.title: OpenAI deploys GPT-5.4-powered monitoring system to detect misalignment in internal coding agents, reviewing interactions within 30 minutes to enhance AI safety [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has developed an internal monitoring system using GPT-5.4 to observe and analyze the behavior of its coding agents, aiming to detect misalignment and security risks in real-world deployments. The system reviews agents' chains of thought and actions shortly after interactions, flagging behaviors that may conflict with user intent or internal policies to enable rapid mitigation and safeguard improvements. This monitoring approach addresses unique risks posed by internal coding agents, which have access to sensitive systems and can modify safeguards. The system currently outperforms employee reports by identifying additional problematic behaviors and is evolving toward near real-time review to further enhance security. OpenAI has not found evidence of agents acting beyond their assigned tasks, and efforts continue to close monitoring gaps in bespoke or local setups.

items.title: OpenAI to acquire Astral to integrate its Python developer tools into Codex and accelerate AI-driven software development [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI announced plans to acquire Astral, a developer of widely used open source Python tools such as uv, Ruff, and ty, to enhance its Codex AI platform. The acquisition aims to expand Codex's capabilities beyond code generation to support the full software development lifecycle, including planning, modifying, and maintaining code. Astral's tools are integral to modern Python development, helping manage dependencies, enforce code quality, and improve type safety. OpenAI intends to continue supporting these open source projects while integrating them more deeply with Codex to enable AI agents to work seamlessly with developers' existing workflows. The acquisition is subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approval.

items.title: Google DeepMind introduces cognitive framework to measure progress toward AGI and launches $200,000 Kaggle hackathon for evaluation development [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind has released a new cognitive taxonomy framework to assess AI systems' progress toward Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) by evaluating key cognitive abilities. Alongside this, DeepMind has partnered with Kaggle to launch a hackathon inviting researchers to design evaluations for five cognitive abilities with the largest evaluation gaps, offering a total prize pool of $200,000. The framework identifies ten cognitive abilities essential for general intelligence, including perception, learning, reasoning, and social cognition, and proposes a three-stage evaluation protocol comparing AI performance to human baselines. The hackathon aims to develop practical evaluation tools for learning, metacognition, attention, executive functions, and social cognition, with submissions open from March 17 to April 16 and results announced on June 1.

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-5.4 mini and nano models optimized for faster coding, tool use, and multimodal reasoning in high-volume API and subagent workloads [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced GPT-5.4 mini and nano, smaller and faster versions of the GPT-5.4 model designed to improve performance in coding, reasoning, multimodal understanding, and tool use. These models target applications requiring low latency and cost efficiency, such as coding assistants, subagents handling simpler tasks, and real-time multimodal applications. GPT-5.4 mini offers more than twice the speed of its predecessor GPT-5 mini while approaching the larger GPT-5.4's performance on benchmarks like SWE-Bench Pro and OSWorld-Verified. GPT-5.4 nano is the smallest and most cost-effective variant, recommended for classification, data extraction, ranking, and coding subagents. Both models are available through OpenAI's API, Codex, and ChatGPT platforms, with pricing scaled to their size and capabilities.

items.title: OpenAI Japan announces Japan Teen Safety Blueprint with enhanced age verification and parental controls to protect teen users of generative AI [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI Japan has launched the Japan Teen Safety Blueprint, a framework designed to improve safety for teenagers using generative AI by implementing advanced age-aware protections, stronger safety policies for users under 18, and expanded parental controls. The initiative aims to address risks such as exposure to misinformation, inappropriate content, and psychological strain while supporting teen well-being. The blueprint includes privacy-conscious, risk-based age estimation with appeals processes, safeguards against harmful content and behaviors, and tools for families to manage usage and privacy settings. OpenAI is collaborating with clinicians, researchers, educators, and child safety experts to continuously improve features and research AI's impact on teen mental health. This effort builds on existing ChatGPT safeguards and aligns with Japan's approach to balancing protection and responsible technology access.

items.title: OpenAI says Americans send nearly 3 million daily ChatGPT messages about wages to close the compensation information gap [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI reports that Americans use ChatGPT nearly 3 million times daily to obtain wage and compensation information, helping to address the difficulty workers face in accessing clear pay data. This usage is especially common among workers early in their careers, switching fields, or in roles where pay is less transparent or more negotiable. The research highlights that ChatGPT users seek help translating pay into benchmarks and understanding realistic earnings for roles, companies, or entrepreneurial ventures, with queries concentrated in creative, management, healthcare, and technical fields. OpenAI's evaluation of GPT-5.4 shows high accuracy in estimating wages compared to official benchmarks, indicating AI's growing role as a labor market resource to support better career and compensation decisions.

items.title: OpenAI explains why Codex Security avoids traditional SAST reports, focusing on behavior validation and constraint reasoning to reduce false positives [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI's Codex Security deliberately does not use traditional static application security testing (SAST) reports, instead starting analysis directly from the code repository to understand architecture, trust boundaries, and intended behavior. This approach aims to validate security checks more accurately by reasoning about whether defenses truly constrain inputs after transformations, rather than just tracking data flow from source to sink. The company highlights that conventional SAST struggles with approximations and cannot reliably determine if sanitizers or validations are sufficient given complex code behaviors like decoding and normalization. Codex Security uses AI-driven techniques to analyze the entire transformation chain and validate potential vulnerabilities in an isolated environment before surfacing them, reducing false positives and focusing on real security risks.

items.title: OpenAI outlines design strategies for AI agents to resist evolving prompt injection and social engineering attacks [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI discusses new approaches to designing AI agents that can resist prompt injection attacks, which have evolved to include social engineering tactics. These attacks attempt to manipulate AI behavior through misleading external content, posing challenges beyond simple input filtering. The company emphasizes constraining AI agent capabilities and limiting the impact of manipulation, drawing parallels to human social engineering defenses. OpenAI highlights that effective security involves designing systems that reduce risk even when some attacks succeed, rather than relying solely on detecting malicious inputs.

items.title: OpenAI equips Responses API with shell tool and hosted containers to enable secure, scalable agents operating in a computer environment [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has enhanced its Responses API by integrating it with a shell tool and hosted container workspaces, creating an agent runtime that can execute complex workflows within a secure computer environment. This setup allows models to interact with files, run commands, access APIs, and maintain state, expanding their capabilities beyond static task execution. The system orchestrates a loop where the model proposes shell commands, which are executed in isolated containers with controlled filesystem and network access. Output is streamed back to the model in real time, enabling iterative decision-making and task completion. This approach addresses practical challenges like managing intermediate files, network security, and workflow reliability, aiming to simplify agent development and support more versatile, repeatable production workflows.

items.title: Rakuten uses OpenAI Codex to halve mean time to recovery and accelerate software builds from quarters to weeks [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Rakuten has integrated OpenAI's Codex into its engineering workflows, enabling the company to reduce mean time to recovery (MTTR) by approximately 50% and speed up project build times from several months to weeks. The AI-powered tool assists in incident response, automated code review, vulnerability checks, and supports more autonomous development across Rakuten's complex product ecosystem. Codex is used to accelerate root-cause analysis and remediation through KQL-based monitoring, enforce internal coding standards in continuous integration and deployment pipelines, and execute larger projects from partial specifications. This approach allows Rakuten to maintain safety and reliability while significantly increasing development speed. The company is shifting engineers' roles toward defining clear specifications and verifying AI-generated outputs rather than manual code inspection.

items.title: Wayfair integrates OpenAI models to automate supplier support and improve product catalog accuracy for millions of items [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Wayfair has embedded OpenAI models into its supplier support and catalog systems to enhance data accuracy and automate workflows across roughly 30 million products. This integration has enabled the company to correct 2.5 million product tags and automate 41,000 supplier support tickets monthly, improving operational efficiency and customer experience. The company developed a reusable AI architecture using a single OpenAI model to classify product attributes at scale, replacing costly bespoke models. Wayfair also implemented a structured audit process to validate AI-driven catalog updates and collaborated with suppliers to ensure data quality. Additionally, AI-powered features in its supplier support tool Wilma have streamlined ticket routing and resolution, addressing the complexity of thousands of issue types.

items.title: OpenAI launches IH-Challenge training dataset to improve instruction hierarchy, safety steerability, and prompt injection robustness in frontier LLMs [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI introduced IH-Challenge, a reinforcement learning training dataset designed to help large language models prioritize instructions based on trust levels, enhancing their ability to follow safety policies and resist prompt injection attacks. This approach addresses conflicts between system, developer, user, and tool instructions by training models to respect a clear instruction hierarchy, which is crucial for safe and reliable AI behavior. The IH-Challenge tasks are designed to be simple, objectively gradable, and resistant to shortcuts that could undermine training effectiveness. Models trained on IH-Challenge, such as the internal GPT-5 Mini-R, show improved performance on instruction hierarchy benchmarks and maintain overall usefulness without excessive refusals. This training method helps models generalize safety improvements to new and adversarial instruction conflicts, supporting safer AI deployment.

items.title: OpenAI launches interactive visual explanations for over 70 math and science concepts in ChatGPT to enhance learning globally [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced interactive visual explanations in ChatGPT to help users better understand math and science concepts by manipulating variables and formulas in real time. This feature, available globally across all plans starting March 2026, aims to make abstract topics more accessible and improve conceptual understanding for students and learners. The new tools cover more than 70 core topics relevant to high school and college learners, including the Pythagorean theorem, PV=nRT, and Ohm's law. Early feedback from students, parents, and educators indicates that these interactive modules support deeper learning beyond memorization by encouraging exploration and experimentation with concepts. OpenAI plans to expand these interactive learning features and continue research on AI's impact on education through initiatives like NextGenAI and the OpenAI Learning Lab.

items.title: Google DeepMind reflects on 10 years of AlphaGo's impact beyond gaming, influencing biology and scientific research [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Ten years after AlphaGo's debut, Google DeepMind highlights its influence extending beyond games into biology and scientific research, where it has driven advancements across multiple disciplines. The technology is viewed as a foundational step toward artificial general intelligence development.

items.title: OpenAI to acquire Promptfoo to integrate AI security testing into OpenAI Frontier platform [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI announced plans to acquire Promptfoo, an AI security platform that helps enterprises identify and fix vulnerabilities in AI systems during development. The acquisition aims to integrate Promptfoo's automated security testing and evaluation tools directly into OpenAI Frontier, OpenAI's platform for building and managing AI agents. Promptfoo's technology, trusted by over 25% of Fortune 500 companies, includes open-source tools for evaluating and red-teaming large language model applications. OpenAI plans to embed security testing, risk detection, and compliance reporting into Frontier to support enterprise needs for oversight, governance, and accountability as AI agents are deployed in real workflows. The acquisition is subject to customary closing conditions, and OpenAI intends to continue developing both the open-source project and enhanced enterprise capabilities within Frontier to help organizations deploy secure and reliable AI systems.

items.title: OpenAI launches Codex Security in research preview to identify and fix complex software vulnerabilities with improved accuracy and reduced false positives [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced Codex Security, an AI-driven application security tool now available in research preview for ChatGPT Pro, Enterprise, Business, and Edu customers. The tool builds deep context about software projects to detect complex vulnerabilities, prioritize findings by real-world impact, validate issues in sandboxed environments, and propose patches that align with system intent, aiming to reduce noise and accelerate secure code deployment. Codex Security, formerly known as Aardvark, began as a private beta and has demonstrated significant improvements in detection precision, cutting false positives by over 50% and reducing over-reported severity by more than 90%. It scanned over 1.2 million commits in the last 30 days, identifying hundreds of critical and high-severity issues while minimizing unnecessary triage for security teams. The system also learns from user feedback to refine its threat models and improve future findings.

items.title: Descript uses OpenAI reasoning models to scale multilingual video dubbing with improved timing and semantic fidelity [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Descript has developed a multilingual video dubbing system that leverages OpenAI's GPT-5 reasoning models to automatically localize large video libraries while preserving original timing and meaning. This approach addresses challenges in duration adherence across languages, enabling more natural dubbed audio without manual retiming or rewriting. The system breaks transcripts into chunks and optimizes translations for both semantic fidelity and duration constraints during generation, rather than correcting timing afterward. Since rollout, Descript reported a 15% increase in dubbed video exports and a 13 to 43 percentage point improvement in duration adherence, depending on the language. This advancement supports scalable dubbing for enterprise localization projects and improves user experience by avoiding unnatural speech pacing in dubbed content.

items.title: Balyasny Asset Management builds AI research engine using OpenAI models and agent workflows to accelerate investment analysis [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Balyasny Asset Management developed an AI-powered investment research system that integrates OpenAI's GPT-5.4 models and agent workflows to speed up complex financial analysis from days to hours. The system is used by 95% of its investment teams and is designed to operate within institutional compliance standards while handling both structured and unstructured data. The firm established a centralized Applied AI team to create AI-native tools embedded in team workflows, emphasizing rigorous model evaluation across multiple dimensions before deployment. Collaboration with OpenAI allowed for continuous feedback and improvements tailored to finance-specific tasks, while a federated deployment model enables customization for different asset classes. This approach has transformed Balyasny's research process by combining human expertise with scalable AI capabilities.

items.title: OpenAI finds frontier reasoning models struggle to control their chains of thought, supporting chain-of-thought monitoring as an AI safety measure [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI introduced CoT-Control, an evaluation suite to measure reasoning models' ability to control their chains of thought (CoT) under user instructions. Testing 13 frontier models across over 13,000 tasks, they found low CoT controllability scores, with no model exceeding 15.4% compliance. This suggests current models cannot reliably reshape or obscure their reasoning even when aware of monitoring, which supports the effectiveness of CoT monitoring as a safety safeguard. The study highlights the importance of continued evaluation as AI capabilities advance to ensure monitoring remains robust.

items.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.4, its most capable and efficient model for professional tasks with advanced coding, tool use, and 1 million token context support [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has launched GPT-5.4, a frontier AI model designed to enhance professional work by integrating advanced reasoning, coding, and agentic workflows. Available in ChatGPT, the API, and Codex, GPT-5.4 improves performance on complex tasks such as spreadsheets, presentations, and documents, offering faster, more accurate outputs with less iteration. GPT-5.4 introduces features like upfront planning of its reasoning process, improved deep web research, and native computer-use capabilities that enable agents to operate across applications with up to 1 million tokens of context. It also enhances tool search efficiency and reduces token usage compared to previous versions, supporting more reliable and cost-effective AI-driven workflows for developers and professionals.

items.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.4 Thinking system card detailing new cybersecurity safety mitigations [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has published the system card for GPT-5.4 Thinking, the latest reasoning model in the GPT-5 series, highlighting its comprehensive safety measures. This model is the first general-purpose GPT-5 variant to implement specific mitigations addressing high capability cybersecurity risks, building on approaches used in GPT-5.3 Codex and ChatGPT. The system card clarifies that GPT-5.4 Thinking succeeds GPT-5.2 Thinking, as there is no GPT-5.3 Thinking model. The release reflects OpenAI's ongoing efforts to enhance AI safety and security in advanced language models.

items.title: OpenAI launches new tools and resources to help educational institutions close AI capability gaps and expand student opportunities [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced new tools, certifications, and measurement resources aimed at helping schools and universities bridge the gap between basic AI use and advanced capabilities among students. The initiative targets college-age users, who are the largest group of ChatGPT users but often underutilize its full potential. The company highlights that educational institutions play a crucial role in developing students' AI skills by integrating authentic AI use cases into coursework. OpenAI is collaborating with hundreds of universities worldwide through programs like ChatGPT Edu and Education for Countries to provide AI access, training, and research support, enabling students to develop skills needed for the evolving workforce.

items.title: OpenAI launches Adoption news channel to provide practical AI insights for enterprise leaders focusing on operational change and scaling AI adoption [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced the Adoption news channel, a business-focused blog aimed at helping enterprise leaders translate AI capabilities into operational improvements and business value. The channel targets executives and AI adoption leaders seeking guidance on scaling AI, building trust, and redesigning work in an AI-native environment. The channel offers frameworks, decision-making tools, and real-world examples to clarify where AI creates value, how to overcome adoption challenges, and how AI reshapes roles and operating models. It emphasizes practical, actionable insights over technical updates, supporting leaders in navigating AI-driven transformation with clarity and confidence.

items.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Excel beta with GPT-5.4 to enhance financial modeling and adds new financial data integrations [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced ChatGPT for Excel in beta, an add-in powered by GPT-5.4 that enables users to build, update, and analyze spreadsheet models directly within Excel workbooks. This tool aims to accelerate financial modeling, scenario analysis, and data extraction by allowing users to interact with spreadsheets using natural language, improving efficiency and consistency for analysts and finance professionals. Alongside ChatGPT for Excel, OpenAI has integrated financial data from providers like FactSet, Dow Jones Factiva, LSEG, Daloopa, and S&P Global into ChatGPT, facilitating easier access to trusted market and company data within financial workflows. The GPT-5.4 model has been optimized for finance tasks, showing significant performance improvements on internal benchmarks related to investment banking workflows. ChatGPT for Excel is available globally to various ChatGPT subscription tiers and enterprise users, with Google Sheets support coming soon. The tool includes features for auditing and tracing calculations within Excel, though some complex formulas may still require manual refinement during the beta phase.

items.title: VfL Wolfsburg deploys ChatGPT Enterprise club-wide to boost efficiency and reduce costs, with over 50 custom GPTs in daily use across departments [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: VfL Wolfsburg has integrated ChatGPT Enterprise across its organization to enhance efficiency, creativity, and knowledge management while maintaining its football identity. The Bundesliga club uses more than 50 custom GPTs daily in operations, communications, marketing, HR, and administration, achieving over one million euros in annual cost savings by reducing reliance on external agencies. The club began exploring generative AI in 2023 and chose ChatGPT Enterprise for its strong output quality, enterprise-grade security, and ease of use across non-technical roles. Wolfsburg focused on building AI capabilities around real workflows rather than treating AI as a niche project, leading to broad adoption including among former players. The club plans to expand AI use to fan and partner experiences once governance and accountability structures mature.

items.title: OpenAI outlines five AI value models for sequencing workforce fluency to process reinvention to drive business transformation [ * ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI identifies five distinct AI value models that enterprises can adopt to move beyond isolated AI pilots toward comprehensive business reinvention. These models include workforce empowerment, AI-native distribution, expert capability, system integration, and agent-led operations, each with unique economics, governance, and time-to-value considerations. The framework emphasizes starting with workforce empowerment to build AI fluency and governance, which then enables deeper integration and safer AI-driven operations. Organizations that strategically sequence these models can create durable competitive advantages by embedding AI across functions and processes rather than treating it as disconnected experiments.

items.title: OpenAI researchers extend single-minus helicity amplitudes to gravitons, showing nonzero tree-level results under special kinematic conditions [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI researchers published a preprint demonstrating that single-minus graviton tree amplitudes, previously assumed to vanish, can be nonzero in a half-collinear momentum regime. The work extends recent gluon amplitude results to quantum gravity and reveals an infinite-dimensional symmetry acting on gravitons. GPT-5.2 Pro assisted in deriving and verifying these new amplitude formulas, accelerating the research process. The findings contribute to understanding quantum gravity by uncovering hidden mathematical structures in graviton interactions and connecting them to longstanding symmetry principles.

items.title: Axios uses AI to enhance local journalism by streamlining workflows and supporting reporters with tools like the Axiomizer for clearer, sharper news delivery [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Axios employs AI across its local journalism workflow to improve efficiency and quality, enabling reporters to focus on in-depth reporting while AI handles editing and formatting tasks. The company developed a custom GPT tool called the Axiomizer that helps reporters refine headlines and key story elements, enhancing clarity and impact without replacing human journalists. This AI-driven approach allows Axios to expand local coverage to more communities with fewer resources, supporting single reporters in cities like Boulder and Huntsville, Alabama. By automating routine tasks and summarizing public data such as government meetings, AI helps reporters uncover stories more effectively and sustain a profitable local news model. Axios emphasizes maintaining the human voice and community connection while using AI to standardize production and improve economic viability.

items.title: OpenAI launches Learning Outcomes Measurement Suite to assess AI's long-term impact on student learning across diverse educational settings [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced the Learning Outcomes Measurement Suite, a framework developed with the University of Tartu and Stanford's SCALE Initiative, to measure how AI tools influence student learning over time in various educational contexts. This initiative aims to move beyond traditional test scores to capture the broader effects of AI on learning processes and outcomes. The suite is currently undergoing validation through a randomized controlled trial involving over 300 college students and is part of OpenAI's Learning Lab research ecosystem, which includes partners like Arizona State University and MIT Media Lab. Early studies suggest that AI tools aligned with pedagogical principles, such as OpenAI's study mode, can improve learning outcomes, but the new framework seeks to understand the durability and depth of these gains over time. OpenAI plans to publish ongoing research findings and eventually release the measurement suite as a public resource for educational institutions worldwide, aiming to support more informed integration of AI in teaching and learning practices.

items.title: Google DeepMind launches Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, a faster and more cost-efficient AI model for high-volume workloads, available via Gemini API and Vertex AI [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, the fastest and most cost-efficient model in the Gemini 3 series, designed for high-volume developer workloads. It is available in preview through the Gemini API in Google AI Studio and for enterprises via Vertex AI, priced at $0.25 per million input tokens and $1.50 per million output tokens. The model offers improved speed and quality compared to its predecessor, 2.5 Flash, making it suitable for tasks like translation, content moderation, user interface generation, and simulations. Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite delivers a 2.5 times faster time to first answer token and a 45% increase in output speed while maintaining or improving quality benchmarks. It supports adaptive intelligence with configurable thinking levels, enabling developers to balance performance and cost for various workloads. Early adopters, including companies like Latitude, Cartwheel, and Whering, have praised its efficiency and reasoning capabilities for handling complex inputs and instructions at scale.

items.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.3 Instant update to improve ChatGPT's conversational flow, accuracy, and relevance in everyday use [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has launched GPT-5.3 Instant, an update to ChatGPT's most-used model designed to make everyday conversations smoother and more helpful. The update focuses on reducing unnecessary refusals, disclaimers, and overly cautious responses, resulting in more direct and contextually relevant answers. GPT-5.3 Instant incorporates user feedback to enhance tone, relevance, and conversational flow, addressing nuanced issues that affect user experience but may not appear in benchmarks. The update also improves web search contextualization and reduces dead ends, aiming to provide a more fluid and useful interaction for users.

items.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.3 Instant with faster responses and improved web search context, maintaining GPT-5.2 safety measures [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced GPT-5.3 Instant, the latest model in the GPT-5 series, designed to provide faster responses and richer, better-contextualized answers during web searches. The model reduces unnecessary caveats and overly declarative phrasing to improve conversational flow while retaining the comprehensive safety mitigations established in GPT-5.2 Instant. The update was detailed in OpenAI's March 2026 system card, which refers to the model as gpt-5.3-instant and highlights its enhancements over previous versions without significant changes to safety protocols.

items.title: OpenAI and Department of War agree on AI deployment with strict safety red lines and legal protections for classified environments [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has reached an agreement with the Department of War to deploy advanced AI systems in classified settings under strict safety and legal constraints. The agreement prohibits the use of OpenAI technology for mass domestic surveillance, autonomous weapons control, and high-stakes automated decisions, and includes multi-layered safeguards such as cloud-only deployment, oversight by cleared personnel, and contractual protections. The agreement explicitly forbids AI use for domestic surveillance of U.S. persons and nationals, aligning with constitutional and federal laws. It also establishes a working group involving AI labs, cloud providers, and the Department to address emerging AI capabilities, privacy, and national security challenges. OpenAI emphasizes its commitment to democratic oversight and responsible AI deployment in national defense contexts.

items.title: OpenAI and Amazon announce $50 billion strategic partnership to integrate OpenAI Frontier and Stateful Runtime Environment with AWS infrastructure [ ! ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI and Amazon Web Services (AWS) have formed a multi-year strategic partnership that includes Amazon investing $50 billion in OpenAI. The collaboration will bring OpenAI's Frontier platform and a new Stateful Runtime Environment to AWS, enabling enterprises to build, deploy, and manage AI agents and applications at scale. AWS will be the exclusive third-party cloud provider for OpenAI Frontier, which offers enterprise-grade AI agent management with governance and security. OpenAI will also consume approximately 2 gigawatts of AWS Trainium compute capacity to support these AI workloads. Additionally, the companies will develop customized AI models for Amazon's customer-facing applications, enhancing AI capabilities across Amazon's services.

items.title: OpenAI and Amazon launch Stateful Runtime Environment for Agents in Amazon Bedrock to enable persistent, multi-step AI workflows with AWS-native governance [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI and Amazon have introduced the Stateful Runtime Environment for Agents within Amazon Bedrock, designed to support persistent orchestration, memory, and secure execution for complex multi-step AI workflows. This environment runs natively on AWS infrastructure and is optimized for agentic workflows requiring state, reliability, and governance for production use. The new runtime simplifies deploying AI agents by managing state across multiple steps, tool invocations, and approvals, reducing the development burden of building orchestration layers. It enables faster time to production for workflows like customer support, sales operations, IT automation, and finance processes, while complying with existing AWS security and governance frameworks.

items.title: OpenAI announces $110 billion investment round at $730 billion valuation with $30 billion from SoftBank, $30 billion from NVIDIA, and $50 billion from Amazon [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI announced a $110 billion investment round at a $730 billion pre-money valuation, including $30 billion each from SoftBank and NVIDIA, and $50 billion from Amazon. The company also signed a strategic partnership with Amazon and secured next-generation inference compute with NVIDIA to expand its global reach and infrastructure. OpenAI highlighted growth in its products, with Codex users tripling to 1.6 million weekly and ChatGPT reaching over 900 million weekly active users and 50 million consumer subscribers. The funding aims to support scaling AI infrastructure and products to meet increasing demand and advance the company's mission to ensure AGI benefits all of humanity.

items.title: OpenAI and Microsoft reaffirm their ongoing partnership in AI research, engineering, and product development with unchanged terms and exclusive Azure cloud hosting [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI and Microsoft issued a joint statement reaffirming their partnership that began in 2019, emphasizing continued collaboration across AI research, engineering, and product development. They confirmed that recent announcements about OpenAI's new funding and partners do not alter the existing terms of their relationship, including Microsoft's exclusive license to OpenAI's intellectual property and Azure's role as the exclusive cloud provider for stateless OpenAI APIs. The statement clarified that OpenAI's first-party products will remain hosted on Azure and that the revenue-sharing and AGI definitions remain unchanged. The partnership is designed to allow both companies to pursue independent opportunities while maintaining close collaboration to advance responsible AI development and deliver AI tools globally.

items.title: OpenAI updates mental health safety features including parental controls, trusted contacts, and distress detection amid coordinated California litigation [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has provided an update on its mental health-related safety efforts, highlighting the introduction of parental controls, upcoming trusted contact features, and improved detection of emotional distress in ChatGPT. These measures aim to support users and enhance safety during sensitive interactions. The company is also addressing ongoing mental health-related litigation consolidated into a single proceeding in California, with new cases expected. OpenAI emphasized its commitment to handling these cases with care and transparency while continuing to improve its technology in collaboration with mental health experts.

items.title: Google DeepMind launches Nano Banana 2 image model combining Nano Banana Pro's advanced features with Gemini Flash's speed across Google products [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind has introduced Nano Banana 2, a new AI image generation model that merges the advanced capabilities of Nano Banana Pro with the rapid processing speed of Gemini Flash. This model enables faster image creation and editing with enhanced subject consistency, precise instruction following, and production-ready specifications, and is being integrated into Google products such as Gemini, Search, and Ads. Nano Banana 2 leverages real-time world knowledge and improved visual fidelity to produce photorealistic images with accurate text rendering and localization. It supports maintaining character and object consistency across workflows and offers flexible aspect ratios and resolutions up to 4K. Additionally, Google is enhancing AI-generated image identification through updates to its SynthID technology and C2PA Content Credentials.

items.title: OpenAI and Pacific Northwest National Laboratory launch DraftNEPABench to evaluate AI agents accelerating federal infrastructure permitting, showing up to 15% drafting time reduction [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI and the U.S. Department of Energy's Pacific Northwest National Laboratory have partnered to create DraftNEPABench, a benchmark assessing how AI coding agents can speed up federal permitting processes under the National Environmental Policy Act. The benchmark indicates that AI tools could reduce drafting time for environmental impact statements by up to 15%, potentially modernizing infrastructure reviews across 18 federal agencies. The collaboration involved 19 subject matter experts and focused on tasks such as synthesizing technical documents, verifying facts, and drafting structured reports that meet legal and regulatory standards. By leveraging AI models with command-line interface capabilities, the project demonstrates how these tools can assist government workers by handling time-consuming drafting tasks, allowing them to focus on oversight and complex decision-making. While the benchmark evaluates AI performance on specific drafting tasks with available context, it does not cover the full complexity of real-world permitting decisions. The initiative aims to improve efficiency in federal permitting workflows and supports OpenAI's commitment to providing public servants with effective AI tools.

items.title: OpenAI and Figma launch Codex integration enabling seamless code-to-design workflows for faster product iteration [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI and Figma have introduced a new integration connecting OpenAI's Codex directly with Figma's design platform, allowing users to move fluidly between code and design. This integration supports a roundtrip workflow where teams can generate Figma designs from code and implement designs back into code, enhancing collaboration and speeding up product development. The integration uses Figma's MCP Server, an open-source standard that connects AI agents with external tools, enabling users to bring details from Figma Design, Figma Make, or FigJam into Codex and vice versa. This partnership builds on previous collaborations, including Figma's use of OpenAI models and the ChatGPT app integration, aiming to lower barriers between design and engineering roles and improve creative iteration.

items.title: OpenAI publishes February 2026 report on detecting and preventing malicious AI uses combining models with websites and social platforms [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI's February 2026 threat report analyzes how malicious actors integrate AI models with websites and social media to conduct harmful activities. The report includes case studies demonstrating that threat actors often use multiple AI models and platforms in coordinated workflows rather than relying on a single tool or channel. The report builds on two years of research into AI abuse, highlighting the evolving tactics of threat actors and providing insights to help industry and society better identify and defend against these threats. It emphasizes the importance of understanding the combined use of AI and traditional digital tools in malicious operations.

items.title: OpenAI appoints Arvind KC as Chief People Officer to lead people operations and culture amid AI-driven work transformation [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has appointed Arvind KC as Chief People Officer to support the company's growth and adapt its people systems as AI reshapes work. KC brings experience from Roblox, Google, Palantir, and Meta, combining engineering and leadership expertise to enhance hiring, onboarding, and collaboration processes. His role includes ensuring OpenAI's people policies and systems align with the company's ambitions while preserving its culture. KC will also guide how roles evolve and skills develop in an AI-enabled workplace, with plans to share insights to help the broader economy adapt to AI-driven changes in work.

items.title: OpenAI stops using SWE-bench Verified for coding capability evaluation due to test flaws and training data contamination, recommends SWE-bench Pro instead [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has ceased evaluating models with SWE-bench Verified, citing significant issues including flawed test cases that reject correct solutions and training data overlap that allows models to memorize benchmark problems. These problems undermine the benchmark's ability to accurately measure real-world autonomous software engineering progress at current model performance levels. SWE-bench Verified was created in 2024 to improve on the original SWE-bench by filtering out problematic tasks, but recent analysis found that over half of audited problems still have faulty tests and that all tested frontier models had likely seen some benchmark problems during training. OpenAI is developing new uncontaminated evaluations and advises the research community to report results using SWE-bench Pro until better benchmarks are available.

items.title: OpenAI launches Frontier Alliance Partners with BCG, McKinsey, Accenture, and Capgemini to help enterprises scale AI coworker deployments [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI announced the Frontier Alliance Partners program, partnering with consulting firms Boston Consulting Group, McKinsey & Company, Accenture, and Capgemini to assist enterprises in moving AI projects from pilots to production. These partners will support strategy, workflow redesign, system integration, and change management to enable secure, scalable deployment of AI agents across organizations. The alliances combine OpenAI's Frontier platform and engineering expertise with the partners' experience in enterprise transformation, AI integration, and operational change. Each partner is investing in dedicated teams certified on OpenAI technology to deliver end-to-end AI coworker solutions, aiming to drive measurable business impact and adoption at scale.

items.title: OpenAI shares AI model's proof attempts on First Proof math challenge, with five problems likely solved correctly [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has released its AI model's proof attempts for the First Proof challenge, a research-level math competition designed to test AI's ability to produce checkable proofs on expert problems. The model tackled all 10 problems, with expert feedback suggesting at least five proofs have a high chance of correctness, while others remain under review or were found incorrect after further analysis. The First Proof problems require sustained, domain-specific reasoning and have challenged human experts for years. OpenAI's model was trained with limited human supervision and iterative prompting, improving its performance over time. This effort builds on prior AI achievements in math and science reasoning, and OpenAI plans to engage further with the research community to refine evaluation methods and enhance future models' capabilities.

items.title: Google DeepMind launches Gemini 3.1 Pro AI model with enhanced reasoning for complex tasks, available via API, Vertex AI, Gemini app, and NotebookLM [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind has introduced Gemini 3.1 Pro, an upgraded AI model designed to handle complex tasks requiring advanced reasoning beyond simple answers. The model is rolling out across consumer and developer platforms including the Gemini API, Vertex AI, the Gemini app, and NotebookLM, aiming to improve problem-solving capabilities in various applications. Gemini 3.1 Pro demonstrates significant improvements in reasoning benchmarks, achieving a verified score of 77.1% on the ARC-AGI-2 test, more than doubling the performance of its predecessor. It supports advanced functions such as generating scalable animated SVGs, synthesizing complex system data into user-friendly dashboards, and creating interactive and creative coding projects. The model is currently in preview to gather feedback and further refine agentic workflows before general availability.

items.title: OpenAI commits $7.5M to The Alignment Project to fund independent AI alignment research and enhance global AGI safety efforts [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has pledged $7.5 million to The Alignment Project, a global fund managed by the UK AI Security Institute, to support independent research aimed at mitigating safety and security risks from misaligned AI. This funding is part of a broader effort to diversify and scale AI alignment research beyond frontier labs. The grant contributes to a total fund exceeding £27 million, supporting a wide range of projects in fields such as computational complexity, economic theory, cognitive science, and cryptography. The Alignment Project operates with an established cross-sector coalition and an expert-reviewed grantmaking process, aiming to foster a robust, independent ecosystem that complements OpenAI's internal alignment and safety research as AI capabilities advance.

items.title: OpenAI launches OpenAI for India initiative with Tata Group to build local AI infrastructure, expand enterprise AI adoption, and advance workforce skills [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI announced OpenAI for India at the India AI Impact Summit 2026, partnering with Tata Group to develop sovereign AI infrastructure, accelerate AI adoption in enterprises, and enhance workforce training across India. The initiative aims to support over 100 million weekly ChatGPT users in India by building local data centers, deploying ChatGPT Enterprise to Tata employees, and expanding AI certification programs. As part of the effort, OpenAI will use Tata Consultancy Services' HyperVault data centers to run advanced AI models securely within India, meeting data residency and compliance requirements. The partnership includes plans to scale data center capacity from 100 megawatts to potentially 1 gigawatt and to provide AI education licenses to institutions such as the Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad and All India Institute of Medical Sciences. OpenAI also plans to open new offices in Mumbai and Bengaluru to strengthen its local presence.

items.title: Google DeepMind launches Lyria 3 music generation in Gemini app, enabling 30-second AI-created tracks from text or images with SynthID watermark [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind has integrated its latest music generation model, Lyria 3, into the Gemini app, allowing users to create 30-second custom music tracks by describing ideas or uploading images. The app generates tracks with lyrics, creative control options, and custom cover art, embedding an imperceptible SynthID watermark to identify AI-generated content. Lyria 3 improves on previous models by automatically generating lyrics, offering more control over style and tempo, and producing more complex music. The feature is available in beta for users aged 18 and older in multiple languages, with higher usage limits for subscribers. Users can also verify if audio was created by Google AI through the app's verification tools.

items.title: OpenAI and Paradigm launch EVMbench to benchmark AI agents detecting, patching, and exploiting smart contract vulnerabilities using 117 curated cases [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI and Paradigm introduced EVMbench, a benchmark designed to evaluate AI agents' capabilities in detecting, patching, and exploiting high-severity vulnerabilities in smart contracts. The benchmark includes 117 vulnerabilities from 40 audits and scenarios from the Tempo blockchain, focusing on payment-oriented smart contract code. EVMbench tests AI agents across three modes: detecting vulnerabilities, patching contracts without breaking functionality, and exploiting contracts in a sandboxed environment. The benchmark uses a Rust-based harness for reproducible evaluation and has shown that newer AI models like GPT-5.3-Codex significantly outperform earlier versions in exploit tasks, though detection and patching remain challenging. While EVMbench provides a realistic assessment environment, it does not cover all complexities of real-world smart contract security, such as timing-dependent exploits or multi-chain scenarios. The benchmark aims to encourage defensive AI use in auditing and strengthening deployed contracts securing billions in crypto assets.

items.title: Google DeepMind launches National Partnerships for AI in India to advance AI-driven science and education [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind has introduced the National Partnerships for AI initiative in India to enhance scientific research and education through artificial intelligence. This program aims to scale AI applications across various scientific and educational domains within the country.

items.title: OpenAI's GPT-5.2 proposes and proves a new gluon amplitude formula in theoretical physics, verified by academic collaborators [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI's GPT-5.2 generated a new formula for a gluon scattering amplitude previously assumed to be zero under certain conditions. This formula was formally proved by an internal model and verified by physicists from institutions including the Institute for Advanced Study, Vanderbilt University, and Harvard University, marking a novel discovery in particle physics. The research identifies a specific momentum configuration called the half-collinear regime where the gluon amplitude does not vanish, challenging standard textbook assumptions. GPT-5.2 simplified complex expressions and conjectured a general formula, which was then rigorously proven and checked against established physics relations. The work opens avenues for further studies, including extensions to graviton amplitudes and other particle interactions.

items.title: OpenAI launches Lockdown Mode and Elevated Risk labels in ChatGPT to enhance security against prompt injection and data exfiltration [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced Lockdown Mode and Elevated Risk labels in ChatGPT to help organizations and users defend against prompt injection attacks and AI-driven data exfiltration. Lockdown Mode is an optional security setting that restricts ChatGPT's access to external web and app features, reducing potential attack vectors for sensitive information leakage. Initially available for ChatGPT Enterprise and specialized business plans, it is rolling out to personal accounts as well. These features complement existing security measures like sandboxing, URL-based data exfiltration protections, and enterprise controls, aiming to provide stronger safeguards for users handling sensitive data.

items.title: OpenAI releases GABRIEL, an open-source GPT-based toolkit to convert qualitative text and images into quantitative data for social science research at scale [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI's Economic Research Team has launched GABRIEL, an open-source Python library that uses GPT to transform unstructured qualitative data such as text and images into measurable quantitative scores. The tool is designed to help economists, social scientists, and data scientists analyze large datasets more efficiently by automating repetitive labeling tasks. GABRIEL enables researchers to specify measurement criteria in natural language and apply them consistently across thousands or millions of documents, facilitating studies of scientific papers, curricula, historical records, and customer reviews. It also includes features like dataset merging, deduplication, passage coding, theory ideation, and text deidentification to support research workflows. The toolkit aims to make qualitative data more accessible and accelerate social science research by reducing manual effort.

items.title: OpenAI builds real-time access system combining rate limits and credits to scale Codex and Sora usage [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI developed a real-time access engine that integrates rate limits, usage tracking, and credit balances to allow continuous use of Codex and Sora beyond initial rate limits. This hybrid system enforces limits while enabling pay-as-you-go access without disrupting user experience. The system treats access as a layered decision process, smoothly transitioning from rate limits to credit consumption in real time. OpenAI built this solution in-house to ensure immediate correctness, transparency, and trust, avoiding delays and inconsistencies common in third-party billing platforms. The distributed usage and balance system tracks per-user usage and credit balances synchronously, making accurate, auditable access decisions for each request. This approach supports scaling demand while maintaining fairness and system performance for Codex and Sora users.

items.title: Google updates Gemini 3 Deep Think to enhance problem-solving in science, research, and engineering, available to AI Ultra subscribers and via early access API [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Google has released a major upgrade to Gemini 3 Deep Think, its specialized reasoning mode designed to tackle complex challenges in science, research, and engineering. The updated version is now accessible to Google AI Ultra subscribers through the Gemini app and is available for early access via the Gemini API to select researchers, engineers, and enterprises. The upgrade was developed in collaboration with scientists and researchers to address problems with incomplete data and no single correct solution, blending deep scientific knowledge with practical engineering applications. Early users have applied Deep Think to identify subtle errors in advanced mathematics, optimize semiconductor material fabrication, and accelerate physical component design. The system also achieves top-tier performance on rigorous academic benchmarks in mathematics, physics, chemistry, and competitive programming. By enabling tasks such as converting sketches into 3D-printable models, Deep Think aims to support real-world engineering and research needs. Google is inviting interested parties to join the early access program to explore the capabilities of Deep Think through the Gemini API.

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark, a real-time coding model with 128k context and 15x faster generation, available as a research preview for ChatGPT Pro users [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark, a smaller, ultra-fast version of GPT-5.3-Codex designed for real-time coding tasks. The model delivers over 1000 tokens per second with a 128k context window and is currently available as a research preview for ChatGPT Pro users, running on Cerebras' low-latency AI accelerator hardware. Codex-Spark focuses on interactive coding workflows, enabling developers to make targeted edits and see immediate results. OpenAI has also implemented end-to-end latency improvements across its inference stack, reducing response times significantly. The preview aims to gather developer feedback while OpenAI and Cerebras work on scaling datacenter capacity and refining the user experience.

items.title: OpenAI builds internal beta software product with zero manually-written code using Codex agents over five months [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI's engineering team developed an internal beta software product entirely generated by Codex agents without any manually-written code, completing about a million lines of code in five months. The product has daily internal users and external alpha testers, demonstrating significant engineering velocity improvements by shifting human roles from coding to designing environments and specifying intent for AI agents. The development began with an empty repository in August 2025, with Codex generating all initial scaffolding and subsequent code, tests, documentation, and tooling. A small team of engineers focused on enabling and guiding Codex agents through prompts and iterative reviews, pushing most review tasks to agent-to-agent interactions. This approach redefined engineering work to emphasize system design and agent capability enhancement rather than direct coding. As the project progressed, human quality assurance became the bottleneck, leading the team to improve application legibility for Codex by integrating tools like Chrome DevTools Protocol and enabling the AI to launch and test app instances per change. This experiment highlights a shift toward agent-first software development, maximizing human time and attention by leveraging AI for code generation and maintenance.

items.title: Google DeepMind launches Gemini Deep Think, achieving gold-medal standard at the International Mathematical Olympiad to accelerate math and science discovery [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind has introduced an advanced version of its Gemini AI, called Deep Think, which has officially reached a gold-medal standard at the International Mathematical Olympiad. This milestone highlights the AI's growing capability to assist in complex mathematical and scientific problem-solving. The achievement demonstrates Deep Think's potential to accelerate research and discovery across various scientific fields by tackling challenging problems traditionally solved by human experts. This development marks a significant step in applying AI to advance knowledge in mathematics and science.

items.title: OpenAI deploys custom ChatGPT on GenAI.mil, the Department of War's secure AI platform for 3 million military and civilian personnel [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI for Government announced the deployment of a custom ChatGPT on GenAI.mil, the Department of War's secure enterprise AI platform used by 3 million civilian and military personnel. The system operates within authorized government cloud infrastructure with built-in safety controls and does not use processed data to train OpenAI's public models, ensuring data security. ChatGPT on GenAI.mil is designed to assist with tasks such as summarizing policy documents, drafting procurement materials, generating reports, and supporting research and mission workflows. This deployment builds on OpenAI's existing collaborations with the Pentagon and aims to provide reliable AI tools that enhance readiness and mission execution while maintaining strict safeguards for sensitive government data.

items.title: OpenAI outlines its approach to localizing AI models to respect languages, laws, and cultures while maintaining global safety standards [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has detailed its strategy for adapting its advanced AI models to local contexts worldwide, ensuring they operate in local languages, comply with regional laws, and reflect cultural norms without compromising safety. This approach supports governments seeking sovereign AI systems tailored to their specific needs rather than simple translations. The company is piloting localized versions of ChatGPT, such as an educational model for Estonian students, and emphasizes adherence to its Model Spec, which enforces safety and human rights principles globally. OpenAI commits to transparency about content modifications due to legal or cultural requirements and plans to continue sharing insights as it expands its OpenAI for Countries initiative.

items.title: OpenAI and Ginkgo Bioworks use GPT-5 in an autonomous lab to reduce cell-free protein synthesis costs by 40% through closed-loop experimentation [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI partnered with Ginkgo Bioworks to connect GPT-5 to a cloud-based automated lab, enabling closed-loop experimentation that optimized cell-free protein synthesis (CFPS) and cut protein production costs by 40%. The system tested over 36,000 unique reaction compositions across six rounds, improving reagent cost efficiency by 57% and discovering more robust reaction formulations. CFPS allows protein production without living cells, facilitating rapid prototyping and testing in biology, but it is complex and costly to optimize due to many interacting biochemical components. By automating experiment design, execution, and analysis, the GPT-5-driven system accelerated iteration and overcame traditional bottlenecks in CFPS optimization. This advancement could lower barriers for protein-based research and industrial applications by making protein synthesis faster and more affordable, potentially accelerating development of medicines, diagnostics, and industrial enzymes.

items.title: OpenAI launches Trusted Access for Cyber, a trust-based framework to expand access to advanced cyber defense models while enhancing safeguards against misuse [ * ] [ ◼ ]
