items.content_text: OpenAI introduced Trusted Access for Cyber, a new identity and trust-based framework designed to provide controlled access to its most advanced cyber-capable AI models, including GPT-5.3-Codex. This initiative aims to accelerate defensive cybersecurity efforts by ensuring these powerful tools are used responsibly by verified users and organizations focused on protection and prevention. The framework includes identity verification for individual users and enterprise-level trusted access, alongside automated monitoring to detect suspicious activity. OpenAI is also committing $10 million in API credits through its Cybersecurity Grant Program to support teams with proven records in vulnerability identification and remediation. This approach seeks to balance expanding access to frontier cyber capabilities with reducing risks of misuse such as data exfiltration or malware deployment.

items.title: OpenAI launches Frontier, an enterprise platform to build, deploy, and manage AI agents with shared context, onboarding, permissions, and governance [ ! ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced Frontier, a new platform designed to help enterprises build, deploy, and manage AI agents that work across business systems with shared context, onboarding, and governance. The platform aims to address challenges enterprises face in scaling AI agents by providing tools that mirror human onboarding, learning, and permission management. Frontier integrates with existing enterprise systems and supports multi-cloud environments without requiring replatforming, enabling AI agents to operate across various applications and workflows. Early adopters include HP, Intuit, Oracle, State Farm, Thermo Fisher, and Uber, with others like BBVA, Cisco, and T-Mobile piloting the platform to enhance complex AI-driven tasks.

items.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.3-Codex, an advanced agentic coding model combining GPT-5.2-Codex's coding performance with GPT-5.2's reasoning and professional knowledge capabilities [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has launched GPT-5.3-Codex, its most capable agentic coding model to date, which integrates the advanced coding skills of GPT-5.2-Codex with enhanced reasoning and professional knowledge from GPT-5.2. This model supports long-running tasks involving research, tool use, and complex execution, allowing interactive steering without losing context. GPT-5.3-Codex is classified as high capability in biology and cybersecurity domains, prompting OpenAI to deploy corresponding safeguards under its Preparedness Framework. While definitive evidence of high capability in cybersecurity is not confirmed, OpenAI is taking a precautionary approach with layered safety measures to prevent misuse while facilitating access for cyber defenders.

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-5.3-Codex, a faster agentic coding model with enhanced reasoning and professional knowledge for complex, long-running software tasks [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI introduced GPT-5.3-Codex, its most capable coding agent to date, combining advanced coding performance with general reasoning to support extended, real-world technical work. The model is 25% faster than its predecessor and can handle tasks involving research, tool use, and complex execution while maintaining context during interaction. GPT-5.3-Codex achieved state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks including SWE-Bench Pro and Terminal-Bench, demonstrating strong coding and agentic capabilities across several programming languages. It also excels in web development, autonomously building and iterating complex games and applications over long periods. Beyond coding, the model supports a wide range of professional software lifecycle tasks such as debugging, deployment, writing product requirements, and data analysis, matching previous models on professional knowledge work evaluations.

items.title: OpenAI details the development of the Codex App Server, a bidirectional JSON-RPC API enabling integration of the Codex coding agent across multiple platforms [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI explains how it built the Codex App Server to unify the Codex coding agent experience across various interfaces including web apps, CLI, IDE extensions, and a macOS app. The App Server acts as a client-friendly, bidirectional JSON-RPC API that supports streaming progress, tool use, approvals, and diffs, allowing consistent interaction with the Codex harness. The article outlines the App Server's origin as a way to reuse the Codex harness across products and its evolution into a stable protocol supporting multiple clients such as JetBrains, Xcode, and the Codex desktop app. It describes the architecture involving thread lifecycle management, configuration, authentication, and tool execution, emphasizing the App Server's role in hosting Codex core threads and managing communication between clients and the agent logic. OpenAI also shares insights on how the App Server enables embedding Codex capabilities into different products to enhance software development workflows, offering guidance for developers aiming to implement Codex as a code reviewer, SRE agent, or coding assistant.

items.title: OpenAI outlines Sora feed philosophy focusing on creativity, user control, connection, and safety with personalized recommendations and parental controls [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI detailed the philosophy behind its Sora feed, emphasizing support for creativity, user control over content preferences, fostering connections, and balancing safety with freedom of expression. The feed uses personalized recommendation algorithms that consider user activity, engagement signals, and safety criteria to inspire creativity while maintaining robust guardrails against harmful content. The system includes parental controls allowing parents to manage feed personalization and continuous scrolling for teens. Safety measures involve automated and human review processes to enforce content guidelines, aiming to prevent unsafe or inappropriate material while encouraging creative expression within a secure environment.

items.title: OpenAI and Snowflake announce $200 million multi-year partnership to integrate OpenAI models into Snowflake's enterprise data platform [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI and Snowflake have entered a $200 million multi-year partnership to embed OpenAI's advanced models, including GPT-5.2, directly into Snowflake's data and AI platform. This integration enables Snowflake customers to build AI agents and generate insights from their enterprise data using tools like Snowflake Cortex AI and Snowflake Intelligence without coding. The partnership allows enterprises across various industries to apply AI-driven reasoning and analysis to their trusted data securely and at scale. Snowflake customers can call OpenAI models directly from SQL to analyze diverse data types, enhancing decision-making and operational workflows while maintaining strong security and governance standards.

items.title: OpenAI launches Codex app for macOS as a command center to manage multiple AI coding agents and parallel workflows [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced the Codex app for macOS, designed to help developers manage multiple AI agents simultaneously, run parallel tasks, and collaborate on long-running software projects. The app supports isolated work environments for agents, integrates with existing tools, and extends Codex capabilities beyond code generation through customizable skills.

items.title: Google launches Project Genie for AI Ultra subscribers in the U.S. to create and explore interactive, AI-generated worlds using text and images [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google has introduced Project Genie, an experimental research prototype available to Google AI Ultra subscribers in the U.S., that enables users to create, explore, and remix interactive virtual worlds. Powered by the Genie 3 model, the platform generates real-time paths and environments based on user input through text prompts and images. Project Genie allows users to sketch worlds, define character perspectives, and navigate dynamic environments that simulate physics and interactions. While the prototype has limitations in realism and character control, Google plans to expand access and improve the technology as part of its broader research into general AI systems and immersive world modeling.

items.title: OpenAI launches in-house AI data agent using GPT-5 and Codex to analyze internal datasets and deliver insights across teams [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has developed a custom internal AI data agent powered by GPT-5.2 and Codex to help employees quickly explore and analyze its extensive data platform, which includes over 600 petabytes across 70,000 datasets. The agent enables users from various departments to ask complex questions in natural language and receive reliable insights within minutes, reducing the need for manual data exploration and SQL debugging. The agent integrates with existing tools like Slack, web interfaces, IDEs, and OpenAI's internal ChatGPT app, and it continuously improves through a self-learning memory system. It handles the full analytics workflow by discovering data, running queries, and synthesizing findings while reasoning through problems and adjusting its approach autonomously to ensure accurate results.

items.title: OpenAI to retire GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1 mini, and o4-mini models from ChatGPT on February 13, 2026 [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI announced it will retire several older ChatGPT models, including GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1 mini, and OpenAI o4-mini, on February 13, 2026, alongside the previously planned retirement of GPT-5 Instant and Thinking versions. The API will not be affected by these changes at this time. The decision follows user feedback that influenced improvements in GPT-5.1 and GPT-5.2, which now offer enhanced personality, creative ideation support, and customization options for ChatGPT's responses. OpenAI noted that the vast majority of users have already shifted to GPT-5.2, with only 0.1% still using GPT-4o daily. The company plans ongoing updates to improve ChatGPT's personality, creativity, and user experience while expanding user choice and maintaining appropriate safeguards.

items.title: Taisei Corporation rolls out ChatGPT Enterprise to enhance talent development with AI across its workforce [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Taisei Corporation, a leading Japanese construction company, has implemented ChatGPT Enterprise as a central part of its talent development strategy, focusing on expanding employee potential through AI rather than just improving productivity. The HR team led the rollout using a "Middle Out" approach that combines leadership direction with frontline engagement, supported by training programs, internal events, and governance measures to ensure safe and confident AI use. Since the rollout, Taisei has seen high adoption rates, significant time savings per employee, and thousands of custom GPTs created, reflecting meaningful changes in how employees work with AI. The company aims to foster a culture where AI use is integrated into daily work and plans to share its human-centered AI model with the broader construction industry and society.

items.title: OpenAI launches €500,000 EMEA Youth & Wellbeing Grant to fund NGOs and researchers focused on AI's impact on youth safety and wellbeing [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced the EMEA Youth & Wellbeing Grant, a €500,000 funding program aimed at supporting NGOs and research organizations working to improve youth safety, wellbeing, and development in the context of artificial intelligence across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The grant targets projects that produce practical tools, independent research, or initiatives that help young people benefit safely from AI. The program offers grants typically ranging from €25,000 to €100,000, with multi-year awards possible for larger efforts. Eligible applicants must be operational NGOs or research institutions registered in the EMEA region, focusing on youth safety or AI impacts on minors. Applications for 2026 have closed, and finalists have been selected, with projects expected to begin in the second or third quarter of 2026.

items.title: OpenAI launches EU Economic Blueprint 2.0 with new AI adoption data, SME training program, and youth safety grant to boost AI use across Europe [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced the EU Economic Blueprint 2.0, featuring updated data on AI usage in Europe and initiatives to accelerate AI adoption among individuals, businesses, and governments. The plan includes a program to train 20,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in AI skills, supported by Booking.com, and a €500,000 grant to support research on youth safety and wellbeing in the digital age. The Blueprint highlights disparities in AI usage across EU member states and emphasizes the need for national AI strategies, education frameworks, and skills accreditation to close the capability gap. OpenAI also plans to expand partnerships with European governments through its OpenAI for Europe initiative, focusing on education, health, and AI skills training to support national AI priorities.

items.title: OpenAI implements safeguards to prevent data leaks when AI agents fetch URLs by verifying links against a public web index [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced measures to protect user data when AI agents interact with web links, addressing risks of data exfiltration through URLs and prompt injection attacks. The system checks whether a URL has been previously observed on the public web before allowing automatic fetching, reducing the chance of leaking private information. This approach avoids relying solely on trusted site lists, which can be bypassed through redirects or cause user friction. When a URL is unverified, users receive warnings and must explicitly approve access, maintaining control over potentially sensitive data exposure. These safeguards focus on preventing quiet data leaks via URLs but do not guarantee the trustworthiness of web content or protection against social engineering.

items.title: PVH Corp adopts ChatGPT Enterprise to integrate AI across fashion design, supply chain, and consumer engagement for Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: PVH Corp, the parent company of Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger, announced it will use ChatGPT Enterprise to embed AI throughout its global operations, aiming to enhance creativity, efficiency, and data-driven decision-making in fashion design, planning, and consumer engagement. The company plans to apply AI to product creation, demand forecasting, inventory management, and personalized marketing while maintaining strong data security and governance standards. PVH will develop custom AI capabilities combining OpenAI's models with its expertise in fashion and supply chain management to support its long-term growth strategy, the PVH+ Plan. This collaboration seeks to transform the fashion industry by integrating advanced AI with human creativity to improve brand-building and operational agility at scale.

items.title: OpenAI launches Prism, a free LaTeX-native workspace with GPT-5.2 integration for scientific writing and collaboration [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced Prism, a free, AI-native workspace designed to streamline scientific writing and collaboration by integrating GPT-5.2 directly into a LaTeX-based environment. Prism allows researchers to draft, revise, and manage papers with real-time collaboration and AI-assisted reasoning, equations, citations, and literature search all in one cloud-based platform. Built on the foundation of the acquired Crixet platform, Prism supports unlimited collaborators without seat limits or local software installation, aiming to reduce manual overhead and improve workflow efficiency. It is available now to anyone with a ChatGPT personal account, with plans to extend access to organizational ChatGPT Business, Enterprise, and Education users.

items.title: TRUSTBANK launches Choice AI using OpenAI models to personalize Furusato Nozei gift recommendations in Japan [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: TRUSTBANK partnered with Recursive to develop Choice AI, an AI-powered feature that simplifies the discovery of thank-you gifts in Japan's Furusato Nozei hometown tax donation program. The system uses OpenAI's GPT-4.1 series models and a multiagent architecture to provide personalized conversational recommendations based on user preferences and donation intent. Furusato Nozei allows taxpayers to support rural municipalities by donating a portion of their taxes in exchange for local specialty gifts, but navigating the extensive catalog of options has been challenging. TRUSTBANK's Choice AI addresses this by dynamically routing user queries to specialized agents that tailor recommendations, improving the user experience especially for first-time donors and helping them make informed decisions within their donation limits.

items.title: Indeed uses AI to enhance job search and recruiting with new features like Career Scout and Talent Scout, aiming to improve matching and efficiency for employers and job seekers [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Indeed's Chief Revenue Officer Maggie Hulce discusses how the company integrates AI across its platform to simplify and speed up hiring processes for both job seekers and employers. The platform employs over a hundred AI-powered features, including personalized job recommendations and candidate matching, developed in collaboration with OpenAI. Recent launches include AI agents Career Scout and Talent Scout, designed to assist job seekers and recruiters respectively. Indeed emphasizes responsible AI use, ensuring employers remain the final decision-makers. Internally, AI adoption has increased productivity by automating repetitive tasks, allowing teams to focus on strategic work. The company supports AI fluency through training programs, internal sharing, and incentives to foster innovation and confidence among employees.

items.title: OpenAI details Codex CLI agent loop orchestrating models, tools, and prompts for software tasks [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI explains the core agent loop in Codex CLI, which manages interactions between users, language models, and tools to perform software changes efficiently and safely on local machines. The loop involves generating prompts, querying models, executing tool calls, and iterating until a final user response or action is produced. The article outlines how Codex CLI handles tokenization, inference, and context window management to maintain conversation history and tool execution within model limits. It also highlights that the agent's output includes both assistant messages and code modifications on the user's machine, marking the completion of each interaction cycle.

items.title: OpenAI scales PostgreSQL to support 800 million ChatGPT users with millions of queries per second using replicas, caching, and workload isolation [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has scaled its PostgreSQL database to handle the demands of 800 million ChatGPT users by supporting millions of queries per second through a single primary instance and nearly 50 read replicas globally. The company optimized its infrastructure with caching, rate limiting, and workload isolation to manage rapid growth and maintain performance. Despite PostgreSQL's limitations with write-heavy workloads due to its multiversion concurrency control, OpenAI mitigated write pressure by migrating write-heavy workloads to sharded systems like Azure Cosmos DB and restricting new tables on PostgreSQL. The single-primary architecture remains effective for their read-heavy workloads, providing sufficient capacity for ongoing growth without immediate plans for sharding PostgreSQL.

items.title: Praktika uses GPT-4.1 and GPT-5.2 to power adaptive AI tutors that personalize language lessons and track learner progress for real-world fluency [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Praktika has developed a language learning app that employs GPT-4.1 and GPT-5.2 to create AI tutors capable of adapting lessons based on individual learner behavior, goals, and conversation context. The system includes multiple AI agents that simulate real tutors by monitoring progress, adjusting lesson plans, and responding dynamically during conversations to improve fluency and confidence. The app's multi-agent architecture features a Lesson Agent for interactive tutoring, a Student Progress Agent that tracks language performance, and a Learning Planning Agent that personalizes long-term learning strategies. Praktika's approach emphasizes real-time memory retrieval and advanced speech recognition to make AI conversations feel natural and responsive, helping users bridge the gap between classroom learning and practical language use in work and daily life.

items.title: OpenAI publishes data-driven report on ChatGPT usage and adoption patterns across industries and departments at work [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI released a report analyzing how ChatGPT is used by workers across various industries and job functions, highlighting adoption trends, common tasks, and departmental usage patterns. The report draws on anonymized usage data combined with independent studies to provide insights into AI integration in the workplace. The analysis shows rapid adoption of ChatGPT since its 2022 launch, with over a quarter of U.S. workers using it for work-related tasks. Industries like IT, finance, and manufacturing lead in adoption, while sectors such as retail and healthcare show slower uptake due to factors like compliance and workforce composition. Early usage focuses on writing, research, programming, and analysis, reflecting ChatGPT's versatility in supporting core workflows.

items.title: OpenAI Blog: Higgsfield uses GPT-4.1, GPT-5, and Sora 2 to generate 4 million cinematic social videos daily from simple inputs [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Higgsfield is a generative media platform that transforms simple inputs like product links or images into short-form, cinematic social videos using OpenAI's GPT-4.1, GPT-5 for planning, and Sora 2 for video creation. The system generates about 4 million videos per day, applying a cinematic logic layer to interpret creative intent and produce structured, trend-aligned content without requiring users to provide technical video instructions. The platform operationalizes virality by analyzing social video patterns to create and update a library of video presets that guide pacing, narrative, and camera logic, resulting in a 150% increase in share velocity and triple cognitive capture compared to earlier methods. Features like Click-to-Ad enable users to generate social-ready ads from product pages quickly, supporting high-volume, trend-responsive video production for marketing teams.

items.title: OpenAI outlines global AI adoption gaps and launches initiatives to help countries boost productivity through advanced AI use in education, health, and public services [ * ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI's new report highlights significant disparities in advanced AI adoption across more than 70 countries, revealing that some nations use AI's complex capabilities up to three times more per person than others, regardless of income levels. This capability overhang risks widening economic and technological divides as countries that adopt AI more deeply gain productivity and innovation advantages. To address this, OpenAI is expanding its OpenAI for Countries program in 2026 with initiatives focused on integrating AI into education, health, disaster response, cybersecurity, and startup support. The program partners with governments to tailor AI adoption strategies that improve workforce skills, public services, and institutional strength, aiming to help more countries capture AI-driven economic growth and prepare for future job markets.

items.title: OpenAI launches Education for Countries initiative to help governments integrate AI into education systems and workforce training [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced Education for Countries, a new initiative aimed at assisting governments in modernizing education systems by embedding AI tools, training, and research to prepare students for future workforce demands. The program collaborates with ministries, universities, and researchers to provide AI-powered learning tools, conduct large-scale research on AI's impact in education, and offer certifications aligned with national workforce priorities. The initiative's first cohort includes Estonia, Greece, Italy, Jordan, Kazakhstan, Slovakia, Trinidad & Tobago, and the United Arab Emirates, with deployments such as Estonia's nationwide use of ChatGPT Edu reaching over 30,000 users. OpenAI emphasizes a phased rollout focusing on educator training and pilot programs for students, alongside efforts to ensure AI safety and literacy for young users. This program aligns with OpenAI's mission to expand economic opportunity and ensure AI benefits are broadly accessible.

items.title: OpenAI and Gates Foundation launch $50M Horizon 1000 pilot to advance AI in 1,000 African primary healthcare clinics by 2028 [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI and the Gates Foundation have announced Horizon 1000, a $50 million initiative to support the deployment of AI technologies in primary healthcare across 1,000 clinics in Africa by 2028. The program aims to strengthen healthcare delivery by providing funding, technology, and technical support, starting with Rwanda. The initiative addresses the shortage of healthcare workers and variable quality of care in Sub-Saharan Africa by helping frontline health workers use AI tools to navigate complex guidelines and reduce administrative burdens. Horizon 1000 seeks to improve patient care and support health workers while promoting African leadership in healthcare innovation.

items.title: OpenAI outlines Stargate Community plans to tailor AI infrastructure development with local input, energy commitments, and workforce priorities across US sites [ * ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI is advancing its Stargate AI infrastructure initiative with a community-first approach that emphasizes local input, energy responsibility, and economic benefits. The company aims to expand its U.S. AI capacity to 10GW by 2029, with several sites already operational or in development across Texas, New Mexico, Wisconsin, and Michigan. Each Stargate site will have a customized community plan addressing local energy needs and grid conditions, including commitments to fund energy generation and grid upgrades without raising local electricity prices. Partnerships with utilities and developers are underway to implement these plans, such as solar and battery storage projects in Wisconsin and Michigan, and new energy generation in Texas. OpenAI also prioritizes minimizing water use and protecting ecosystems through advanced cooling technologies.

items.title: ServiceNow expands access to OpenAI models to power AI-driven enterprise workflows and voice capabilities across its platform [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: ServiceNow announced a multi-year agreement to integrate OpenAI's frontier models, including GPT-5.2, as a preferred intelligence capability for enterprises running over 80 billion workflows annually on its platform. This integration enables AI to understand, decide, and act within enterprise workflows securely, enhancing automation across IT, finance, sales, and human resources functions. The partnership supports AI-powered features such as natural language assistance, summarization, content generation, intelligent search, and developer tools that convert intent into automated workflows. ServiceNow and OpenAI aim to develop more natural, multimodal AI experiences that allow users to interact via speech, text, or visuals, helping enterprises deploy scalable, agentic AI to improve operational efficiency and decision-making.

items.title: OpenAI rolls out age prediction on ChatGPT to identify users under 18 and apply teen-specific safeguards [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI is deploying an age prediction model on ChatGPT consumer plans to estimate whether accounts belong to users under 18, enabling the application of tailored safeguards to protect teens. The model analyzes behavioral and account signals such as activity patterns and stated age, with users able to verify their age via a secure selfie process to regain full access if misclassified. The safeguards reduce exposure to sensitive content including graphic violence, risky viral challenges, sexual or violent role play, self-harm depictions, and harmful body image content. This approach is informed by expert input and child development research, with ongoing efforts to improve accuracy and prevent circumvention. Parental controls also allow customization of teen experiences, including usage limits and distress notifications. The rollout will expand to the EU soon, with OpenAI continuing to refine protections and engage with experts on teen safety.

items.title: OpenAI outlines business model scaling with intelligence value through subscriptions, API usage, ads, commerce, and compute amid growing ChatGPT adoption [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI describes how its business model grows in line with the value delivered by its AI intelligence, particularly through ChatGPT's widespread adoption. The company has expanded from consumer subscriptions to workplace plans, usage-based pricing, and a platform for developers, aligning revenue growth with increasing compute capacity and user engagement. The model integrates commerce and advertising by helping users move from exploration to decision-making, ensuring monetization adds genuine value. OpenAI reports significant growth in compute resources and revenue from 2023 to 2025, emphasizing a diversified compute ecosystem that supports scalable AI services for everyday workflows beyond elite use cases.

items.title: Google DeepMind introduces D4RT for unified 4D reconstruction and tracking, achieving up to 300x speed improvements over prior methods [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind has developed D4RT, a system that enables AI to perform unified and efficient four-dimensional reconstruction and tracking. This technology significantly accelerates processing speeds, reaching up to 300 times faster than previous approaches. D4RT's advancements could enhance AI perception capabilities in dynamic environments, facilitating more responsive and accurate spatial understanding.

items.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Go worldwide with GPT-5.2 Instant access, higher usage limits, and longer memory at $8 per month in the US [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has expanded ChatGPT Go, a low-cost subscription plan offering access to its GPT-5.2 Instant model, to all countries where ChatGPT is available. Originally launched in India in August 2025, ChatGPT Go provides users with increased message limits, file uploads, image creation, and longer memory compared to the free tier, aiming to make advanced AI more affordable globally. ChatGPT Go joins OpenAI's subscription lineup alongside ChatGPT Plus and ChatGPT Pro, which offer progressively higher capabilities and pricing. The company plans to introduce ads in the free tier and ChatGPT Go in the US to support accessibility, while paid tiers will remain ad-free.

items.title: OpenAI plans to test ads in the U.S. on ChatGPT free and Go tiers to expand affordable AI access while preserving privacy and answer quality [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI announced plans to introduce advertising on the free and ChatGPT Go subscription tiers in the U.S. to support broader access to AI tools. The company emphasized that ads will be clearly labeled, separate from ChatGPT's responses, and will not influence the answers provided, maintaining user trust and privacy. ChatGPT Go, a low-cost subscription offering expanded features, is now available in the U.S. alongside the free tier. OpenAI will not include ads in Pro, Business, or Enterprise subscriptions and will exclude ads from accounts of users under 18 or near sensitive topics. The company highlighted principles guiding its ad approach, including mission alignment, answer independence, conversation privacy, user control over data, and prioritizing long-term user trust over revenue. OpenAI plans to start testing ads in the coming weeks, gathering user feedback to refine the experience. The initiative aims to create a diverse revenue model that supports affordable AI access globally while maintaining the quality and trustworthiness of ChatGPT's services.

items.title: OpenAI invests in Merge Labs to develop high-bandwidth brain-computer interfaces combining biology and AI [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI is investing in Merge Labs to advance brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) that integrate biological and artificial intelligence to enhance human ability and interaction with technology. Merge Labs aims to create safe, high-bandwidth BCIs by combining bioengineering, neuroscience, device engineering, and AI. OpenAI will collaborate with Merge Labs on scientific foundation models and AI tools to accelerate research and development. Merge Labs' co-founders include researchers Mikhail Shapiro, Tyson Aflalo, and Sumner Norman, supported by technology entrepreneurs including Sam Altman in a personal capacity.

items.title: OpenAI launches RFP to boost U.S. AI supply chain by expanding domestic manufacturing of data center hardware, consumer electronics, and robotics components [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has issued a new Request for Proposals aimed at strengthening the U.S. AI supply chain by accelerating domestic manufacturing of critical components for data centers, consumer electronics, and robotics. This initiative supports the company's broader Stargate effort to build AI infrastructure capacity and create well-paid jobs across the country. The RFP seeks manufacturers and suppliers capable of producing modules, tooling, assembly equipment, and key inputs like power electronics and cooling systems within the United States. OpenAI plans to use responses to guide partnerships and procurement strategies that enhance supply chain resilience and maintain American leadership in AI technology as infrastructure scales. This effort is part of a wider push toward reindustrialization, with manufacturers investing in advanced production capabilities and workforce expansion to ensure AI benefits are developed and shared domestically. The deadline for proposal submissions is June 2026, with reviews conducted on a rolling basis.

items.title: OpenAI partners with Cerebras to add 750MW of low-latency AI compute for faster real-time inference, with capacity rolling out through 2028 [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has partnered with Cerebras to integrate 750MW of ultra low-latency AI compute into its platform, aiming to reduce inference latency and speed up responses for real-time AI workloads such as code generation, image creation, and AI agents. Cerebras' technology combines massive compute, memory, and bandwidth on a single chip to eliminate bottlenecks that slow AI inference on conventional hardware. The integration will occur in phases through 2028, enhancing OpenAI's inference stack to support faster, more natural AI interactions and enabling the scaling of real-time AI to more users. OpenAI describes this partnership as part of its strategy to match the right compute systems to specific workloads, while Cerebras highlights the potential for real-time inference to transform AI usage similarly to how broadband transformed the internet.

items.title: Google DeepMind updates Veo 3.1 to generate more expressive, consistent videos with vertical format support and upscaling to 1080p and 4K [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind has released Veo 3.1, an update to its Ingredients to Video tool that enhances video expressiveness, character and background consistency, and supports native vertical video output for platforms like YouTube Shorts. The update also introduces upscaling options to 1080p and 4K resolution, enabling higher-fidelity video production directly from images on mobile devices. Veo 3.1 improvements include richer dialogue and storytelling from simple prompts, better identity consistency for characters across scenes, and the ability to maintain consistent backgrounds and objects. These features allow creators to produce cohesive, dynamic clips with seamless blending of textures and elements. The update is available across multiple platforms including the Gemini app, YouTube Shorts, Flow, Google Vids, the Gemini API, and Vertex AI, catering to both casual users and professional filmmakers.

items.title: Zenken adopts ChatGPT Enterprise to enhance sales efficiency and proposal success, achieving over 90% weekly usage and significant time savings [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Zenken has implemented ChatGPT Enterprise across its organization to improve sales performance, reduce preparation time, and increase proposal approval rates. The company reports more than 90% weekly active usage, 30 to 50% time savings on knowledge tasks, and reinvestment of saved hours into higher-value work, leading to a 5 to 10% increase in new deal win rates and a 30% rise in final proposal approvals. Zenken chose ChatGPT Enterprise for its security features and advanced reasoning models, which support complex business analysis and strategic decision-making. The AI tools have transformed sales workflows by enabling deeper industry analysis, real-time responses during meetings, and personalized proposals, helping the lean sales team engage customers more effectively and reduce outsourcing costs by 50 million yen annually.

items.title: OpenAI and SoftBank Group invest $1 billion in SB Energy to develop multi-gigawatt AI data center campuses including a 1.2 GW Texas facility under the Stargate initiative [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI and SoftBank Group have each invested $500 million in SB Energy to support the development of large-scale AI data center campuses, including a 1.2 gigawatt facility in Milam County, Texas. This partnership is part of the broader Stargate initiative aimed at advancing AI and energy infrastructure in the United States. SB Energy will build and operate the Texas data center, which is expected to begin service in 2026 and create thousands of construction jobs. The collaboration combines OpenAI's data center engineering expertise with SB Energy's infrastructure and energy development capabilities, focusing on efficient, purpose-built AI infrastructure with attention to water usage and energy needs to benefit local communities and ratepayers.

items.title: Datadog integrates OpenAI Codex for system-level code review to identify risks beyond traditional tools, improving incident prevention across its engineering teams [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Datadog has adopted OpenAI's Codex to enhance its code review process by incorporating system-wide context, enabling the detection of risks that traditional static analysis tools often miss. This integration aims to prevent incidents and maintain customer trust by providing deeper insights into how code changes affect interconnected systems. The company piloted Codex in one of its largest repositories, automatically reviewing every pull request and gathering engineer feedback that highlighted Codex's valuable and relevant suggestions. Datadog validated Codex's effectiveness by replaying historical incidents, finding that it identified potential issues in about 22% of cases that human reviewers had overlooked. The tool's ability to reason over the entire codebase and dependencies has led to broader deployment among over 1,000 engineers, who report that Codex's feedback feels like input from a highly knowledgeable engineer with extensive time to find bugs.

items.title: OpenAI launches OpenAI for Healthcare with HIPAA-compliant AI tools including ChatGPT for Healthcare, partnering with major US health systems starting January 2026 [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI introduced OpenAI for Healthcare, a suite of secure AI products designed to help healthcare organizations improve care quality, reduce administrative workload, and maintain HIPAA compliance. The offering includes ChatGPT for Healthcare, which supports clinical, research, and operational workflows with evidence-based responses and institutional policy integration, and is already deployed at leading institutions such as AdventHealth and UCSF. The platform features role-based access controls, data residency options, audit logs, and a Business Associate Agreement to ensure patient data protection and compliance. It aims to address the growing strain on healthcare by enabling clinicians to synthesize medical evidence, automate documentation, and follow consistent care pathways while keeping clinicians in control of patient care decisions.

items.title: Netomi scales enterprise AI agents using GPT-4.1 and GPT-5.2 with concurrency and governance for reliable multi-step workflows [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: Netomi has developed a platform that uses OpenAI's GPT-4.1 for fast, reliable tool use and GPT-5.2 for deeper multi-step planning to scale AI agents across complex enterprise workflows. The system is designed to handle real-world ambiguity, maintain policy compliance, and operate under heavy load for Fortune 500 clients like United Airlines and DraftKings. The platform employs a governed orchestration pipeline that supports concurrency to meet enterprise latency expectations, enabling sub-three-second responses even during traffic spikes exceeding 40,000 concurrent requests per second. Netomi's approach includes persistence reminders, explicit tool-use expectations, and structured planning to ensure consistent agent behavior across long, multi-step tasks, addressing challenges in industries such as airlines where workflows span multiple systems and policies.

items.title: Portola builds Tolan voice-first AI companion using GPT-5.1 with low latency, real-time context reconstruction, and memory-driven personalities for natural conversations [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Portola developed Tolan, a voice-first AI companion powered by GPT-5.1, designed for natural, ongoing conversations with personalized animated characters that learn over time. The app emphasizes low latency and accurate context management to handle live, meandering dialogues rather than simple prompt-response interactions. Tolan uses a real-time context reconstruction system that integrates recent messages, persona cards, vector-retrieved memories, and tone guidance to adapt instantly to topic shifts. Its memory system retains facts, preferences, and emotional cues, enabling consistent and evolving personalities shaped by science fiction writers and behavioral researchers. The transition to GPT-5.1 improved steerability and latency, resulting in more faithful character expression and a 30% reduction in memory recall errors, enhancing user engagement and conversational coherence.

items.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Health, a secure, physician-informed experience connecting health data and apps with enhanced privacy protections [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced ChatGPT Health, a dedicated feature within ChatGPT designed to securely integrate users' health information and wellness apps to provide personalized health insights. The service emphasizes privacy and security, operating as a separate space with purpose-built encryption and isolation to protect sensitive health conversations and data. Users can connect medical records and wellness apps like Apple Health, Function, and MyFitnessPal to receive tailored advice and support for managing their health and preparing for medical appointments, while the tool is intended to complement, not replace, professional medical care. ChatGPT Health is built with input from physicians and includes controls to keep health data compartmentalized from other ChatGPT interactions, with conversations in this space excluded from training OpenAI's models. Initially available to a limited group of users outside the European Economic Area, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom, the feature will expand to more users on web and iOS platforms in the coming weeks. Medical record integrations and some app connections are currently limited to the U.S., and connecting Apple Health requires iOS.

items.title: OpenAI opens applications for Grove Cohort 2, a 5-week founder program offering $50K in API credits and early AI tool access [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has launched applications for Grove Cohort 2, a five-week program designed for individuals at any stage of company building, from pre-idea to product development. The program provides participants with $50,000 in API credits, early access to new AI tools, and mentorship from OpenAI technical leaders, aiming to support early-stage founders in exploring AI concepts and building networks. The cohort will include about fifteen participants who will engage in in-person workshops, weekly office hours, and mentoring sessions at OpenAI's San Francisco headquarters. The program emphasizes collaboration with OpenAI researchers and offers opportunities to pursue funding or other paths after completion. Applications were open until January 12, 2026.

items.title: Google reviews 2025 AI research breakthroughs across eight areas including Gemini 3 models, multimodal reasoning, and scientific applications [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Google reported significant AI research advances in 2025, highlighted by the development of Gemini 3 and Gemma 3 models that improved reasoning, multimodality, and efficiency. These breakthroughs enhanced AI capabilities in products like Pixel 10 and Search, and supported progress in fields such as genomics, healthcare, mathematics, coding, and quantum computing. The company emphasized responsible AI development and collaboration to address global challenges including climate change. Throughout the year, Google released multiple iterations of its Gemini models, culminating in Gemini 3 Flash, which combined high reasoning performance with improved speed and cost efficiency. The Gemma family of models also expanded multimodal and multilingual capabilities while remaining accessible for public use. These advancements reflect Google's focus on transforming AI from a tool into an integrated utility that supports scientific discovery and practical applications across its product portfolio.

items.title: OpenAI strengthens ChatGPT Atlas browser agent against prompt injection attacks using automated red teaming and reinforcement learning [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI is enhancing the security of ChatGPT Atlas by using automated red teaming powered by reinforcement learning to proactively identify and patch prompt injection vulnerabilities in its browser agent. This approach helps discover novel attack methods before they can be exploited in real-world scenarios, improving the agent's defenses as it interacts with web content and user workflows. Prompt injection attacks involve embedding malicious instructions that can hijack the agent's behavior, posing risks such as unauthorized data sharing or actions within the browser. OpenAI's continuous rapid response cycle leverages deep model access and compute resources to stay ahead of attackers by rapidly shipping mitigations and tightening security controls, aiming to make prompt injection attacks increasingly difficult and costly over time.

items.title: OpenAI reaches over one million customers using its AI tools to transform work across industries including finance, aviation, healthcare, and design [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI announced that more than one million customers worldwide now use its AI technologies to enhance team productivity and create new opportunities. Companies such as PayPal, Virgin Atlantic, BBVA, Cisco, Moderna, and Canva have integrated OpenAI's tools like ChatGPT and Codex to automate workflows, improve writing, coding, research, and data analysis, and develop new products across multiple modalities. The adoption of AI has shifted from experimentation to transformation, with 75% of users reporting they can complete tasks previously unattainable. OpenAI highlights these customers as key contributors to its rapid growth and ongoing innovation in AI applications across diverse sectors.

items.title: OpenAI introduces framework and 13-evaluation suite for chain-of-thought monitorability across 24 environments, finding internal reasoning monitoring outperforms output-only methods [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has developed a new framework and a suite of 13 evaluations spanning 24 environments to systematically measure chain-of-thought monitorability in AI models. Their research shows that monitoring a model's internal reasoning processes is significantly more effective than monitoring only its actions or final outputs, especially as models engage in longer chains of thought. The study examines how monitorability scales with increased reasoning effort, reinforcement learning, and pretraining size, revealing that most leading reasoning models remain fairly monitorable. It also identifies a tradeoff between model size and reasoning effort, where smaller models with more reasoning steps can achieve comparable capabilities while being easier to monitor, albeit with higher inference compute costs. OpenAI encourages further research to preserve and enhance chain-of-thought monitorability as AI systems become more capable and are deployed in higher-stakes settings.

items.title: OpenAI and U.S. Department of Energy sign memorandum to expand AI collaboration for scientific discovery and advanced computing [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI and the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) have signed a memorandum of understanding to deepen their collaboration on AI and advanced computing to accelerate scientific research. This agreement builds on existing partnerships with DOE national laboratories and supports initiatives like the Genesis Mission to apply AI in high-impact scientific projects. The memorandum establishes a framework for information sharing and coordination between OpenAI and DOE, enabling joint exploration of AI applications in areas such as fusion energy and other research domains. OpenAI has already deployed advanced AI models on DOE supercomputers and engaged over 1,000 scientists across national labs to test and refine AI tools in real research environments. This collaboration reflects a shared commitment to advancing U.S. leadership in AI and science by integrating frontier AI models with domain expertise and scientific infrastructure, aiming to accelerate discovery while ensuring responsible and rigorous use of AI in research workflows.

items.title: OpenAI updates Model Spec with Under-18 Principles to enhance teen safety and age-appropriate guidance in ChatGPT [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has updated its Model Spec to include Under-18 Principles that guide ChatGPT in providing safe, age-appropriate support for teens aged 13 to 17. These principles emphasize teen safety, real-world support, respectful treatment, and transparency, especially in higher-risk situations. The update incorporates expert input from organizations like the American Psychological Association and builds on existing safeguards such as parental controls and content protections. It aims to strengthen guardrails around sensitive topics like self-harm, explicit content, and dangerous activities, encouraging teens to seek trusted offline resources and emergency help when needed. OpenAI continues to refine these principles based on ongoing research and expert feedback, while also expanding family support resources and product features to promote responsible AI use among teens.

items.title: OpenAI releases AI literacy guides for teens and parents to promote safe and thoughtful ChatGPT use [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has published new AI literacy resources aimed at helping teens and parents use ChatGPT responsibly and confidently. The guides explain how AI models work, highlight the importance of verifying information, and offer practical advice on prompt writing, data management, and understanding AI limitations. Developed with input from experts in online safety, mental health, and human-computer interaction, the resources include conversation starters and tips for parents to support healthy boundaries and critical thinking in teens. OpenAI plans to expand these materials over time to cover different age groups and update them as new insights emerge.

items.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.2-Codex system card detailing advanced coding model improvements and safety measures [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI published an addendum to the GPT-5.2 system card introducing GPT-5.2-Codex, an advanced agentic coding model optimized for complex software engineering tasks. The update highlights improvements in long-horizon work, project-scale tasks, Windows environment performance, and cybersecurity capabilities, along with comprehensive model- and product-level safety mitigations. The system card reports that GPT-5.2-Codex was evaluated under OpenAI's Preparedness Framework, showing strong cybersecurity skills but not reaching High capability in that domain. It is treated as High capability in biology and deployed with corresponding safeguards, while it does not achieve High capability in AI self-improvement. OpenAI expects continued rapid capability growth in future models.

items.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.2-Codex, an advanced coding model with improved long-horizon reasoning, large-scale code transformations, and enhanced cybersecurity features [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has launched GPT-5.2-Codex, its most advanced agentic coding model designed for professional software engineering and defensive cybersecurity. The model offers improved long-context understanding, reliable tool usage, and stronger performance on complex tasks such as large refactors and code migrations, particularly in Windows environments. It also features enhanced cybersecurity capabilities, although it has not yet reached a 'High' level of cyber capability under OpenAI's Preparedness Framework. GPT-5.2-Codex achieves state-of-the-art results on benchmarks like SWE-Bench Pro and Terminal-Bench 2.0, which test AI performance in realistic coding and terminal environments. The model can interpret technical visuals more accurately and translate design mocks into functional prototypes. OpenAI is deploying GPT-5.2-Codex to paid ChatGPT users and plans to enable API access soon, while piloting invite-only access for vetted cybersecurity professionals to balance accessibility with safety.

items.title: Google launches Gemini 3 Flash, a fast and cost-effective AI model with Pro-grade reasoning and low latency, available across multiple Google platforms [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Google has introduced Gemini 3 Flash, a new AI model designed for speed and efficiency that offers advanced reasoning capabilities at a lower cost. It is now the default model in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search, and is accessible to developers through the Gemini API, Google AI Studio, Google Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Android Studio, Vertex AI, and Gemini Enterprise. Gemini 3 Flash delivers frontier-level performance on complex reasoning and multimodal tasks while being three times faster than its predecessor, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and using 30% fewer tokens on average. It supports coding, complex analysis, and interactive applications, making it suitable for both everyday users and enterprise workflows.

items.title: OpenAI launches OpenAI Academy for News Organizations with American Journalism Project and Lenfest Institute to train journalists on AI use and responsible adoption [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has launched the OpenAI Academy for News Organizations, a learning platform developed in partnership with the American Journalism Project and The Lenfest Institute to help journalists, editors, and publishers integrate AI into their workflows responsibly. The Academy offers on-demand training, practical use cases, open-source resources, and guidance on governance to support newsrooms in adopting AI for reporting, research, and operational efficiency. The initiative builds on OpenAI's ongoing collaborations with journalism organizations to address challenges like trust, accuracy, and job impacts while enhancing investigative and multilingual reporting capabilities. OpenAI plans to expand the Academy with additional courses and live programming to assist news organizations globally in adapting to AI-driven changes in the industry.

items.title: OpenAI reports enterprise AI adoption surging with deeper workflow integration and measurable productivity gains across global industries in 2025 [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI's 2025 report shows that over one million business customers are increasingly integrating AI into workflows, leading to significant productivity improvements such as saving 40-60 minutes daily and enabling new technical tasks like data analysis and coding. Usage has grown substantially, with ChatGPT message volume increasing eightfold and API token consumption rising 320 times year-over-year. The report highlights rapid global adoption across industries, with the technology sector growing 11 times in the past year and a widening gap between AI leaders and laggards in usage intensity. OpenAI anticipates future enterprise AI developments will focus on handling complex workflows and better organizational context, driving efficiency and new value creation for firms and customers.

items.title: OpenAI opens app submissions for ChatGPT with new in-product directory and Apps SDK for developers [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has started accepting app submissions for review and publication in ChatGPT, introducing a new in-product app directory for users to discover approved apps. Developers can build chat-native experiences using the Apps SDK and follow updated guidelines to create apps that extend ChatGPT conversations with real-world actions. The app directory is accessible from ChatGPT's tools menu and chatgpt.com/apps, allowing users to browse and connect to apps that can be triggered during conversations. Developers submit apps through the OpenAI Developer Platform, with approved apps rolling out gradually starting early next year. OpenAI emphasizes safety and privacy, requiring apps to comply with usage policies and provide clear privacy disclosures to users. OpenAI plans to expand the app ecosystem over time, improving discovery, developer monetization options, and integration of apps as natural conversation extensions within ChatGPT.

items.title: DeepMind releases Gemma Scope 2, expanding open interpretability tools across the Gemma 3 language model family to aid AI safety research [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: DeepMind has launched Gemma Scope 2, an update that extends open interpretability tools to the entire Gemma 3 family of language models. This release aims to support the AI safety community by providing deeper insights into complex language model behaviors. The tools included in Gemma Scope 2 enable researchers to analyze and understand the internal workings of these advanced models more effectively, facilitating safer and more transparent AI development.

items.title: OpenAI launches FrontierScience benchmark to evaluate AI reasoning in physics, chemistry, and biology for expert-level scientific research tasks [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI introduced FrontierScience, a new benchmark designed to assess AI models' expert-level reasoning capabilities across physics, chemistry, and biology. The benchmark includes Olympiad-style and real-world research questions to measure progress toward AI-accelerated scientific workflows. FrontierScience consists of over 700 expert-written questions, with an Olympiad track testing constrained scientific reasoning and a Research track focusing on open-ended research abilities. Initial results show OpenAI's GPT-5.2 leading in performance, indicating AI can support structured scientific reasoning while highlighting the need for further improvement in open-ended tasks. The benchmark aims to provide a standardized measure of AI's scientific reasoning to guide development and track progress, recognizing that the ultimate value lies in AI's contribution to novel scientific discoveries and acceleration of research processes.

items.title: OpenAI uses GPT-5 to optimize molecular cloning protocol, achieving 79x efficiency improvement in wet lab biological research [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI collaborated with Red Queen Bio to develop an evaluation framework testing GPT-5's ability to propose and refine wet lab experiments, focusing on optimizing a molecular cloning protocol. GPT-5 autonomously suggested novel enzymatic modifications that increased cloning efficiency by 79 times compared to the baseline. The AI introduced a new mechanism involving the enzymes RecA and gp32, which together improved DNA strand pairing and assembly. These improvements were validated through multiple rounds of experimentation with human scientists executing the protocols and providing data. The work demonstrates AI's potential to accelerate biological research while highlighting the need for controlled settings due to biosecurity considerations. Although the results are promising, the improvements are specific to the experimental setup and still require human involvement. OpenAI notes that further advances in AI planning and reasoning could enhance both discovery and optimization in laboratory protocols, potentially speeding up scientific progress in biology.

items.title: OpenAI publishes leadership guide outlining five steps for building AI-ready organizations amid rapid AI progress [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI released a leadership guide detailing five practical steps-Align, Activate, Amplify, Accelerate, and Govern-to help organizations adopt AI effectively and stay competitive as AI technology advances rapidly. The guide draws on experiences from companies like Estée Lauder and BBVA and emphasizes clear strategy, employee training, governance, and innovation acceleration. The guide highlights the importance of aligning company leadership and employees on AI strategy, enabling teams through training and support, amplifying successful AI use cases, accelerating decision-making, and establishing governance frameworks. It includes examples such as Moderna's CEO encouraging frequent ChatGPT use and stresses the role of leaders in communicating AI's value and fostering adoption across departments.

items.title: OpenAI launches new ChatGPT Images powered by GPT Image 1.5, offering faster generation and more precise edits for all users [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has released an updated version of ChatGPT Images, powered by its flagship image generation model GPT Image 1.5, which delivers up to four times faster image creation and more accurate edits that preserve details. The new model is available to all ChatGPT users and through the API starting December 16, 2025. It supports precise modifications such as adding, subtracting, and blending elements while maintaining consistent lighting and composition. The update introduces a new Images feature within ChatGPT designed to facilitate creative exploration without requiring written prompts. The model improves instruction following, enabling intricate original compositions and transformations that retain the essence of the original images. Business and Enterprise access to the new Images experience is planned for a later rollout.

items.title: Google updates Gemini 2.5 Flash Native Audio with improved function calling, instruction following, and live speech translation in Google Translate beta [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Google has enhanced its Gemini 2.5 Flash Native Audio model to improve live voice agents with sharper function calling, better instruction adherence, and smoother multi-turn conversations. The update also introduces live speech translation in the Google Translate app beta, supporting over 70 languages while preserving speaker intonation and pacing. The improved Gemini audio model is now available across Google AI Studio, Vertex AI, Gemini Live, and Search Live, enabling more natural voice interactions for enterprise customer service and real-time assistance. Google Cloud customers report increased user satisfaction and business impact from integrating the updated model into their voice applications.

items.title: BBVA expands collaboration with OpenAI to deploy ChatGPT Enterprise to 120,000 employees and accelerate AI-native banking transformation [ ! ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: BBVA and OpenAI have launched a multi-year AI transformation program that will roll out ChatGPT Enterprise to all 120,000 BBVA employees across 25 countries, aiming to enhance customer experience, streamline operations, and support new AI-driven workflows. This expansion builds on nearly two years of collaboration, during which BBVA deployed ChatGPT to thousands of employees and developed AI tools like the virtual assistant Blue for customer service. The partnership includes developing specialized AI solutions for risk analysis, software development, and employee productivity, alongside training programs and secure adoption models. BBVA plans to integrate AI deeply into its products and services, moving toward becoming an AI-native bank with direct customer interactions through ChatGPT, illustrating a significant enterprise-scale use of generative AI in financial services.

items.title: OpenAI used Codex to develop and launch the Sora Android app in 28 days, achieving a 99.9% crash-free rate and top Play Store ranking [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI built and launched the Sora app for Android in 28 days using the Codex AI model, enabling users to generate videos from short prompts. A small team of four engineers leveraged Codex to accelerate development while maintaining high reliability and engineering standards. The app reached number one on the Play Store and generated over a million videos within 24 hours of launch. The team treated Codex like a senior engineer, guiding it with clear goals and architectural direction, while Codex excelled at reading codebases, writing tests, and applying feedback. This approach allowed rapid, maintainable development without the overhead of a large team.

items.title: BNY Mellon expands enterprise AI adoption with OpenAI-powered Eliza platform, enabling 20,000 employees to build AI agents that improve efficiency and client outcomes [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: BNY Mellon has implemented OpenAI's technology through its internal platform Eliza to enable over 20,000 employees to build AI agents that support client relationships and operational efficiency. The initiative emphasizes responsible AI use and governance to maintain trust in the systemically important financial institution. Eliza integrates governance directly into its tools, ensuring security and oversight while allowing rapid experimentation. BNY Mellon has trained 99% of its workforce on generative AI and supports ongoing learning and community engagement to foster a culture of AI empowerment across the organization.

items.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.2 with improved math and science reasoning, achieving new state-of-the-art results on GPQA Diamond and FrontierMath benchmarks [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced GPT-5.2, its most advanced model for mathematical and scientific tasks, demonstrating stronger reasoning and abstraction capabilities that enhance reliability in complex analyses. The model achieved 93.2% accuracy on the graduate-level GPQA Diamond benchmark and set a new record by solving 40.3% of problems on the expert-level FrontierMath test. GPT-5.2 has contributed to solving previously open research problems, including a case in statistical learning theory regarding the monotonicity of learning curves with increasing data. Researchers used GPT-5.2 Pro to directly address this problem, producing a proof that was carefully verified, marking a significant step in applying AI to advance scientific understanding and research workflows.

items.title: Google DeepMind deepens collaboration with UK AI Security Institute on AI safety and security research [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: Google DeepMind and the UK AI Security Institute have strengthened their partnership to advance research on critical AI safety and security issues. This collaboration aims to address emerging challenges in AI development and deployment through joint efforts and shared expertise.

items.title: OpenAI reflects on a decade of AI breakthroughs and shares lessons from its journey toward building beneficial AGI [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI marks ten years since its founding by reflecting on its progress from early research to widely used AI systems that have reshaped possibilities in the field. The company highlights key milestones, including foundational results in reinforcement learning and language models, and the launch of ChatGPT and GPT-4, which brought AGI closer to mainstream consideration. The reflection emphasizes OpenAI's culture of discovery, iterative deployment strategy, and commitment to AI safety and alignment with human values. Looking ahead, OpenAI expresses optimism about continuing advancements and the potential to build superintelligence within the next decade, while acknowledging the challenges and responsibilities involved in integrating AI into society.

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-5.2, its most advanced model for professional work with improved reasoning, coding, vision, and long-context understanding [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI introduced GPT-5.2, a new model designed to enhance professional knowledge work with better performance in reasoning, coding, image perception, and handling complex tasks. It is available in ChatGPT and the OpenAI API, aiming to increase productivity by saving users significant time on work-related activities. GPT-5.2 outperforms previous versions and industry professionals on multiple benchmarks, including tasks across 44 occupations, and demonstrates improvements in spreadsheet creation, presentations, and multi-step projects. The model is rolling out to paid ChatGPT plans and is accessible to developers via the API.

items.title: Podium deploys GPT-5.1-powered AI agents to over 10,000 SMBs, driving 300% year-over-year AI revenue growth and billions in influenced revenue [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Podium has equipped more than 10,000 small and medium-sized businesses with AI agents powered by OpenAI's GPT-5.1, resulting in 300% year-over-year AI revenue growth and influencing billions in revenue. These AI agents, known as "Jerry," handle lead capture, scheduling, and customer follow-up, enabling faster responses and 24/7 service that improve lead conversion and revenue without increasing headcount. Podium tailored its AI agents for various industries such as HVAC, auto dealerships, and medspas, allowing businesses to customize the agents' tone and workflows using natural language. The AI agents respond within a minute, significantly faster than typical human replies, and have helped businesses capture after-hours leads that would otherwise be lost. Podium's evaluation framework prioritizes conversion outcomes, and its GPT-5.1-based agents have demonstrated superior accuracy, speed, and cost efficiency compared to competitors.

items.title: OpenAI updates GPT-5 System Card with details on GPT-5.2 model family and safety mitigations [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has released an update to the GPT-5 System Card introducing GPT-5.2 as the latest model family in the GPT-5 series. The safety mitigation strategies for GPT-5.2 remain largely consistent with those described in previous GPT-5 and GPT-5.1 System Cards. GPT-5.2 models were trained on a diverse range of data sources, including publicly available internet content, third-party partnerships, and user or researcher-provided information.

items.title: Disney and OpenAI sign three-year deal to license over 200 characters for AI-generated short videos on Sora and Disney+ [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: The Walt Disney Company and OpenAI have entered a three-year licensing agreement allowing OpenAI's Sora platform to generate short, user-prompted videos featuring more than 200 characters from Disney, Marvel, Pixar, and Star Wars. Selected fan-inspired videos will be available for streaming on Disney+, and the deal includes Disney's company-wide adoption of ChatGPT Enterprise and OpenAI's API for new products and experiences. The agreement emphasizes responsible AI use, protecting user safety and creators' rights, and excludes talent likenesses or voices. Disney will also make a $1 billion equity investment in OpenAI and receive warrants for additional equity. The collaboration aims to expand storytelling possibilities while maintaining robust controls and safety measures, with Sora and ChatGPT Images expected to launch fan-generated content in early 2026.

items.title: DeepMind strengthens partnership with UK government to support prosperity and security in the AI era [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: DeepMind is deepening its collaboration with the UK government through the UK AI Security Institute to enhance prosperity and security amid advancing AI technologies. This partnership aims to address challenges and opportunities presented by AI developments in the UK and beyond.

items.title: OpenAI invests in safeguards and defensive tools as AI cybersecurity capabilities advance, aiming to mitigate misuse and support defenders [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI is enhancing its AI models' cybersecurity capabilities while implementing layered safeguards to manage dual-use risks and support defensive operations. The company is preparing for future models that could develop or assist with complex cyber exploits, focusing on strengthening defenses and limiting malicious use. The approach includes training models to refuse harmful requests, deploying detection and response systems, and collaborating with expert red teams to identify vulnerabilities. OpenAI emphasizes a defense-in-depth strategy combining access controls, monitoring, and threat intelligence to adapt to evolving threats and empower cybersecurity defenders globally.

items.title: Scout24 launches GPT-5 powered conversational assistant HeyImmo to enhance real-estate search with adaptive answers and personalized guidance [ * ] [ ◼ ]
items.content_text: Scout24, Germany's largest real-estate platform, has developed HeyImmo, a GPT-5 powered conversational assistant designed to guide users through property search with clarifying questions, summaries, and tailored listing recommendations. The assistant adapts its responses to user preferences, offering concise summaries, bullet points, or direct listings with images. The development involved building a custom evaluation system based on the OpenAI Evals framework to measure answer quality and extensive internal testing to refine the experience. Scout24 collaborated closely with OpenAI to improve safety, reliability, and user experience, focusing on delivering an intelligent and trustworthy search assistant. The company plans to expand AI-driven features across its ecosystem, including support for landlords, homeowners, and agents.

items.title: DeepMind launches FACTS Benchmark Suite to systematically evaluate factual accuracy of large language models [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: DeepMind has introduced the FACTS Benchmark Suite, a new tool designed to systematically assess the factuality of large language models. This benchmark aims to provide a standardized way to measure how accurately these models generate factual information. The suite offers researchers and developers a framework to evaluate and improve the reliability of language models in producing truthful content.

items.title: OpenAI co-founds Agentic AI Foundation under Linux Foundation, donates AGENTS.md to promote open standards for agentic AI [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has co-founded the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) under the Linux Foundation alongside Anthropic and Block, with support from major tech companies including Google, Microsoft, and AWS. The foundation aims to provide neutral stewardship for open, interoperable infrastructure as agentic AI systems transition from experimental to real-world production. As part of this initiative, OpenAI donated AGENTS.md, a lightweight Markdown format that provides project-specific instructions to AI agents, ensuring consistent and safe operation across diverse codebases. Since its release in August 2025, AGENTS.md has been adopted by over 60,000 open-source projects and agent frameworks, reflecting growing industry alignment around shared, vendor-neutral standards for agentic AI.

items.title: OpenAI launches AI Foundations and ChatGPT Foundations for Teachers certification courses to build practical AI skills and support workforce development [ * ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has introduced its first certification courses, AI Foundations and ChatGPT Foundations for Teachers, aimed at equipping workers and educators with practical AI skills to enhance career opportunities and classroom applications. The AI Foundations course offers hands-on training within ChatGPT and is being piloted with major employers and public-sector partners, while the teachers' course is available on Coursera and focuses on integrating AI into K-12 education. These initiatives are part of OpenAI's broader goal to certify 10 million Americans by 2030, helping learners demonstrate job-ready AI competencies. The programs involve collaborations with organizations like Walmart, John Deere, and educational institutions such as Arizona State University, with plans to expand access and develop additional certifications in the future.

items.title: OpenAI appoints Denise Dresser as Chief Revenue Officer to lead global revenue strategy and enterprise AI adoption [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
items.content_text: OpenAI has named Denise Dresser as Chief Revenue Officer, where she will oversee the company's global revenue strategy and help expand AI adoption across enterprise and customer success. Dresser brings experience from her previous roles as CEO of Slack and senior leadership at Salesforce, focusing on scaling business platforms and integrating AI into workplace tools. Dresser joins OpenAI as AI becomes increasingly integrated into daily work, with 75% of workers reporting improved speed or quality of work due to AI. OpenAI supports this shift with products like ChatGPT for Work and APIs used by over one million business customers, including Walmart, Morgan Stanley, and Target, to enhance customer experiences and internal operations.

items.title: OpenAI partners with Deutsche Telekom to deploy advanced multilingual AI and ChatGPT Enterprise across Europe starting in 2026 [ * ] [ ◼ ]
